Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Job Title


Territory Manager II, DBS - Houston, TX


Working at Abbott


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that’s recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

Neuromodulation


Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.


The Opportunity


As a member of the regional sales team, the Territory Manager II will be responsible for developing and executing sales plans to exceed revenue and market penetration goals while ensuring alignment and collaboration across the team and with sales leadership. The incumbent will work in a highly matrixed, geographically diverse environment under general direction with clinical and sales teammates to identify and capitalize on sales opportunities by creating competency, comfort, and expertise with Abbott therapies among physicians, support staff and customers. The incumbent will perform work that involves a high degree of independence and will exercise sound judgment in planning, organizing, and performing work while continually seeking to improve territory efficiency.


What You’ll Work On


  • Identifies strategies to increase referrals of Abbott therapies and overcome barriers that are restricting the national growth and adoption of the therapies
  • Integrates into accounts, builds trust, and establishes strong rapport with with new and existing customers, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and industry leaders
  • Generate additional sales revenue in assigned region by running initiatives targeted at increasing referrals of eligible patients
  • Collects and studies information about new and existing products and monitors competitor sales, prices and products
  • Ensures prompt follow-up of sales leads, investigation of complaints, and timely completion and filing of standard reports
  • Fosters high trust relationships with colleagues including the regional teams and area leadership
  • Conducts evaluations and develops sales strategies for capital equipment opportunities within accounts
  • Coordinates implanting schedules of aligned Territory Managers and Clinical Specialists
  • Interfaces and interacts with patients up to 50% of the time
  • Demonstrates fiscal responsibility by effectively managing consigned inventory used in the territory
  • Analyzes sales statistics, prepares reports, and performs required administrative sales duties such as filing expense account reports, scheduling appointments, and making travel plans
  • Exercises authority to make sales commitments for assigned efforts and is accountable for results
  • Attends trade shows where new products and technologies are showcased; meet other sales representatives and clients to discuss new product developments
  • Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments
  • Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors
  • Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in lieu of degree
  • 2 or more years of sales experience, preferably in the medical devices industry
  • Ability and willingness to travel within assigned area on a regular basis (% of travel varies by area)
  • Capable and willing to work an unpredictable schedule that may change on short notice
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels and to large groups within and outside the organization
  • Capable of managing multiple projects and accustomed to tight deadlines

Apply Now

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at , on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott, and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

ポジション概要

Parexelの薬事部門では、医薬品の承認申請を支えるeCTD Publishingのスペシャリストを募集しています。

本ポジションでは、Regulatory Affairs担当者等が作成した申請資料をもとに、規制当局の要件に沿ったeCTD形式への編纂・構築を行います。

専用のPublishing Systemを使用したeCTDの作成・編纂、QC、Validation、Lifecycle Managementなど、医薬品の電子申請を支える専門的な業務をご担当いただきます。

eCTD Publishingの実務経験をお持ちの方を歓迎します。Submission全体の管理経験は必須ではなく、これまで担当者の指示のもとでeCTDの編纂・構築業務を担当されていた方も対象となります。


主な業務内容

- 医薬品の承認申請等におけるeCTDの作成・編纂

- 規制要件に基づいた申請文書のeCTD形式への構築

- eCTDに使用するSource Documentの確認・管理

- 申請用PDFの加工・編集、Bookmark、Hyperlink等の設定

- eCTDのQCおよびValidation

- eCTD Lifecycle Management

  • 新薬承認申請（NDA）を含む各種SubmissionのPublishing Support
  • 規制当局からの照会事項（Response to Questions）に対するPublishing Support
  • Regulatory Affairs担当者や国内外のプロジェクトメンバーとの連携

- Submissionスケジュールに沿ったPublishing業務の進捗管理

経験・スキルに応じて、Submission Managementや、より複雑な申請プロジェクトのPublishing業務にも携わっていただきます。


応募要件

必須要件

- eCTDの作成・編纂・構築に関する実務経験

- eCTD Publishing System等を使用した実務経験

- 日本語で業務を遂行できること

製薬会社、CROだけでなく、eCTD Publishingサービスを提供するベンダー等での経験も歓迎します。


歓迎要件

  • 製薬会社またはCROにおけるRegulatory Operations / Submission Management経験

- 新薬承認申請（NDA）に関するPublishing経験

- 日本の医薬品承認申請および薬事規制に関する知識

- eCTD Lifecycle Managementの経験

  • 規制当局からの照会事項（Response to Questions）への対応経験

- eCTDのQC / Validation経験

  • eCTDmanager、Calyx RIM、docuBridge等のPublishing / RIM Systemの使用経験

求める人物像

- eCTD Publishingの専門性をさらに高めていきたい方

- 正確性を大切にし、細かな確認作業を着実に遂行できる方

- Submissionの期限を意識しながら、関係者と協力して業務を進められる方

Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.

Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.

Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Tabby Card Activation team. You’ll combine strong technical expertise with people leadership, acting as a playing coach who stays hands-on with the codebase while driving architectural decisions, engineering excellence and team development. Working closely with Product and other cross-functional teams, you’ll help build scalable solutions that support Tabby Card’s growth, monetization and customer experience.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally including 2+ years of Golang (not a must).
  • 2+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, preferably at a fast-growing fintech or e-commerce company.
  • Experience building scalable, distributed systems and working with high-load architectures.
  • Solid understanding of backend tools and technologies, we use PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform, GitLab, and a microservices architecture.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs and contributing to product development.
  • A passion for writing clean, testable, and maintainable code.
  • A proactive mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Strong communication skills in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead large cross-team projects and drive them to production.
  • Stay hands-on as a playing coach: write code, participate in architectural discussions, and contribute to key technical decisions.
  • Review feature designs and ensure non-functional requirements are met.
  • Oversee technical debt management and incident handling.
  • Drive the effective adoption of AI tools and practices across the SDLC and team processes to improve engineering productivity.
  • Contribute to quarterly planning and roadmap definition.
  • Hire, evaluate, mentor, and motivate team members.
  • Build cross-team and cross-functional collaboration to increase efficiency.
  • Foster a results- and business-oriented culture.
  • Monitor key team performance indicators.
  • Ensure process and delivery transparency for stakeholders and partner functions.
  • Optimize processes to improve productivity.

What we offer:

  • Full-time B2B contract
  • Fully remote setup
  • Up to 20% tax allowance
  • 22 paid leave days annually
  • Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company
  • Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning
  • Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn
Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation and legal setup.

JOB SUMMARY

Achieve company inventory management goals for aligned suppliers which include but is not limited to: exemplary customer service, purchase order (PO) accuracy (cost, quantity, dates), minimal spoilage and shrink, and managing inventory to the lowest possible Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). Execute a replenishment strategy that supports supply chain efficiencies; in conjunction with: • Shipping and receiving. • Warehousing. • Order filling, picking, and packing. • Inventory control and records management. Utilize Inventory systems to achieve optimum inventory and service levels through supplier and item level settings, supply chain best practices, policies, and procedures.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take strategic action to maintain inventory levels while maximizing customer service levels.

  • Manage Inventory DSO, aged inventory, obsolete inventory, spoilage and shrink to achieve company goals.

  • Collaborate with the local, market and corporate merchandising teams, suppliers, and other functional areas.

  • Demonstrate an intermediate to advanced level of proficiency of the Manhatten inventory planning tool Demand Planning Replenishment (DPR), to drive the team's performance as indicated by DPR scorecards, dashboards and merchandising key performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Work with the logistics team to maximize supply chain efficiencies.

  • Collaborate/strategize with Inbound Planning to develop programs to maximize efficiencies of receiving and warehousing.

  • Manage Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) count (min 2,300-4,000 SKUs vendor direct, 3500+ redistributed or 750 purchase order perishable lines weekly) and resolve replenishment issues as required.

  • Performance to be sustained at this level while meeting established KPIs.

  • Execute purchasing of new items and proper system set up timely.

  • Actively process salesforce 360 request including NISR and MSR request in timely manner.

  • Follow and react to market conditions within established corporate and market guidelines.

  • Understand seasonal trends for aligned suppliers

  • Manage and understand commodity purchasing dynamics.

  • Execute enterprise purchasing initiatives.

  • Confirm all POs for pricing and quantity.

  • Investigate and resolve late/missing POs.

  • Respond and resolve Cora requests in a timely manner.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

High school diploma required.

Bachelor's degree preferred.

Experience

3+ years of experience. May substitute an equivalent combination of education and experience in place of 3 years Inventory Management/Purchasing experience (Bachelors: +1 year Inventory Management/Purchasing experience).

Experience working within a retail, wholesale or distribution environment.

Inventory Management/Purchasing experience in distributor with 10,000+ SKUs preferred.

Professional Skills

  • Proficient Excel skills.

  • Strong communication skills with stakeholders on any gaps in product service level.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across the enterprise.

  • Superb attention to detail and follow up.

  • Proactive attitude to highlight and address issues as they arise.

  • Able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

  • Adapt to change based on company’s priorities. Understand/execute standard replenishment processes and best practices.

  • Excellent tactical replenishment execution skills.

  • Solid organizational and planning skills.

  • Negotiate with suppliers to execute the inventory depletion process.

  • Knowledgeable of product forecasting

OVERVIEW:

Sysco is the global leader in foodservice distribution. With over 71,000 colleagues and a fleet of over 13,000 vehicles, Sysco operates approximately 333 distribution facilities worldwide and serves more than 700,000 customer locations.

We offer our colleagues the opportunity to grow personally and professionally, to contribute to the success of a dynamic organization, and to serve others in a manner that exceeds their expectations. We’re looking for talented, hard-working individuals to join our team. Come grow with us and let us show you why Sysco is at the heart of food and service.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected factor under federal, state or local law.

This opportunity is available through Sysco Corporation, its subsidiaries and affiliates.

raw.description:
Cognicion LLC, a boutique eDiscovery services and information management provider is actively recruiting a skilled Team Lead to support the delivery of post-cyber incident response matters by leading review teams, executing established workflows, performing quality control, maintaining project documentation, and supporting reporting and notification deliverables. Works closely with the Cyber Services team to provide operational and technical support throughout the project lifecycle. This role is designed as a development pathway to the Cyber Consultant role, with increasing responsibility for technical workflows, project coordination, client communications, and cyber project workstreams.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  1. Assists with cyber incident response projects and provides day-to-day operational and technical support to the CIR team.
  2. Collaborates with CIR team members and managers to execute established workflows, including document analysis, sensitive-data identification, review, quality control, and notification reporting.
  3. Serves as a primary point of contact for assigned review teams, providing project-specific guidance, answering workflow questions, and escalating issues as appropriate.
  4. Assists with reviewer onboarding and project-specific training and communicates updates to review protocols, workflows, and quality expectations.
  5. Executes and monitors established review and quality-control workflows and, with guidance, helps refine them to improve efficiency, quality, and profitability.
  6. Monitors reviewer productivity, quality, staffing needs, and adherence to project guidance; provides feedback and recommendations to the CIR team.
  7. Supports project intake, triage, culling, entity creation, notification-list preparation, and reporting throughout the cyber project lifecycle.
  8. Prepares and maintains status reports, decision logs, reviewer guidance, metrics, and other project documentation.
  9. Prepares and validates structured data, spreadsheets, metadata overlays, and client-ready deliverables using established procedures and under the direction of the CIR team.
  10. Identifies and escalates project risks, workflow issues, quality concerns, and schedule impacts.
  11. Troubleshoots routine platform, workflow, and access issues and coordinates or escalates support requests as necessary.
  12. Adheres to data-security, confidentiality, chain-of-custody, and project-specific information-handling requirements.
  13. Assumes responsibility for assigned project workstreams, including review oversight, quality control, reporting, notification-list preparation, and workflow execution, with increasing independence as proficiency is demonstrated.
  14. Participates in internal and client-facing discussions and assists with status updates and communication of review and technical findings under the direction of the CIR team.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred.
  • Two years of experience in litigation document review, managed review, eDiscovery, cyber incident response review, or a related legal-data environment.
  • Experience leading or supporting document-review teams, including reviewer guidance, workflow coordination, performance monitoring, and project-specific quality control, preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret detailed protocols, identify sensitive information accurately, exercise sound judgment, and escalate issues appropriately.

TECHNICAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Familiarity with cyber incident response and/or document-review workflows, including sensitive-data identification, quality control, entity management, deduplication, and notification reporting.
  • Proficiency in at least one review or cyber-data platform, such as Relativity, 4iG, Canopy, or a comparable platform.
  • Ability to search and code documents, create or maintain entities, and work within established layouts, views, fields, and review workflows.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filters, sorting, pivot tables, data normalization, and structured-data preparation or validation.

The expected salary range for this role is $62,600 to $93,700. Beyond an employment candidate's physical location, salary offers may be based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, education, training and/or experience.

Description

Senior Analyst / Consultant – Property & Specialty Product

About the Role

At Liberty Mutual, we're simplifying how we build and bring insurance products to market. The US Retail Markets Property & Specialty Product Delivery team is leading a large-scale business and technology transformation that will redefine how we compete in Personal Lines.

We're hiring a Senior Analyst or Consultant to join our Property & Specialty Product Program Management team — a high-visibility group at the center of that effort. In this role, you'll help define our next generation of Property & Specialty products and build the roadmap to deliver them. You'll work across one of the broadest portfolios in Personal Lines — Homeowners, Condo, and Specialty — partnering with leaders across Product, Technology, and Delivery to turn complex problems into clear, actionable solutions. This is a role with unusual scope. Beyond supporting a single workstream, you'll help shape cross-functional working models, influence product strategy, and design the structures that keep a major transformation on track. If you want to think big, move deliberately, and make a meaningful impact on a major insurance organization, this is your opportunity.

**This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location. The level of position offered will be based on skills and experience at manager discretion. **

What You'll Do

  • Drive product convergence analysis: Research current-state products across brands and lines of business, identify differences, and recommend go-forward solutions that simplify our product portfolio.
  • Own requirements development timelines: Build and manage workplans that keep product requirement development on track, coordinating across key stakeholders including Product Development, Delivery, and Pricing.
  • Support our Legacy Book strategy: Help develop a consolidation strategy for Legacy Books across the P&S portfolio — a critical enabler of our long-term transformation.
  • Build organizational working models: Design and maintain the cross-functional engagement structures that keep Product, Experience, and Technology teams aligned on roadmaps, decisions, and deliverables.
  • Document converged product requirements: Collaborate with cross-functional partners to define and formalize the product requirements that will power our next-generation insurance platform

What We're Looking For

After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

Role Details

Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Reports To: Director, Early Talent, Claude Corps
Comp: $65,000 - $85,000

About Claude Corps

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Each cohort is larger than the last, and every candidate deserves a process that feels organized, responsive, and human. That’s where you come in.

About the Role

You’ll run the operational side of Claude Corps recruiting, from interview scheduling and candidate communication to reporting and offers. You’ll own the recruiting data in Greenhouse, keep leadership informed with reliable reporting, and make sure candidates always know what happens next.

You’ll work closely with recruiting leadership, interviewers, and the program team, and you’ll use AI and automation to cut repetitive work so the team can spend its time on candidates.

What You’ll Do

Own the recruiting data

  • Keep Greenhouse accurate and up to date, including candidate stages, tags, owners, and next steps
  • Build weekly reporting that gives leadership a clear read on pipeline health, interviewer participation, and hiring speed
  • Proactively identify data inconsistencies, trends, and bottlenecks
  • Use AI and automation to streamline reporting, reminders, and routine communications, and validate every output

Own the systems

  • Serve as the first point of contact for Greenhouse, integrations, scheduling tools, sourcing technology, and troubleshooting or escalating issues as needed
  • Maintain clear, current process documentation and lead smaller operational improvement projects

Run the calendar

  • Schedule screens and final rounds. Handle reschedules and no-shows, as needed.
  • Track interviewer participation and outstanding scorecards, and flag delays early

Create a positive candidate experience

  • Manage the recruiting inbox within established response times, ensuring candidate questions and requests receive appropriate follow-up
  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for candidates, providing clear, timely, and professional communication throughout the recruiting process
  • Partner with recruiting leadership and the program team to route eligibility and selection questions to the appropriate owners, tracking outstanding items through resolution

Offers and next steps

  • Prepare and send approved offers through Greenhouse, with accurate details and clear deadlines
  • Track offer responses, open decisions, and deferrals, and keep stakeholders informed
  • Partner with the onboarding team on complete candidate records and timely handoffs

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, program operations, or another fast-paced environment with competing deadlines
  • Experience with an ATS (Greenhouse preferred) and maintaining accurate, reliable data

Key Success Metrics

  • Data Accuracy: Greenhouse records are current and reliable, and weekly reports provide leadership with clear, actionable information

  • Candidate Experience: Candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and have a clear understanding of their next steps throughout the process
  • Operational Improvement: Repetitive tasks and process bottlenecks are reduced through thoughtful use of AI, automation, and continuous improvement

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Sr level position at an annual salary of $65,000 to $85,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join a Retail/CPG project focused on pricing and demand analytics. A strong understanding of the life science industry, the enterprise software sales cycle, and a passion for making market changes with innovative technology are ideal.

What You’ll Do

Requirements

  • 5+ years of combined experience in sales and/or consulting, with min. 2 years in the life sciences space.
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas
  • Consultative Sales experience with Life Science Software Solutions
  • Strategic account planning and execution skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work with a wide range of customers from end users to C-level

raw.title: Sr Portfolio Manager (R-00248)
raw.excerpt: Key Responsibilities • Program & Delivery Management • Provide executive oversight of programs, projects, and task orders within the assigned customer portfolio.
raw.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Program & Delivery Management

    • Provide executive oversight of programs, projects, and task orders within the assigned customer portfolio.
    • Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual scope and customer expectations.
    • Establish/monitor project plans, milestones, staffing requirements, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
    • Ensure contractual deliverables are complete, accurate, high quality, and submitted on time.
    • Identify and escalate delivery, staffing, financial, or customer risks and drive issues through resolution.
    • Foster and maintain strong working relationships with the customer leadership, serving as the primary program escalation point for the customer.
    • Capture program successes and performance metrics in support of True Zero’s Business Development efforts.

      • Personnel Management & First-Line Supervision

      • Serve as the first-line supervisor for assigned employees, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, guidance, and performance management.
      • Oversee the performance management process, working with assigned employees to establish clear performance expectations and ensure individual goals align with project, account, customer, and organizational objectives.
      • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with assigned personnel to review performance, workload, professional development, engagement, and concerns.
      • Complete employee performance evaluations and provide timely, constructive feedback and recognition.
      • Identify professional development opportunities and support employee career growth, training, certifications, and advancement.
      • Address employee performance or conduct issues promptly and consistently in coordination with HR and Delivery leadership.
      • Review and approve employee timecards, leave requests, and other personnel actions in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.
      • Monitor employee utilization, workload, assignment status, and availability to ensure effective deployment of resources.
      • Support employee retention by proactively identifying and addressing engagement, workload, career development, and assignment concerns.
      • Participate in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, assignment, promotion, and offboarding activities for resources supporting the account.
      • Maintain regular communication with employees working at customer locations or in remote environments to ensure continued connection with company leadership and culture.
      • Coordinate staffing transitions and succession planning to minimize disruption to customers and program delivery.

        • Account Growth

        • Develop and execute an account growth strategy for the assigned customer group.
        • Identify opportunities to expand existing programs through additional scope, task orders, contract vehicles, and adjacent customer requirements.
        • Establish and track account-level goals for revenue, backlog, funded work, and team/headcount growth.
        • Partner with business development and capture teams to identify, qualify, shape, and pursue new opportunities.
        • Maintain awareness of customer priorities, budgets, acquisition strategies, upcoming procurements, and competitive activity.
        • Translate anticipated growth opportunities into staffing and recruiting forecasts to ensure resources are available to support expansion.

          • Customer Relationship Management

          • Serve as the primary, senior point of contact and trusted partner for key customer stakeholders.
          • Develop and maintain relationships with government program leadership, contracting stakeholders, technical leaders, and other relevant customer personnel.
          • Conduct regular customer engagement and account reviews to assess performance, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.
          • Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address performance concerns.
          • Ensure the delivery organization understands evolving customer mission objectives and priorities.
          • Balance customer requirements with responsibility for the professional development, performance, and well-being of assigned personnel.

            • Contract Compliance & Administration

            • Maintain oversight of contractual requirements, including scope, funding, period of performance, labor categories, staffing requirements, deliverables, and reporting obligations.
            • Partner with Contracts and Finance to ensure compliance with contract terms and applicable company and government requirements.
            • Monitor contract funding, burn rates, ceilings, option periods, and other key contractual milestones, and work with Finance to ensure TZT Unanet details are maintained and updated as needed.
            • Ensure personnel are appropriately aligned to authorized labor categories, work locations, and contractual requirements.
            • Ensure assigned personnel understand and comply with applicable customer, contract, security, timekeeping, and company requirements.

              • Financial & Operational Management

              • Maintain accountability for the financial performance of the account and its underlying programs.
              • Review revenue, labor utilization, project costs, margins, forecasts, and other financial performance indicators.
              • Maintain a target of approximately 50% individual billable utilization through direct customer engagement or program delivery responsibilities, balancing billable commitments with portfolio management, supervisory, and business development obligations.
              • Ensure employee and subcontractor timekeeping is accurate, timely, and aligned to authorized project and contract charge codes.
              • Review and approve timekeeping for assigned personnel in accordance with established company processes.
              • Review and support timely, accurate customer invoicing and resolve billing discrepancies or issues.
              • Coordinate with Finance to maintain accurate revenue and staffing forecasts.
              • Identify financial or operational variances and implement corrective actions.

                • Metrics & Reporting

                • Establish and maintain an account-level performance scorecard.
                • Track and report key metrics including revenue, margin, staffing/headcount, utilization, vacancies, deliverable status, customer satisfaction, invoice status, contract funding, contract/employee burn, and growth pipeline.
                • Provide regular account performance reports and forecasts to Federal Services Director.
                • Maintain visibility into program risks, issues, opportunities, and corrective actions.
                • Ensure leadership has accurate and timely information to support resource allocation and business decisions.

                  • Team & Organizational Leadership

                  • Provide leadership and direction to Program Managers, Project Managers, technical leads, and other delivery personnel supporting the account.
                  • Build a cohesive account team with clear lines of accountability across delivery, personnel management, customer engagement, and growth.
                  • Ensure appropriate staffing levels and proactively address recruiting, retention, performance, and succession needs.
                  • Coordinate with Recruiting and HR to forecast staffing requirements and fill critical positions.
                  • Promote accountability, communication, collaboration, and consistent delivery practices across the account.
                  • Develop future leaders by delegating responsibility, mentoring high-performing employees, and creating opportunities for increased responsibility.
                  • Foster a culture of customer service, operational excellence, professional development, and accountability.

                    • Key Deliverables:

                  • Engagement delivery plans, staffing plans, and status reporting for assigned engagements.
                  • Utilization and capacity forecasts aligned to pipeline and active work.
                  • Engagement financial reporting: budget, gross margin, and profitability by engagement.
                  • SOWs, change orders, and contract-compliance documentation.
                  • Team development plans, performance reviews, and certification/upskilling roadmaps.
                  • Contributions to delivery methodologies, templates, service catalogs, and SOPs.
                  • Thought-leadership outputs (whitepapers, blogs, accelerators) and representation at events.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS) or a related field.
  • 7–10+ years of experience, including at least 3 years managing consulting or professional services resources / teams and/or managing federal programs.
  • Demonstrate ability to balance direct, billable customer delivery responsibilities with portfolio leadership, personnel management, financial oversight, and business development activities.
  • In-depth knowledge of security domains (cloud, endpoint, risk management, compliance, etc.).
  • Familiarity with frameworks like NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS.
  • Experience with project management methodologies and tools.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, PMP strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication, leadership, organizational, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to hold a federal security clearance is required.

    Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in building or scaling a Professional Services / Engineering Team.
  • Background in fast-paced consulting environments.

What We Offer

Team members at True Zero enjoy:

  • A competitive salary, paid twice per month, plus an annual performance bonus tied to segment results
  • Best-in-class medical coverage — 100% of medical premiums covered by True Zero
  • Companywide new business incentive programs
  • Contribution incentives (white papers, blog posts, internal webinars, etc.)
  • 3 weeks of PTO to start, plus 11 paid holidays annually
  • 401(k) with 100% company match on the first 4%
  • Monthly reimbursement of cell phone and home internet costs
  • Paternity / Maternity leave

True Zero Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

🌍 Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

💰 Salary: Competitive, based on experience

⏰ Working Hours: Monday to Friday, aligned with US business hours, with occasional flexibility as we operate globally

📝 Contract Type: Full-time Contractor Agreement

🤝 Reporting To: Sales Team Lead

📅 Start Date: As Soon as Possible

Role Impact 🎯

As a B2C Outbound Sales Specialist at Nexford, your role goes beyond just closing enrollments – you’ll be a key player in driving our mission to provide accessible, high-quality education globally.

This is a highly targeted, consultative sales position where you’ll manage both inbound and outbound calls, primarily engaging prospective learners in the US and other international markets. You’ll work directly with prospective learners to understand their goals, overcome objections, and guide them toward the Nexford program that best fits their career aspirations.

The role requires balancing productivity and quality: not only exceeding enrollment targets but also upholding Nexford’s standards through rigorous QA call marking during downtime. Every enrollment you secure contributes directly to Nexford’s growth, helping us expand our reach and impact.

We’re looking for exceptional sales professionals who bring end-to-end sales experience, education sales expertise, resilience, consultative-selling skills, and a passion for making a measurable difference in a high-impact EdTech environment.

Why You’ll Love This Role 💛

  • Meaningful Impact: Help make high-quality education accessible worldwide by guiding learners to achieve their career goals with Nexford’s programs.
  • Consultative Sales: Use a targeted, consultative approach to connect with learners, meet sales goals, and optimize enrollment strategies.
  • Global Reach: Engage with learners from over 110 countries, making a tangible difference in lives across diverse communities.
  • US Market Exposure: Work directly with prospective learners in the US market and develop your experience in a global B2C sales environment.
  • Purpose-Driven Growth: Join a mission-focused startup where your contributions are valued, and participate in continuous learning to support Nexford’s vision of accessible, career-focused education.

What You'll Be Owning 🎯

  • 80% of your day is on calls — outbound, inbound, and follow-up. This is a phone-first role.
  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial conversation and qualification through consultation, objection handling, follow-up, and closing the enrollment.
  • Convert high-priority leads by understanding learners’ goals and recommending the program that best fits their needs.
  • Follow up persistently and adapt your approach until the right decision is made.
  • Manage your pipeline across all channels and respond within SLAs — every time.
  • Consistently work toward and exceed individual enrollment and revenue targets.
  • Review sales interactions and calls to maintain and improve quality standards across the team.

Skills and Qualifications 🌟

We care more about what you've achieved than ticking every box:

  • 4+ years of end-to-end outbound telesales experience, including prospecting, conducting sales conversations, handling objections, follow-up, and closing deals.
  • Lead generation or appointment-setting experience alone is not sufficient — you must have hands-on experience owning and closing the full sales cycle.
  • At least 2 year of sales experience in Education or EdTech is required.
  • Previous experience selling to customers in the US market is important, preferably in a B2C environment.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets in a KPI-driven environment. You own your numbers.
  • Strong consultative selling, objection-handling, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • The discipline to manage your own performance remotely and deliver without being chased.
  • Exceptional English, both written and verbal, with strong listening and communication skills.
  • Must be based in the Philippines.
  • Must be available to work US time zones / US business hours.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field.

Why Nexford University 🎓

Join a forward-thinking team dedicated to reshaping education. This is your chance to bring positive social impact to a global audience.

At Nexford, you'll thrive in an innovative and flexible work environment. We offer a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, stock options, professional development opportunities, and more.

Salary: Competitive, based on experience

raw.excerpt: Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph. D.
raw.description:
Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, building the industry's first network digital twin: a mathematically accurate model of the production network. It's the foundation for autonomous networking, giving engineers and AI agents the ability to know the impact of every change before it touches production. That founding instinct still defines how we work. We're accurate and evidence-driven, relentless about clarity, and we'd rather be certain than comfortable, building a groundbreaking platform that transforms how teams run and secure networks across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Global leaders like Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell trust Forward, alongside fast-growing enterprises and government agencies, realizing an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits, according to IDC. Backed by top-tier investors, including A. Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, Omega Venture Partners, Section 32, and Threshold Ventures, and headquartered in Santa Clara, we're most proud of our team: curious people who'd rather build what doesn't exist than accept how things have always been done.

About the Role

Forward is looking for a HR Business Partner (HRBP) to serve as a strategic partner to our Sales organization. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and people strategy, working directly with senior sales leaders (CRO, VPs of Sales, and Regional/Sales Directors) to build high-performing revenue teams, shape organizational design, and drive talent, culture, and change initiatives that scale with an evolving go-to-market motion. This role requires deep credibility with commercial leaders and fluency in the unique dynamics of a quota-carrying, commission-driven workforce.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales senior leadership, providing coaching and counsel on organizational design, territory/quota structure, workforce planning, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Partner with sales leaders to translate revenue targets and go-to-market strategy into people strategies, including org design, span of control, and role architecture as the sales org scales or restructures.
  • Lead full-cycle talent management for the client group: performance management, calibration, succession planning, promotion processes, and career pathing tailored to sales career ladders (RSD/AE, SDR/BDR, sales management, and sales enablement tracks).
  • Use data and analytics (attrition, ramp time, quota attainment, rep productivity, pipeline health as it relates to headcount, promotion equity) to diagnose organizational health and recommend proactive interventions.
  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition on sales-specific hiring strategy, headcount planning, and workforce composition, including seasonal/quarterly hiring cycles tied to sales capacity planning.
  • Lead or co-lead org design and change management efforts tied to territory realignments, reorganizations, M&A integration, or new market/segment launches.
  • Coach sales managers and directors on leadership skills, performance conversations, managing underperformance in a quota-driven environment, and team motivation.
  • Partner with Compensation on commission plan design, quota setting implications, and annual compensation planning cycles (merit, equity, promotions) to ensure competitiveness and pay-for-performance alignment.
  • Own employee relations matters within the client group, including performance improvement plans and terminations tied to quota non-attainment, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally sound resolution.
  • Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives specific to the challenges of building diverse sales teams.
  • Partner cross-functionally (Talent Acquisition, Legal, Sales Enablement) to design and deliver programs that meet the unique needs of a revenue organization.
  • Act as a culture carrier, helping sales leaders build and reinforce an environment of high performance, accountability, and inclusion.

What We're Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, with a significant portion spent directly supporting Sales, Revenue, or other quota-carrying/commission-based client groups.
  • Proven experience operating at a senior level, partnering directly with CRO, VP, and Director-level sales leaders.
  • Deep understanding of sales organizational structures, compensation plan design (base/commission/OTE), quota methodology, and the specific talent dynamics of hiring and retaining sales talent.
  • Strong track record leading org design, workforce planning, and change management in a fast-paced, target-driven, high-growth environment.
  • Excellent coaching skills with the credibility and presence to influence senior commercial leaders.
  • Data-driven approach to HR — comfortable building and interpreting people analytics dashboards (attrition, ramp, productivity) to inform decisions.
  • Sound judgment and experience navigating complex employee relations issues, including performance-based terminations; working knowledge of employment law.
  • Experience partnering on incentive compensation design and annual compensation planning cycles.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills across all levels of the organization.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, HR, Organizational Psychology) or SHRM-SCP/SPHR certification a plus.

The base pay range for this role is between $210,000 and $265,000. Base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location

raw.title: Sr. Strategic Healthcare Advisor
raw.excerpt: Who we areFounded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization.
raw.description:
Who we are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

About the role

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Strategic Healthcare Advisor/Consultant with deep expertise in health plan administration, advanced healthcare data analysis, and the specific challenges faced by self-funded employer groups. This seasoned professional will play a key role in analyzing complex healthcare data to provide forward-looking insights and strategic recommendations that help clients optimize member health outcomes and health plan strategy. The ideal candidate is a talented orator, curious, forward-thinking, and adept at leveraging advanced technologies including Generative AI (GenAI), to derive meaningful insights and guide decision-making.

What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)

· Data Analysis & Insight Generation:

Analyze and identify trends, risks and future opportunities across a broad healthcare data set.
Utilize advanced analytical techniques and tools, including Generative AI (GenAI), to uncover underlying drivers in plan and member experience, clinical outcomes, population health, and cost dynamics.
Employ pattern recognition to determine which populations are driving costs, understand behavioral/utilization differences, and identify concentrations in specific divisions or locations.
Validate data findings by probing deeper into anomalies and ensuring data integrity to produce meaningful insights.
· Strategic Advisory & Future Planning:

Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing forward-looking insights into data trends and their implications for future outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve member health outcomes and cost management through changes in benefits design, workplace conditions, partner solutions, or technology enhancements.
Guide clients and their consultant partners in understanding the potential impact of industry shifts, emerging trends, and "what's happening" in the benefits world on their health plans and member populations.
· Client Engagement & Presentation:

Craft and deliver compelling presentations that highlight insights and recommendations, emphasizing actionable strategies and measurable results.
Engage directly with clients and consultants, collaborating with Client
Engagement (CE) teams to share insights and provide consultative assistance.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as an adjunct analytical support and peer advisor, including for clients with their own analysts on staff.
· Healthcare Industry Expertise:

Leverage deep understanding of health plan administration, the medical and pharmacy payer landscape, and challenges unique to self-funded employer groups.
Stay abreast of developments in the healthcare and benefits industries that can impact client results, including regulatory changes and emerging best practices.
· Internal Collaboration & Solution Delivery:

Collaborate with internal teams (Value Creation, CE, Pods, Product Development, Technology, Actuarial Teams, Data Specialists) to develop and implement tailored solutions addressing identified opportunities.
Work with data teams to access and analyze data, and with project management and implementation teams to support action plans.
· Innovation & Technology Utilization:

Embrace and leverage advanced technologies, including Generative AI, to enhance data analysis and insight generation.
Engineer effective prompts and queries to develop deeper insights and answer complex questions using GenAI and other analytical tools.
· All other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring (Qualifications)

· Bachelor’s degree in Health Administration, Public Health, Business, Statistics, or a related field

· 4+ years of experience in self-funded healthcare space with 8+ years in health plan administration, member health population management, with specific experience supporting self-funded employer groups.

· Ideal candidate will be a tenured professional with 8+ years’ experience, working in consultative and/or analytical roles with a minimum of 4 years in the self-funded healthcare space.

· Knowledge of the medical and pharmacy payer industry, including experience with claims and eligibility data.

· Proven expertise in addressing the unique needs and challenges of self-funded employers, with an ability to develop and communicate strategies that address cost management, plan design, and member health outcomes.

· Strong self-starter mentality with the ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and proactively address client needs.

· Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to engage senior stakeholders and present data in a clear, impactful way.

· Proficiency in data presentation tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Tableau, Excel, or similar).

· Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills, with a client-centric and proactive approach.

· Protect and take care of our company and member’s data every day by committing to work within our company ethics and policies

· Ability to travel to client locations as needed

· Strong administrative/technical skills; Comfort working on a PC using Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), IM/video conferencing (Teams & Zoom), and telephones efficiently.

· A high degree of personal accountability and trustworthiness, a commitment to working within Quantum Health’s policies, values and ethics, and to protecting the sensitive data entrusted to us.

What’s in it for you:

  • Compensation: Competitive base and incentive compensation
  • Coverage: Health, vision and dental featuring our best-in-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.
  • Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.
  • Development: Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 annually, certification/continuing education reimbursement, discounted higher education partnerships, paid trainings and leadership development.
  • Culture: Recognition as a Best Place to Work for 15+ years, dedication to diversity, philanthropy and sustainability, and people-first values that drive every decision.
  • Environment: A modern workplace with a casual dress code, open floor plans, full-service dining, free snacks and drinks, complimentary 24/7 fitness center with group classes, outdoor walking paths, game room, notary and dry-cleaning services and more!

What you should know:

  • Internal Associates: Already a Healthcare Warrior? Apply internally through Lever
  • Process: Application > Recruiter Video Interview > Online Assessment(s) > Interview(s) > Offer > Background Check.
  • Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Quantum Health welcomes everyone. We value our diverse team and suppliers, we’re committed to empowering our ERGs, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer .
  • Tobacco-Free Campus: To further enable the health and wellbeing of our associates and community, Quantum Health maintains a tobacco-free environment. The use of all types of tobacco products is prohibited in all company facilities and on all company grounds.
  • Compensation Ranges: Compensation details published by job boards are estimates and not verified by Quantum Health. Details surrounding compensation will be disclosed throughout the interview process. Compensation offered is based on the candidate’s unique combination of experience and qualifications related to the position.
  • Sponsorship: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent and ongoing future basis without requiring sponsorship.

About the Role

Forward is looking for a HR Business Partner (HRBP) to serve as a strategic partner to our Sales organization. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and people strategy, working directly with senior sales leaders (CRO, VPs of Sales, and Regional/Sales Directors) to build high-performing revenue teams, shape organizational design, and drive talent, culture, and change initiatives that scale with an evolving go-to-market motion. This role requires deep credibility with commercial leaders and fluency in the unique dynamics of a quota-carrying, commission-driven workforce.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales senior leadership, providing coaching and counsel on organizational design, territory/quota structure, workforce planning, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Partner with sales leaders to translate revenue targets and go-to-market strategy into people strategies, including org design, span of control, and role architecture as the sales org scales or restructures.
  • Lead full-cycle talent management for the client group: performance management, calibration, succession planning, promotion processes, and career pathing tailored to sales career ladders (RSD/AE, SDR/BDR, sales management, and sales enablement tracks).
  • Use data and analytics (attrition, ramp time, quota attainment, rep productivity, pipeline health as it relates to headcount, promotion equity) to diagnose organizational health and recommend proactive interventions.
  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition on sales-specific hiring strategy, headcount planning, and workforce composition, including seasonal/quarterly hiring cycles tied to sales capacity planning.
  • Lead or co-lead org design and change management efforts tied to territory realignments, reorganizations, M&A integration, or new market/segment launches.
  • Coach sales managers and directors on leadership skills, performance conversations, managing underperformance in a quota-driven environment, and team motivation.
  • Partner with Compensation on commission plan design, quota setting implications, and annual compensation planning cycles (merit, equity, promotions) to ensure competitiveness and pay-for-performance alignment.
  • Own employee relations matters within the client group, including performance improvement plans and terminations tied to quota non-attainment, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally sound resolution.
  • Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives specific to the challenges of building diverse sales teams.
  • Partner cross-functionally (Talent Acquisition, Legal, Sales Enablement) to design and deliver programs that meet the unique needs of a revenue organization.
  • Act as a culture carrier, helping sales leaders build and reinforce an environment of high performance, accountability, and inclusion.

What We're Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, with a significant portion spent directly supporting Sales, Revenue, or other quota-carrying/commission-based client groups.
  • Proven experience operating at a senior level, partnering directly with CRO, VP, and Director-level sales leaders.
  • Deep understanding of sales organizational structures, compensation plan design (base/commission/OTE), quota methodology, and the specific talent dynamics of hiring and retaining sales talent.
  • Strong track record leading org design, workforce planning, and change management in a fast-paced, target-driven, high-growth environment.
  • Excellent coaching skills with the credibility and presence to influence senior commercial leaders.
  • Data-driven approach to HR — comfortable building and interpreting people analytics dashboards (attrition, ramp, productivity) to inform decisions.
  • Sound judgment and experience navigating complex employee relations issues, including performance-based terminations; working knowledge of employment law.
  • Experience partnering on incentive compensation design and annual compensation planning cycles.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills across all levels of the organization.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, HR, Organizational Psychology) or SHRM-SCP/SPHR certification a plus.

The base pay range for this role is between $210,000 and $265,000. Base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location

Description

Job Description: Data Analyst – Banking / Financial Crime Modeling

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst with a strong banking background and expertise in financial crime analytics, including sanctions, fraud, or Anti-Money Laundering (AML) modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, hands-on experience with model development and tuning, and advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.

This role will focus on analyzing complex banking data, developing and optimizing classification models, evaluating model performance, and supporting tuning initiatives to improve the effectiveness of financial crime detection systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform quantitative analysis and model tuning across sanctions, fraud, and AML use cases.
  • Develop, validate, and optimize statistical and machine learning models to improve detection accuracy and performance.
  • Apply appropriate tuning methodologies and analytical tools to identify opportunities for model optimization.
  • Develop and evaluate classification models, including logistic regression, multinomial logit, and tree-based machine learning algorithms such as XGBoost, LightGBM, and Random Forest.
  • Use Python and SQL to perform data analysis, feature engineering, statistical modeling, and automation.
  • Work with large and complex datasets to identify data quality issues, modeling gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Compare model performance using appropriate statistical measures and recommend optimization strategies.
  • Document model tuning methodologies, results, performance metrics, and optimization activities.
  • Prepare clear reports and present findings to senior management, regulatory stakeholders, and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Collaborate with business, technology, compliance, and model governance teams to address analytical and modeling challenges.
  • Maintain code quality and version control using tools such as GitHub.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Master's or Ph.D. in Statistics, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience in the banking or financial services industry, preferably in sanctions, fraud, or AML modeling.
  • Strong understanding of model tuning methodologies, optimization techniques, and performance evaluation.
  • Good knowledge of banking products, processes, systems, and financial crime risk.
  • Hands-on experience developing and evaluating classification and machine learning models, including:
  • Logistic Regression and Multinomial Logit
  • XGBoost
  • LightGBM
  • Random Forest
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, including the ability to write production-quality Python code for data analysis, feature engineering, and statistical modeling.
  • Experience working with large datasets, automation, and data processing.
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts, data science methodologies, and model performance evaluation.
  • Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and GitHub.

Core Competencies

  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data quality and modeling issues.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting capabilities, including the ability to communicate model tuning outcomes to senior management and regulators.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Adaptability and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a changing environment.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

raw.description:
We have opened our doors in line with our commitment to create jobs and grow our economy and are in search for a Full Stack Developer with a strong background building robust, scalable APIs and beautiful, functional User Interfaces (UIs). As a Full Stack Java Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying cutting-edge applications, leveraging a variety of technologies and frameworks including Java Springboot, JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation tools, Microservices architectures and Agile methodologies.

﻿

﻿Responsibilities:

  • Develop high-quality Java-based applications utilizing Java 8 and above.
  • Design and implement SOAP and Restful services to facilitate seamless communication between various components of the application.
  • Utilize JBDC to write efficient SQL for data persistence in various databases.
  • Develop interactive user interfaces using JavaScript/TypeScript and popular frontend frameworks like React.js, Angular.js, or Vue.js.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design features, and implement solutions.
  • Provide estimates on timelines for PI items to be prioritized in each quarter.
  • Writing high quality testable code following software engineering best practices.
  • Implement version control using Git to manage code repositories and facilitate collaboration.
  • Working with and monitoring containerized applications using Kubernetes to optimize resource utilization and scalability.
  • Design and implement Microservices to build modular and scalable systems.
  • Manage project dependencies and builds using Maven (Springboot applications) and npm/yarn (Node.js applications) for efficient software development.
  • Implement and maintain Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate the software delivery process.
  • Utilize JIRA and Confluence for issue tracking, and documentation.
  • Follow Agile development methodologies to ensure iterative development, flexibility, and timely delivery.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role.
  • Proficiency in the Java programming language (Java 8 and above).
  • Strong proficiency in building Springboot applications.
  • Extensive experience with integrations to SOAP and Restful services.
  • Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Software Design Patterns
  • Familiarity with the JPA framework for object-relational mapping.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks like React.js, Angular.js, or Vue.js.
  • Familiarity with monitoring distributed systems using tools such as AppDynamics, Prometheus, Sentry, Zipkin, etc.
  • Experience with Git/Github/Gitlab/Bitbucket for version control and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of Database Design and proven experience working with relational databases, e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Database, Oracle Db, SQLite, etc.
  • Familiarity with using kubectl to interact with and monitor services running in Kubernetes via the command line interface (CLI).
  • Hands-on experience with Microservices architecture and its implementation.
  • Knowledge of Maven for managing project dependencies and builds.
  • Familiarity compiling and modifying plantUML diagrams, e.g. for LLD diagrams and documentation.
  • Familiarity with working with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
  • Experience using JIRA and Confluence for project management and documentation.
  • Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies and practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

raw.description:
Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients. Chez AbbVie, nous effectuons des recherches scientifiques révolutionnaires à l’échelle mondiale au quotidien. AbbVie Canada est l’un des meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada.

Lorsque vous déterminez votre cheminement de carrière, choisissez d’être remarquable.

AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences, les soins de la vue, la virologie, la santé des femmes et la gastroentérologie, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique par le truchement des produits et services d’Allergan Esthétique.

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un Chef, Formation en santé pour notre gamme de produits en Immunologie (dermatologie, gastroentérologie, rhumatologie). Le titulaire du poste sera un membre actif du Centre d’éducation et de formations en santé AbbVie. À ce titre, il aura la responsabilité de cerner les besoins en matière de formation en santé des professionnels de la santé et de mettre au point de multiples initiatives de formation en santé adaptées pour y répondre. Le titulaire du poste travaillera à distance et relèvera du Chef principal, Équipe de formation en santé.

Principales responsabilités

  • Procéder à l’évaluation des besoins des professionnels de la santé à l’échelle nationale et contribuer à la détermination des écarts et besoins en matière de formation pour notre gamme de produits en immunologie en partenariat avec des collègues interfonctionnels.
  • Diriger la planification et l’élaboration d’un plan stratégique de formation en santé conformément à l’évaluation des besoins, aux lacunes en matière d’apprentissage et aux impératifs stratégiques globaux de la marque afin de concevoir, d’élaborer et de mettre en œuvre avec succès des solutions en matière de formation en santé.
  • Diriger la conception de stratégies et de tactiques de formation en santé avant-gardistes, mesurables par des indicateurs de rendement clés (IRC) définis, visant à influencer les connaissances, les attitudes et les compétences des professionnels de la santé, ainsi que leurs comportements généraux, afin d’élever les normes de soins et de favoriser l’amélioration des résultats pour les patients.
  • Superviser la teneur, l’échéancier, et le budget du plan de formation en santé en veillant à la rentabilité, à l’optimisation des ressources et à la réussite de l’exécution.
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’engagement numérique efficaces, en utilisant divers outils et canaux pour améliorer les interactions numériques avec les professionnels de la santé.
  • Mener et favoriser la responsabilité de l’examen des normes en matière de formation pour le matériel de formation en santé, en veillant à ce qu’il réponde aux critères établis et aux critères de qualité.
  • S’assurer que toutes les offres de formation en santé d’AbbVie respectent les normes éthiques les plus rigoureuses, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, celles de Médicaments novateurs Canada, les normes nationales d’agrément, les exigences de l’Association médicale canadienne ainsi que les politiques internes.
  • Identifier et cultiver les relations avec les parties prenantes internes, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, les membres de l’équipe de marque et l’équipe sur le terrain, pour assurer une qualité optimale de la formation en santé et une approche globale pour une exécution réussie.
  • Identifier et cultiver les relations avec les parties prenantes externes, y compris les professionnels de la santé, les associations professionnelles et les fournisseurs afin de créer un contenu de formation en santé de grande qualité qui respecte les normes de formation en santé d’AbbVie.
  • Évaluer l’efficacité des offres de formation en santé par la collecte et l’analyse de données, en tirant parti des connaissances acquises pour élaborer et adapter des solutions éducatives fondées sur des données probantes.

Formation ou expérience requises

  • Baccalauréat en science ou en soins de santé
  • Formation et/ou expérience pertinente dans le domaine de la formation en santé et des principes de l’apprentissage des adultes, un atout important
  • Connaissance du milieu canadien des soins de santé et des divers environnements, organismes et systèmes d’agrément nationaux dans le domaine de la formation en santé, un atout important
  • Expérience thérapeutique en dermatologie, gastroentérologie et rhumatologie, un atout important
  • Certification en formation continue en santé ou équivalence obtenue

Compétences et capacités essentielles

  • Ce poste nécessite des compétences exceptionnelles en collaboration interfonctionnelle et en gestion des parties prenantes.
  • Attitude proactive et solides compétences en matière de relations interpersonnelles et de collaboration, capacité de communiquer efficacement avec des personnes, individuellement et avec des groupes, et d’influencer les parties prenantes pour qu’elles s’alignent sur les objectifs en matière de formation en santé
  • Présentation efficace, aptitudes pour la communication orale et écrite
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et administratives, et capacité à travailler de manière autonome
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler dans un environnement dynamique aux priorités multiples qui exige la faculté de prendre des décisions et capacité de gérer simultanément de nombreux projets et parties prenantes
  • Réflexion stratégique et compétences analytiques garantissant une planification et une mise en œuvre efficaces des offres de formation en santé
  • Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Aisance avec l’utilisation des différents outils/systèmes pour effectuer ses tâches quotidiennes
  • Connaissances et expérience des stratégies et des outils d’engagement numérique, et capacité démontrée à se connecter et à interagir efficacement au sein de paysages numériques, un atout important
  • Bilinguisme (anglais et français), un atout majeur
