raw.description:
Are You Ready?

CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown year over year to nearly 800 people worldwide. For mission-critical and regulated industries that need to deliver critical solutions in high-stakes environments, we provide accelerated operational readiness and unparalleled performance at the highest standard through our rigorous approach, field-tested processes, and elite expertise developed over 30 years.

Our approach is simple because our Purpose informs everything we do:

We exist to be the trusted solution for our clients as they strive to build a better working world and improve the human experience.

Our Foundational Principles:

  • We act with integrity
  • We serve each other
  • We serve society
  • We work for our future

At CAI, we believe in a relentless dedication to excellence, pushing boundaries and surpassing expectations. From the beginning, we’ve challenged ourselves to do what others wouldn’t. Not just setting industry standards, but redefining them entirely. We are bold in our thinking and creative in our approach. We operate at the intersection of wisdom and technology and thrive when they come together with humanity.

For us, operational readiness isn’t simply a goal—it’s a way of life. Tomorrow demands to be at the forefront of today. We get there through tireless effort, precision, efficiency, and an unwavering belief that there is always room for advancement. We’re not interested in how it used to be done. We’re obsessed with how it will be done.

The Global Director, Accounts Receivable leads the global Order-to-Cash finance process and is responsible for billing, customer invoicing standards, cash application, collections governance, dispute resolution coordination, credit policy administration, Average Days Delinquent (ADD) performance, bad debt reserve support, and AR integration for acquired companies. This role ensures that revenue is billed accurately, collected efficiently, and reported consistently across all countries.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the global AR process, including customer setup, billing readiness, invoice issuance, collections routines, cash application, dispute tracking, credit review support, and AR month-end close procedures.
  • Establish global billing, collections, credit, cash application, dispute escalation, and bad debt reserve procedures while allowing for country-specific statutory and customer requirements.
  • Partner with operations, project management, sales, legal, tax, treasury, and local finance teams to resolve invoicing issues, contractual billing requirements, disputes, credit concerns, and collection barriers.
  • Develop AR reporting and metrics, including ADD, aging, collection effectiveness, unapplied cash, dispute aging, invoice rejection rates, billing cycle time, and high-risk customer exposure.
  • Lead standardization and automation of billing and cash application processes, including ERP workflows, customer portals, invoice templates, project billing controls, and integrated reporting.
  • Support acquisition integration by mapping order-to-cash processes, aligning billing requirements, migrating customer master data, standardizing collection routines, and stabilizing AR reporting.
  • Maintain controls over customer master data, billing authorization, revenue cut-off, credit approvals, allowance judgments, write-offs, cash application, and documentation retention.
  • Partner with FP&A to provide visibility of receipts, overdue balances, collection risks, and other AR matters impacting liquidity and cash flow forecasting.
  • Drive continuous improvement through billing discipline, collections management, effective dispute resolution, and increased visibility and accountability for receivables.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
  • 8+ years of AR, order-to-cash, billing, collections, project accounting, shared services, or accounting operations leadership experience.
  • Experience in a professional services, consulting, engineering, project-based, multi-country, or acquisition-driven environment is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience standardizing and improving processes, implementing controls, and driving automation across a complex organization is highly desirable.
We are an equal opportunity employer; we are proud to employ veterans and promote diversity and inclusion in our workplace. Diversity is a strength for our global company. We pledge that CAI will be operated in a way that is fair and equitable to all – our employees, our customers, and the broader society.
This job description is not all inclusive and you may be asked to do other duties. CAI will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance Act (FCA) / Fair Chance Ordinance (FCO).

raw.excerpt: Location: Remote Required Clearance: Public Trust Required Education: Associate's Degree Required Experience: 4 years Position DescriptionWe are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Help Desk Support Agent (Mid-Level) to provide Tier 2 identity and access management (IAM) help desk support for a complex, mission-critical federal program supporting the U.
raw.description:
Location: Remote
Required Clearance: Public Trust
Required Education: Associate's Degree
Required Experience: 4 years

Position Description

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Help Desk Support Agent (Mid-Level) to provide Tier 2 identity and access management (IAM) help desk support for a complex, mission-critical federal program supporting the U.S. Department of Education's Federal Student Aid (FSA) office. The ideal candidate brings solid experience in federal help desk operations, user account management, and identity verification support within a structured, high-volume service environment.

Responsibilities

This position plays a pivotal role in ensuring FSA's internal and external users receive timely, accurate, and professional support for account access, authentication, and identity recovery issues across the PAS and AIMS platforms. The Help Desk Support Agent operates as a key point of contact between end users, Tier 1 help desk teams, and IAM subject matter experts — maintaining high service quality standards while supporting the integrity and security of FSA's identity management ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

  • Respond to inbound calls and written inquiries from FSA internal and external users experiencing account access, authentication, and identity management issues.
    - Support users in attaining access to their authorized accounts and systems, including account lookup by mobile phone, email address, or PII; password resets; account unlocks; and delivery of verification codes.
    - Provide Tier 2 help desk support across PAS and AIMS platforms, including PAS Identity Account Recovery (IDAR), ID Verification Help Desk, and AIMS Two-Factor Authentication (TFA) Help Desk services.
    - Deliver help desk support for integrated FSA applications and services, troubleshooting incidents and problems in coordination with FSA and FSA Data Center teams.
    - Perform analysis and troubleshooting of IAM solution issues, engaging relevant subject matter experts (SMEs) and vendors as needed to drive resolution.
    - Support warm/soft handoffs from FSA Tier 1 Help Desk teams, providing next level Tier 2 support for issues that cannot be resolved quickly at the Tier 1 level.
    - Develop and share written troubleshooting guidelines with FSA Tier 1 Help Desk teams and FSA Data Center staff to improve first-contact resolution and reduce erroneous escalations.
    - Administer automated customer satisfaction surveys following Tier 2 interactions, maintaining a customer satisfaction (CSAT) rating of 85% or better.
    - Meet or exceed established service level targets: live answer rate of at least 97%, call abandonment rate below 3%, and average speed of answer (ASA) within 60 seconds.
    - Resolve all Identity Account Recovery (IDAR) and ID Verification cases within three (3) business days of receiving required customer documentation.
    - Respond to email inquiries within two (2) business days of initial receipt.
    - Facilitate handoffs to the IAM Help Desk for users requiring updates to critical account identifiers, ensuring identity is validated and verified prior to any updates and that supporting documentation is properly stored.
    - Support updates to user phone numbers and email addresses, including triggering account revalidation workflows and maintaining documentation.
    - Support Partner Participation Oversight (PPO) CSRs, Business Process Operations (BPO) CSRs, DCC, COD Web, and NSLDS CSR Helpdesks in performing AIMS user account lookups and password resets.
    - Maintain accurate counts of all inbound and outbound calls and provide weekly help desk statistics including calls offered, calls answered, abandoned calls, live answer rate, and ASA to FSA via IAM SharePoint.
    - Track and report accurate call categorization data by major topic and sub-topic to support FSA program reporting.
    - Participate in quality monitoring activities; all help desk calls are subject to recording and a 2% quality monitoring review.


About PingWind

PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. We have extensive experience in the fields of cybersecurity, development, IT infrastructure, supply chain management and other professional services such as system design and continuous improvement. PingWind is an SBA certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with offices in Northern Virginia and Huntsville AL.
www.PingWind.com

    · Three medical plan choices with generous employer contribution
    · Dental and Vision Insurance
    · Company paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
    · Company paid Life and AD&D Insurance
    · 401k with competitive matching and vesting schedule
    · Continuing education assistance
    · Short Term / Long Term Disability & Life Insurance
    · Medical, Dependent Care and Commuter Flexible Spending Accounts
    · Employee Assistance Program
    · Wellness benefits include Calm Health app and WellHub gym subsidy (formerly GymPass)
    · 529 College Savings Plan
    · Legal Insurance
    · Pet Insurance

Veterans are encouraged to apply

$66k-$92K

raw.excerpt: Who We AreMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Ebusiness Control Specialist

Department: Internal Control

Reports to: Lead, Ebusiness Control

About this role:

The Ebusiness Control Specialist role is responsible for overseeing and validating internal controls across Moniepoint MFB's digital payment platforms, electronic channels, and transaction processing systems. The role ensures that robust controls are designed and operating effectively to mitigate operational, digital transaction, and settlement risks. The Specialist will evaluate transaction flows across all Moniepoint products, API integrations, and payment channel reconciliations to safeguard digital operations. The position requires a deep understanding of internal control frameworks, digital risk management, e-payment regulations, and payment channel architectures.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement control testing programmes to validate end-to-end electronic transaction flows across all products including loans, POS, web, mobile, and API channels.
  • Design and monitor daily reconciliation and control processes for loans, card switching platforms, payment gateways, and third-party processor integrations.
  • Perform continuous risk assessments and control testing on all electronic channels - including payment, loans, chargeback management, and dispute resolution workflows.
  • Evaluate revenue assurance controls for e-business products, verifying fee configurations, commission splits, and automated ledger postings.
  • Review and monitor merchant settlement accounts, transaction staging accounts, and e-channel clearing suspense accounts for timely matching and resolution.
  • Assess IT application controls, authorization logic, and parameter settings relevant to e-business applications and digital channel interfaces.
  • Collaborate with Product, Technology, and Operations teams to ensure internal control requirements are embedded into new digital payment product designs.
  • Develop and maintain an e-business control deficiency dashboard to track and remediate issues identified during channel reviews and audits.
  • Conduct regular audits of digital channel access rights, privileged user activities, and transaction limits to prevent fraud and unauthorized activities.
  • Monitor compliance with relevant payment system standards, regulatory guidelines for electronic channels, and digital risk management practices.
  • Perform root cause analysis on digital channel control failures, transaction outages, or settlement discrepancies, recommending preventive measures.
  • Develop and manage the control deficiency remediation dashboard for follow-up and closure of open findings from control assessment, internal audit, and any external examination and assessment of finance operations.

Experience & Background:

  • Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Management, Finance or a related field.
  • Certifications: CISA, CRISC, CISM, ACA, ACCA or related professional credentials.
  • Experience: 4-6 years of experience in internal control, digital channel auditing, e-business control, or revenue assurance within a fintech, switching company, or commercial bank.
  • Framework and Standard Knowledge: In-depth knowledge and practical experience with the COSO internal control framework, ISO 31000 (Risk Management) and the relevant IFRS standards as applicable.

Skills & Competencies:

  • E-Business & Payment Systems Knowledge: Deep understanding of electronic payment channels (POS, Mobile, Web, NIP, Switching platforms), API integration controls, and digital settlement mechanics.
  • Control & Risk Frameworks: Expertise in internal control frameworks (COSO, ISO 31000, ISO 27001) applied specifically to fintech and digital banking operations.
  • Data & Transaction Analysis: Proficiency in automated transaction reconciliation, data analytics, log analysis, and designing test scripts for high-volume digital transactions.
  • Revenue Assurance: Strong capability in identifying revenue leakage, fee discrepancy analysis, and transaction reconciliation across switching networks.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders across different departments.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: A commitment to continuous learning and improvement in the field of financial technology.
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to a dynamic and evolving threat landscape and regulatory environment.
  • Leadership: Ability to lead assessments and oversee communication and feedback collection with stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively document and communicate assessment findings.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify control deficiencies, assess their impact, and develop remediation plans.
  • Organizational & Time Management: Excellent organizational and time management skills to manage multiple assessments, remediation efforts, and reporting requirements.
  • Integrity and Professionalism: High level of integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive information and maintaining objectivity in assessments.

What success looks like in this role:

  • Full coverage and validation of end-to-end controls across all digital payment and transaction platforms.
  • Zero tolerance for unresolved revenue leakages, settlement discrepancies, or unidentified channel control gaps.
  • Timely remediation and closure of identified control deficiencies, internal/external audit findings, and regulatory assessment gaps.
  • Seamless integration of robust control requirements into all new digital products and API releases prior to launch.

Why join us:

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
  • Supportive culture and commitment to continuous professional development.

raw.title: Marketing Automation Manager - Canada, Spain, India
raw.excerpt: Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence.
raw.description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

Storyblok is hiring a Marketing Automation Manager to own the top of funnel systems and the campaigns that run through them: Pardot, the forms on the Storyblok website, list uploads, Clay, and the nurture programs, sequences and webinar flows built in Pardot. The role sends the campaigns, loads the lists and builds the forms day to day, and turns that repeat work into templates and automations so more of the week goes to lead scoring, routing, data quality and reporting. Sitting within Revenue Operations, this role works across Demand Generation, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development, Sales Operations and Analytics, in a lean data team where the person pulls their own numbers and builds their own reports.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  1. Campaign operations
  • Build and send list emails and sequences in Pardot and Knak: webinar invites and follow ups, quarterly enterprise and marketer sequences, review asks, partner and event emails.
  • Build and run the nurture programs in Engagement Studio (welcome, post webinar, gated content, re-engagement), each by segment and lifecycle stage, and rebuild them as results come in.
  • Set up webinars end to end: registration form, Zuddl to Pardot sync, campaign IDs, reminders and follow up. Build form handlers, autoresponders and landing page forms on the Storyblok website.
  • Load lead lists from events, content syndication and paid social with the right campaign, source and consent, and run the request board: intake, SLA, QA before launch.
  • Run optimization: Test subject lines, send times and content on every sequence, and personalise by segment, industry and stage.
  1. Marketing systems and integrations
  • Administer Pardot and its Salesforce sync: users, connectors, field mapping, campaign member status.
  • Own the links between Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Zuddl, Knak, Meta and Google Ads, and keep them documented.
  • Run Clay: enrichment waterfalls, list building, and the signal tables that feed BDR routing.
  • Evaluate, buy and renew the marketing tools.
  1. Lead flow, scoring and routing operations
  • Own lead scoring and grading, reviewed each quarter against what converts.
  • Own lifecycle stages (MQL, SAL, SQL) and the handoff rules to BDRs and AEs.
  • Bring self serve signups and product usage into scoring and lifecycle, so PLG and enterprise leads run through 1 flow.
  1. Data quality and reporting
  • Own the sync between the warehouse, Pardot and Salesforce in both directions: enrichment and usage in, campaign results out.
  • Keep the database clean: dedupe, normalise country, industry and title, suppression lists, GDPR consent by region.
  • Own the campaign taxonomy and UTM standard across the team and agencies.
  • Write your own SQL and Salesforce reports; build the funnel and pipeline by source reports in the BI tool. Watch deliverability: domain health, bounce and spam rates.
  1. Automation, process and cadence
  • Template the repeat request types (list uploads, list emails, form handlers, webinar setups), then automate them with Clay, LLM tools (Claude) and a workflow builder such as n8n or Zapier, each with QA and a fallback.
  • Write the playbooks and train marketers to self serve where it is safe.
  • Own and report monthly on speed to lead, MQL to SQL and form to meeting rates, request turnaround and share automated, database coverage and accuracy, and email deliverability and engagement.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years in marketing operations or marketing automation, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Pardot administration: Salesforce connector, Engagement Studio, form handlers, campaign sync. Salesforce fluency: campaigns, lead and contact fields, reports and dashboards.
  • Built nurture programs and can show what they did to conversion.
  • Ran a request queue at volume and cut the time per request with templates and automation; shipped automations with a workflow builder and LLM tools and kept them running.
  • Lead scoring, lifecycle and routing experience, with results.
  • Working SQL, and hands on with an enrichment tool such as Clay, ZoomInfo or Apollo.
  • Knowledge of GDPR and consent management across regions.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

  • Operating discipline: runs a high volume request queue on an SLA with QA before every launch.
  • Systems thinking: sees how Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Clay and the warehouse connect, and keeps the data flowing cleanly between them.
  • Data fluency: pulls own numbers, defines fields and builds reports without an analyst in between.
  • Automation mindset: templates repeat work, then builds the automation that removes it.
  • Attention to detail: a wrong list or a broken form reaches thousands of people.
  • Testing habit: runs tests on every sequence and changes the program based on results.
  • Cross-functional coordination: aligns Demand Gen, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development and Sales Ops around 1 lead flow.
  • Communication: writes clear playbooks and guidance that marketers follow without a meeting.

Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. Who We Serve

You’ll be the Office Manager for a family-owned residential plumbing, heating and cooling company. The family has been in the trade for 40+ years and serves homeowners in Connecticut and New York. They run a premium, professional operation:

  • Flat-rate pricing
  • Customer financing
  • A paid maintenance membership
  • 24/7 emergency service

Their customers expect polish, and so does the owner. This role is for someone who wants to own the office, not just support it.

What you’ll own

  • The phones. You are the first voice customers hear. You answer and book calls for service, emergencies (no heat, active leaks, no hot water) and estimates, calmly and professionally.
  • Scheduling and dispatch. Build and manage the technicians’ daily schedules, re-route them when emergencies come in, and keep customers updated on arrival times. The owner should not have to step in.
  • Follow-up. Make happy calls after jobs, follow up on open estimates per the SOP, and sell and renew maintenance memberships.
  • Job tracking. Track every job from booking through completion and invoicing, and flag any job that’s stuck, on hold or at risk of slipping.
  • Cash. Invoice, collect payments, keep receivables current and help customers through financing applications.
  • Compliance and admin. Handle permits, certificates of insurance (COIs), licenses and technician paperwork accurately and on time.
  • Payroll. Prepare accurate payroll every pay period.
  • Reporting. Send the owner a weekly report covering calls, booking rate, job completion, backlog, AR aging and memberships.
  • Systems and team. Keep the field service software (Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan or similar) clean and accurate. Support hiring and onboarding, and manage any office staff added as the company grows.

How you’ll be measured

  • 95%+ of calls answered
  • Every new lead contacted within 5 minutes
  • 75%+ of qualified leads booked
  • Every open estimate followed up on time, per the SOP
  • Membership sign-ups and renewals on target
  • AR kept within target, with nothing aging without action
  • A weekly list of stuck or on-hold jobs, sent with zero surprises
  • Payroll, permits and paperwork done right and on time, every time

You’ll succeed here if you have

  • 2+ years in office management, dispatch, customer service or operations coordination, ideally in plumbing, HVAC or other home services
  • Hands-on experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber or a similar platform
  • Excellent spoken English and a confident, warm phone presence
  • High drive and high attention to detail. You follow through without being chased.
  • The ability to juggle phones, schedules and follow-ups at the same time without dropping anything
  • Availability to work US Eastern business hours

Nice to have

  • Direct plumbing or HVAC experience, especially with emergency dispatch or maintenance memberships
  • Experience with payroll, AR or basic job costing
  • Experience managing a small remote team

Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch):

  • Up to $1600/mo depending on experience
  • Guaranteed annual bonus of one month's salary
  • Performance-based annual bonus up to 1.5x one month's salary contingent on quarterly performance scores
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including dependents: health, life, vision and dental insurance.
  • 16 days PTO

Note:

The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch, all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity.

Software Engineer II

Samsara's Mission

Improve the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the operations that power the global economy.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Safety Engineering - Triage & Insights Team owns and builds the systems and customer-facing products across web, mobile, and API surfaces that help fleets identify unsafe driving behaviors and recognize positive driving habits. We ingest sensor and media data, detect risky behaviors, and serve as the source of truth for safety events, from automations and the safety inbox to reports, safety scores, and driver coaching.

We are building the next generation of safety products to be AI-native. Our team is developing LLM-powered workflows, agentic systems, and conversational experiences that help customers move from manual incident review and reactive coaching toward proactive, intelligent, and self-serve safety operations. That includes AI-driven driver experiences that go beyond static reports into live, two-way interaction, and agent-assisted tools that let safety managers shape the way they triage and act on their data.

As a Software Engineer II on this team, you will own customer-facing features from concept to production. You will partner closely with Product, Design, and ML and AI engineering teams to evolve our products, refine workflows based on customer input, and deliver scalable, AI-powered solutions that make the world's operations safer, smarter, and more efficient.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user, and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer-facing features and platform capabilities end to end, from design and implementation through rollout and follow-through in production, including taking AI prototypes to production at scale.
  • Architect, build, test, and deliver full-stack products across reliable services, APIs, and web and mobile experiences, using technologies such as Golang, GraphQL, TypeScript, React, React Native, and MySQL. Previous experience with these technologies is not required.
  • Build AI-native product experiences: integrate LLMs into safety workflows, develop agent tooling and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and design the interactions between AI agents and the product UI.
  • Design and run evaluations and build human-in-the-loop feedback loops that continuously improve the accuracy, precision, and reliability of the insights we deliver.
  • Use AI coding tools and agents in your own workflow to plan, build, and ship faster, and help shape how our team develops software in an AI-assisted world.
  • Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs across speed, maintainability, scalability, cost, and customer impact.
  • Own the operational health of the production systems you build, improving reliability and scalability as our customer base grows.
  • Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Design, ML, and platform teams to deliver cohesive customer experiences.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating reliable customer-facing production systems.
  • Strong programming fundamentals in a language such as Golang, Java, or Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable code and reviewing peers' code for correctness and clarity.
  • Experience developing features or end-to-end solutions across backend services, APIs, and modern web applications.
  • Experience or demonstrated interest in AI-native development, including integrating LLMs into products, building agentic workflows, or running evaluations to improve the quality of AI-generated output.
  • Experience using data, metrics, logs, tests, or tracing to investigate issues, validate releases, and improve reliability.
  • Ability to independently own moderately complex projects, with the ability to estimate, communicate, and deliver on milestones.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering and cross-functional partners.
  • A growth mindset, strong product intuition, and excitement for learning new technologies and building impactful customer experiences.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building and scaling customer-facing AI or LLM-powered products in production, including agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering, or conversational and voice experiences.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as Langfuse or Eino, and optimizing LLM-powered systems for cost and token efficiency.
  • A track record of using AI coding agents to plan and deliver features, not just autocomplete.
  • Experience working across the stack with modern technologies such as Go, GraphQL, TypeScript, React, React Native, and AWS (or Azure or Google Cloud).
  • Familiarity with observability, rollout practices, and monitoring approaches that improve product reliability and operational excellence.
  • Experience operating in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with distributed teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

raw.excerpt: About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
raw.description:
About Sezzle:


With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Shopper Risk Fraud Operations analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Fraud Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Analysts will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work one of the shifts listed below full-time:
  • Monday -Friday between 9:00 am and 5:30 pm - local time (Central time zone).
This will be a non-exempt/hourly position. Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

Compensation:

For this Fraud Operations Analyst the compensation range is $1,500 - $2,000 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry.

What You'll Do:

  • Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.
  • Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.
  • Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
  • Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
  • Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
  • Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
  • Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

What We Look For:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents
  • Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training
  • Able to work through holidays
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents
  • Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus
  • Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus
  • Experience in using database query language (e.g. SQL, etc), and data processing and analytics tools such as Python / R / SAS is a plus
  • Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:


At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Strategic Healthcare Account Executive to join Ping’s healthcare sales organization. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Healthcare Accounts, this role owns and grows a focused portfolio of strategic healthcare accounts across providers, payers, and healthcare technology organizations. The Strategic Healthcare Account Executive is responsible for driving new business while expanding the right existing relationships, helping customers solve complex identity challenges tied to security, digital experience, compliance, and operational efficiency.   • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close, aligning Ping’s solutions to customer priorities around risk reduction, cost reduction, and improved digital experiences.
  • Position Ping’s identity platform across workforce, customer, and embedded healthcare use cases, including opportunities where healthcare technology companies integrate identity into their own products and experiences.
  • Build trusted relationships with security, IT, digital, product, operations, and executive stakeholders to shape buying consensus and move opportunities forward.

You Have

  • Experience selling into healthcare accounts, including providers, payers, healthcare technology companies, or adjacent regulated industries.
  • A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline and win net-new business through strategic prospecting and account planning.
  • Success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that involve technical buyers, business leaders, and executive sponsors.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate technical capabilities into value tied to revenue, efficiency, risk reduction, or customer experience.
  • Excellent communication, discovery, negotiation, and forecasting skills.
  • A disciplined, self-directed working style with strong prioritization and follow-through.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience selling identity, access management, CIAM, IGA, MFA, fraud, or verification solutions.
  • Familiarity with healthcare industry dynamics, including digital patient or member experiences, regulatory considerations, and security requirements.
  • Experience with platform, embedded, OEM, or ISV sales motions.
  • Experience working with strategic partners, GSIs, or channel ecosystems in enterprise accounts.
  • Knowledge of modern identity trends such as passwordless authentication, decentralized identity, or behavioral and risk-based security models.

.

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sr. Partner Marketing Manager.

About the job This position is needed toscale our partner ecosystem and drive regional pipeline growth through joint co-marketing strategies and through-partner execution.

In this role, you will develop data-driven co-marketing plans with strategic partners, build scalable demand-generation programs, and align internal sales teams with external partner leadership. You will serve as the strategic bridge driving co-selling motions, managing operational budgets, enforcing lead governance, and tracking partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth across the enterprise cloud and SaaS ecosystem.

Responsibilities In this role, you’ll:

  • Develop data-driven multi-quarter co-marketing plans and joint GTM strategies with strategic partners to hit regional pipeline targets.

  • Execute targeted account-mapping using platforms like Crossbeam to drive custom 1:1 ABM campaigns for elite partners and scalable digital toolkits for broader partner networks.

  • Co-create compelling "better together" messaging, solution briefs, and branded assets with Product Marketing to showcase joint value propositions.

  • Orchestrate high-velocity field campaigns, executive roundtables, workshops, and sponsorship presence at major industry flagship events to source new logos.

  • Enforce strict lead-routing governance rules and follow-up SLAs to minimize channel conflict and optimize lead-to-opportunity conversion.

  • Manage partner marketing operational budgets, ensuring fiscal compliance and optimal ROI across co-marketing investments.

  • Track and report on Partner-Sourced and Partner-Influenced pipeline performance within Salesforce (SFDC) for regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Full-time remote work schedule.6–8+ years of experience in Partner Marketing, Channel Marketing, Field Marketing, or B2B Demand Generation within the enterprise cloud or SaaS ecosystem.

  • Demonstrated track record of co-marketing success with major cloud vendors, GSIs, SIs, or ISVs.

  • Hands-on proficiency with Salesforce (SFDC), Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, and account-mapping platforms (e.g., Crossbeam).

  • Strong analytical ability to manage operational budgets, enforce lead routing SLAs, and measure pipeline attribution/ROI.

  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills across sales, product marketing, and partner executive teams.

Desired:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

  • Experience delivering tailored Account-Based Marketing (ABM) frameworks and field events (CXO roundtables, executive dinners) for partner ecosystems.

LocationThis role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

TravelWe prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15-20% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,000 - $160,000.

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location

Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs) Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 30 days from posting, but may change based on business needs

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

What Expel can do for you:

  • Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.
  • Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.
  • Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.
  • Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.
  • Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.
  • Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

What you can do for Expel:

  • Own the customer onboarding journey. Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.
  • Bring customers live with confidence. Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.
  • Help customers get the most out of Expel. Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.
  • Keep implementations moving. Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
  • Get ahead of potential issues. Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.
  • Make customer transitions seamless. Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.
  • Help us continuously improve. Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.
  • Support the broader team. Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

What You Should Bring With You

  • 2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.
  • A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.
  • Understanding of enterprise security best practices and common compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.
  • The technical troubleshooting skills to trace data flows, identify integration issues, and work through challenges between a customer's environment and Expel's platform.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts for security practitioners, business stakeholders, and customers.
  • Experience managing multiple customer implementations or technical projects simultaneously, keeping priorities organized and timelines on track.
  • The confidence to set expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and hold customers accountable while maintaining positive relationships.
  • Good judgment around when to troubleshoot independently, when to escalate, and how to adapt when a customer's environment doesn't fit the standard playbook.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD, with a target range of $104,000 to $126,500, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

raw.description:
Role Description

Dropbox is looking for a Program Manager, Customers to build the connective layer between EPD and GTM as we test products, evolve the platform, and learn from our managed customer base. This role will plan, recruit, launch, engage, measure, and close out customer programs while maintaining clear product-readiness standards and a strong customer experience.

The role is execution-focused but broad in scope. The immediate priority is creating a scalable way to test pre-PMF products with existing managed customers, including priority programs. Over time, the role will support additional customer-facing EPD initiatives, help relaunch and operate Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board, integrate customer testing into launch processes, and establish repeatable playbooks that can be adopted by functional owners.

You will work closely with Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics. You will have substantial cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to turn customer participation into clearer product decisions, stronger launch readiness, and a closed insight loop back into product and GTM.

Responsibilities

  • Stand up and run repeatable customer programs, including planning, recruitment, onboarding, engagement, measurement, closeout, and transition to the long-term owning team.
  • Create shared operating infrastructure, including intake processes, recruitment and readiness criteria, briefs, templates, playbooks, status reporting, feedback tracking, escalation paths, and a single source of truth.
  • Coordinate Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics around shared plans, decisions, milestones, and handoffs.
  • Own the execution of pre-PMF customer testing through H2, including product evaluation, messaging feedback, phased-rollout support, measurement, and exit criteria.
  • Support the relaunch and ongoing operation of Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board through recruitment, cadence management, agenda design, and synthesis for senior leaders and partner teams.
  • Integrate customer testing into the product-launch process as a readiness gate or stage, partnering with PMM and Launch Ops as the process matures.
  • Establish recurring customer listening and insight-loop practices that connect customer-support signals, VoC, UXR, managed-customer feedback, and S-team engagement back into EPD and GTM decision-making.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of program management, operations, customer research operations, product operations, go-to-market operations, or a related field with experience delivering complex cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer-facing initiative from planning through execution, measurement, closeout, and handoff.
  • Experience coordinating multiple teams with different goals, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Strong operating discipline: able to create practical processes, readiness criteria, documentation, reporting rhythms, and repeatable playbooks.
  • Experience working directly with customers or customer-facing teams, including recruiting participants, managing engagement, gathering feedback, and protecting customer experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear recommendations and decisions.
  • Sound judgment about product readiness, customer participation, confidentiality, escalation, and when to protect learning quality over premature storytelling or account-driven requests.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with pre-PMF product testing, beta or Design Partner programs, Customer Advisory Boards, Voice of Customer, user research operations, or customer advocacy programs.
  • Experience embedding customer feedback or testing into product-launch, launch-readiness, or product-operations processes.
  • Experience building a program that scales across products, customer segments, or launch types and then transitioning it to a durable functional owner.
  • Experience in a SaaS, collaboration, productivity, platform, or enterprise software environment.
  • Familiarity with customer insight systems, feedback taxonomies, program dashboards, or tools used to track participant health and product signal.

raw.description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

Senior Product Manager, GTM Studio

ZoomInfo | Product

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition.

The Opportunity

GTM Studio is ZoomInfo's AI application built for revenue operators, GTM engineers, and builders to assemble the next generation of go-to-market systems. We need a Senior Product Manager to own features across Audience building, AI enrichment, and AI orchestration, and to build the best-in-class GTM orchestration tool for revenue operators.

This is a role for someone who has built go-to-market systems themselves. You've worked deep in the revenue tech stack and know what breaks when data is stale, enrichment fails, or a workflow meets real customer complexity. You believe in AI-ready systems because you know firsthand what it actually takes to make AI work in production.

What You'll Do

Own features across Audiences, AI Enrichment, and AI Orchestration. Drive the roadmap for core capabilities inside GTM Studio, from how customers build and query audiences to how AI enriches and acts on that data.

Bridge data and applications. Bring together data across the entire customer data ecosystem — ZoomInfo's own data assets plus the broader revenue tech stack our customers already run on. Champion the discipline of data operators: people who understand that good go-to-market systems live or die on the quality, freshness, and structure of the data underneath them.

Partner with sophisticated solutions architects and customers. Work hands-on with our most technical solutions teams and our most demanding customers to design and ship a go-to-market orchestration tool built for revenue operators, not just casual users.

Bring deep revenue tech stack fluency. Maintain strong working knowledge of the revenue tech stack — CRM, marketing automation, sales enablement, sales engagement, and everything in between — and use that knowledge to design integrations and workflows that fit how revenue teams actually operate. Maintain a sharp, current view of the competitive landscape (including Clay and adjacent players) so GTM Studio's roadmap is built to win, not just to ship.

Understand revenue tech systems and the role of data within them. Bring real acumen about how data flows through revenue systems, and use that understanding to prioritize the features that matter most to teams trying to scale — including the sales leaders who are ultimately accountable for a number.

Drive cross-functional execution. Act as the hub connecting data, engineering, AI platform, design, solutions, and web application teams to launch products for revenue operators — translating between technical constraints and GTM outcomes and keeping every team pointed at the same roadmap.

Communicate strategically. Represent the roadmap and its rationale clearly across product and engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders throughout the organization.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally at high-growth B2B SaaS companies
  • Direct, hands-on experience building or implementing go-to-market systems — CRM, marketing automation, sales enablement, or sales engagement platforms — as an operator, not just an observer
  • A track record of shipping in fast, agile environments, with the judgment to balance speed against long-term platform quality
  • Strong technical fluency with data platforms, APIs, and integrations; comfort partnering closely with engineering on complex, data-intensive products
  • Genuine enthusiasm for applied AI — you've used AI-powered tools to solve real GTM problems and have a point of view on where agentic workflows create real leverage versus where they don't
  • Deep empathy for the RevOps, sales, and marketing personas who live inside these systems every day
  • Experience navigating ambiguity and driving alignment across product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to flex between technical depth and executive-level narrative

Who You Are

An applied practitioner. You've built go-to-market products and used real go-to-market tech yourself. You know the difference between a feature that looks good in a slide and one that survives a revenue operator's actual workflow.

A data operator at heart. You understand that enrichment, orchestration, and every downstream AI capability are only as good as the data feeding them — and you treat data quality as a first-class product concern, not an afterthought.

A believer in AI-ready systems. You're excited about what AI orchestration and agentic workflows can unlock for GTM teams, and you know from firsthand experience what it actually takes to make AI work reliably in production — not just in a demo.

A builder of bridges. You move comfortably between data teams, engineers, AI platform teams, and the field — translating what customers need into what gets built, and back again.

ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller.

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

  • Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
  • AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
  • 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)

  • 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year

phData is seeking an AI Governance Leader to join our Advisory team. You'll help enterprise clients identify AI governance gaps and design scalable, responsible governance programs that balance value realization and risk management. You'll partner with senior leadership to build frameworks, policies, and operating models, while shaping how AI governance is positioned as a core component of phData's Intelligence Platform strategy.

Core Responsibilities

Client Delivery & Execution

  • Lead AI ecosystem assessments; identify maturity gaps and design tailored governance frameworks (principles, policies, decision-rights) aligned to client's industry, regulatory environment, and AI enablement vision
  • Own multi-workstream engagements; drive executive alignment and multi-year governance roadmaps connected to AI strategy and value realization
  • Define governance evaluation and approval processes for AI tools and use cases: risk tiers, scoring methodology, and control expectations by risk tier
  • Develop AI governance operating model blueprints: governing bodies, roles, RACIs, and interaction models across Technology, Product, InfoSec, Risk, and Legal
  • Define and operationalize AI FinOps guardrails, including: spend visibility, budget thresholds, usage policies, platform/tool approval, license rationalization, and TCO decisions integrated into the broader governance model
  • Facilitate executive and working sessions to align stakeholders and drive decisions
  • Define governance metrics and dashboards tracking value, cost, risk exposure, control coverage, and governance effectiveness
  • Recommend third-party AI governance tools; collaborate with engineering teams to ensure implementability on modern data & AI platforms
  • Shape and close strategic opportunities in partnership with sales: value propositions, solution approaches, and delivery models
  • Represent phData externally as a thought leader on AI governance at conferences, webinars, and partner events

Client Leadership & Account Growth

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to day-to-day client sponsors and senior stakeholders, owning relationships, aligning on delivery roadmaps, and surfacing expansion opportunities
  • Partner with executive sponsors, data and analytics leaders, product and delivery teams, and business end users to ensure seamless execution and measurable outcomes
  • Build cross-practice relationships (Data Engineering, Analytics, AI/ML, Advisory) to design and deliver end-to-end solutions that drive customer success

Thought Leadership & Practice Development

  • Contribute to phData's AI Governance, Operating Model, and FinOps offerings: methods, templates, accelerators, and client-ready collateral
  • Support sales pursuits, webinars, and thought leadership focused on AI governance
  • Mentor consultants and senior consultants

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in AI/Data ecosystem assessment, multi-stakeholder program leadership, and advising senior executives on AI or data governance
  • Demonstrated experience designing governance frameworks: risk tiering, model risk management, platform/tool approval processes
  • Operating model design experience: roles, RACIs, governance bodies for data, analytics, or AI organizations
  • Strong understanding of AI/GenAI concepts including model types, agentic workflows, and enterprise use cases
  • Familiarity with AI governance standards: NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001
  • Working knowledge of data platforms and AI ecosystems (Snowflake, AWS, Claude, etc.) and how governance is implemented in practice
  • Proven consulting delivery skills: problem framing, hypothesis-driven analysis, compelling executive-ready deliverables
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills; ability to translate complex governance concepts for business audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and build cross-functional consensus
  • Bachelor's degree; ability to travel as required by client commitments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience standing up AI governance committees, steering committees, or review boards — charters, cadences, and decision-rights
  • Hands-on model risk management, responsible AI, or regulated-industry compliance experience (financial services, healthcare, or public sector)
  • Prior consulting experience at a data/AI firm or within a central AI/ML office or analytics function
  • Public thought leadership contributions on AI governance
  • Advanced degree or relevant professional certifications

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo's Strategic Sourcing and Purchasing team is a collaborative and innovative group responsible for sourcing Waymo's infrastructure needs and indirect services by providing business insight through robust RFPs and a best in class procure to pay structure. We handle all processes and supplier development strategies: from contracts, RFPs, robust analytics, negotiations, purchasing, and process optimization. We collaborate actively with Waymo's DTS (IT), Marketing, Legal, Finance, Policy, Engineering, G&A, and Product teams as well as external suppliers to make sure Waymo is receiving best in class services at best in class industry pricing.

In this remote role, you will report into our Head of Partner Audit.

You will:

  • Oversee the enterprise audit activities related to partner continued conformity with Waymo's partner standards
  • Review audits of partners to assess their adherence to agreements, legal requirements, and ethical guidelines.
  • Collaborate with partners to address compliance or conformance issues and implement corrective action plans.
  • Follow up on audit findings to ensure implementation of corrective actions and Waymo SME sign-off
  • Provide guidance to partners on conformance with best practices and regulatory changes.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership about partner remediation performance

You have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Safety, or a related field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5 years experience in compliance, auditing, or a related role
  • Strong knowledge of auditing principles, practices, and standards
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills

  • Professional certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or other similar certifications

  • Experience conducting internal, vendor, and partner audits
  • Experience in project management
