US Citizen

Responsibilities

I2X Technologies is a reputable technology services company to the Federal Government. Whether the focus is on space exploration, national security, cyber security, or cutting-edge engineering applications, I2X is ready to offer you the chance to make a real-world impact in your field and for your country. We provide long-term growth and development. Headquartered in Colorado, I2X is engaged in programs across the country and in more than 20 states. Our programs support multiple Federal agencies, the Department of Defense and often focused on the space initiatives of our government customers.

I2X Technologies is seeking an External Audit Consultant to support ongoing activities for a customer in Washington, DC. This position will be fully remote with the option to periodically work on-site if desired.

  • Experience with cloud and on-premis applications desirable. • Simultaneously works on several complex assignments requiring analysis of intricately related complex variables. • Experience with leading and successfully developing audit and security related system documentation and requirements desired. • Must have at least ten years of progressively responsible experience in the information technology arena as an IT auditor, IT security analyst, IT manager, business analyst, system administrator or a combination of these. • Possess clear, concise, and effective verbal and written communication and project management skills needed for functioning in an unstructured matrix management environment. • Experience with assessing financial systems leveraging NIST 800 series, or FISMA Compliance strongly desired. • CISSP or CISA certification strongly desired.

Participates in the process to evaluate, develop, maintain, and update the technology compliance program. Advises the technology support officer and technology managers on compliance, information security, and internal controls. • Prepares the technology departments for the yearly FISMA audits. • Assist in developing required documents in support of internal FISMA reviews. • Develop solutions with team members to minimize vulnerabilities. • Advises the technology officer of compliance issues and recommends solutions • Provides a weekly status report to the COR documenting concerns, issues, risks, and progress. • Recommends and helps implement automated solutions in the areas of compliance, auditing, and vulnerability detection for the branch. • Designs, tests, and implements audit mechanisms to detect non-compliance and to support evaluations of evidentiary materials. Ensures proper audit trails are recorded. • Creates audit and monitoring reports used by the team, as directed.

Qualifications

The External Audit Consultant shall deliver, but not limited to, the following:

  • Thoroughly assess and validate the audit findings for identified systems of record against Board policies. Document findings and recommendations. • Crosswalk the evidence and latest Board Information Security Program (BISP) against the CISA and FedRamp standards and procedures and document the results. • Provide recommendations, develop action plans, and help implement capabilities to improve compliance and security practices. • Document updates to compliance related policies, processes, procedures, and/or standards as directed.

US Citizenship is required.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will regularly sit, walk, stand and climb stairs and steps. May require walking long distance from parking to work station. Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking an elite Product Sales Specialist to champion our Storage & Analysis product lines, the newest, most technically differentiated products in Cribl’s portfolio. Elite here means something specific: you don’t need a playbook handed to you, you write it. A successful Product Sales Specialist at Cribl thrives in white space, creating demand where none exists, developing messaging from first principles, and earning credibility with technical practitioners and executive buyers alike. You will own the full motion from pipeline creation through close, partner closely with Regional Sales Managers to drive deals forward, and provide the product and go-to-market insights that shape how we take these products to market. This role is ideal for elite overlay sellers, top-performing Solutions Engineers ready to make the leap into a sales role, or early-stage sellers who have built motions from scratch and want to do it again at a company defining a category.

If you're ready to join a team that's redefining what it means to be a true Data Engine for IT and Security, this is your moment. This position will cover the Western United States, so we're looking for someone who lives local to the territory.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Develop a business plan to exceed sales goals alongside the CEO and cross-functional partners including dedicated Storage & Analysis Solution Engineers
  • Engage with Regional Sales Managers on qualified opportunities, actively collaborating with them on account, close, and success plans
  • Work cross-functionally to develop and implement tactics and strategies to grow Cribl’s Storage & Analysis business, including influencing the product roadmap to meet customer requirements
  • Manage and maintain the entire sales ecosystem from generating leads through closing
  • Help customers understand the value of Cribl’s Storage & Analysis products during the sales process
  • Articulate our value proposition up and down the organization, from engineer up to CxO
  • Forecast predictably and hit sales targets within the Storage & Analysis product lines
  • Travel across the US in the range of 25-35%
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 5+ years of Enterprise/Strategic sales or pre-sales experience in Security (SIEM & Observability) or IT infrastructure, including direct sellers, overlay specialists, or Solutions Engineers ready to transition into a closing role
  • Experience working with at least one earlier stage start-up organization <1,000 employees or has demonstrated entrepreneurial skills throughout their career
  • A demonstrated ability to successfully land large upsell & cross-sell / expansion deals and run complex sales process
  • Experience selling through a channel-led motion
  • Comfortable operating without a playbook. You’ve built pipeline and messaging in greenfield territory and know how to create demand for un-budgeted, emerging solutions
  • Background using MEDDIC

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

$150,000—$175,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. raw.description:
About LastPass
LastPass delivers Secure Access Essentials, helping individuals and organizations manage and protect access to AI, applications, and credentials straight from the browser. Trusted by more than 100,000 businesses and millions of users worldwide, LastPass blends strong security with everyday simplicity. From discovering unapproved AI and applications to reducing login friction and securing credentials across the business, LastPass delivers on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected as their environments evolve.

Curious about our products? Visit our website and try it free!

We welcome new ideas, support your growth, and recognize your value, if this aligns with what you are looking for in your next career move, Join Us!

LastPass is looking for a Product Marketing Manager:

In this role, you will own positioning, messaging, and field enablement, helping LastPass deliver on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected. As a staff-level Product Marketing Manager, you will also shape go-to-market strategy across our product portfolio.

About the team:

The Product Marketing team at LastPass sits at the intersection of product, sales, and brand — translating complex security and identity capabilities into clear, compelling narratives that move markets. We are a collaborative, curious group that moves quickly, sweats the details, and believes great marketing starts with a deep understanding of the customer.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

Who will you work with?

You will work closely with Product Management to shape positioning and launch strategy, with Sales Enablement to ensure the field is equipped to win, and with Brand and Creative to bring campaigns to life. You will also partner with Business Operations to track performance and inform how we prioritize marketing investment.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Define and own the positioning and messaging framework for LastPass products, ensuring clarity and differentiation across customer segments and channels
  • Lead go-to-market planning for product launches, coordinating with Product, Sales, and Brand to drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact
  • Develop sales enablement materials — including battle cards, pitch decks, and competitive intelligence — that equip the field to engage buyers and win competitive deals
  • Partner with Brand and Creative to produce compelling content — case studies, thought leadership, and web copy — that supports demand generation and strengthens brand authority
  • Conduct customer and market research to surface insights that sharpen product positioning and influence roadmap prioritization
  • Use data-driven insights to refine product marketing strategy and demonstrate contribution to pipeline and growth

What does it take to work at LastPass?

  • Proven experience in product marketing, with a track record of owning end-to-end go-to-market strategies for B2B SaaS or technology products
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling messaging that resonates with both technical buyers and business decision-makers
  • Strong analytical background, with proven experience using data and market research to inform positioning decisions and measure program effectiveness
  • Proven experience working cross-functionally, influencing stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Brand without direct authority
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, staying organised and delivering quality work under tight deadlines

It's great, but not required:

  • Background in cybersecurity, identity, or access management — familiarity with the security landscape would accelerate time-to-impact in this role
  • Experience with competitive intelligence platforms or win/loss analysis programs, with the ability to translate findings into actionable field guidance

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

$131,200—$150,000 USD

  • The leader in secure access
  • High-growth, collaborative environment with inclusive teams
  • Remote-first culture
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible Paid Time Off policies, including but not limited to: Quarterly Self-Care Days (4 extra paid days off annually) and Volunteer Days
  • Parental leave
  • Comprehensive health coverage, including dependents
  • Home office setup support
  • LastPass Families free account for up to 5 members
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including an annual learning stipend to invest in your growth
  • Peer-to-peer recognition through Motivosity
  • Employee Assistance Program for well-being support
  • Remote work stipend to support your home office needs

raw.title: Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product​
raw.excerpt: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!
raw.description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Why this role matters:

BSS Engineering and Product is a critical enabler of Vonage's commercial platform, ensuring our business support systems are scalable, reliable, commercially aligned, and able to support growth across products, regions, and customer segments. As Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product, you will lead the global BSS function across engineering ownership, product direction, platform strategy, and delivery for billing, rating, provisioning, ordering, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations.

Your key responsibilities:

BSS Engineering Leadership

  • Lead the global BSS engineering organization, owning architecture, delivery, quality, resilience, technical standards, and platform performance across core BSS systems
  • Define engineering practices across solution design, integration, release management, test automation, observability, and technical debt management
  • Ensure BSS platforms support scale, availability, security, compliance, and the needs of a multi-product, multi-region commercial model.

BSS Product Ownership & Roadmap

  • Own the BSS product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing capabilities against commercial, customer, operational, regulatory, and finance needs
  • Translate business requirements into a clear product backlog across billing, rating, mediation, ordering, CPQ, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations
  • Establish governance, prioritization forums, success measures, and communication rhythms, including the use of AI-enabled insight and automation to improve delivery, decision-making, and platform optimisation.

Team Leadership & Operating Cadence

  • Lead and develop a global BSS Engineering and Product team, including engineering managers, product owners, platform leads, architects, and delivery specialists
  • Run an effective operating cadence across roadmap planning, delivery governance, platform health, stakeholder prioritisation, risk management, and product delivery progress
  • Build organisational capability through hiring, succession planning, team structure design, globally distributed delivery, and practical AI enablement across engineering and product ways of working.

What you'll bring:

Required:

  • Senior BSS engineering and product leadership experience in global telecommunications, CPaaS, cloud communications, or enterprise SaaS
  • Deep BSS domain expertise, including platforms such as Amdocs, Oracle Communications, CSGi, NetCracker, Zuora, Optiva, Salesforce CPQ, or equivalent
  • Experience leading BSS platform delivery, including migrations, integrations, data improvement, release planning, and API-led or cloud-native architectures where appropriate
  • Strong product ownership capability, with experience translating commercial, finance, regulatory, operational, and customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes
  • Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, product, architecture, and delivery teams in a matrixed environment, with a track record of using AI, automation, or data-driven tooling to improve productivity, quality, and platform outcomes.

Experience we consider a plus:

  • Experience in CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or Tier 1/Tier 2 telecommunications
  • Experience with API monetisation, partner billing, usage-based charging, subscription management, or digital self-service.

How you'll benefit

  • Private Medical Insurance: Adeslas
  • Group Pension Plan: Generali
  • Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident: VidaCaixa
  • Ericsson Care Line
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)/Hourly Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process.

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

raw.description:
About Us:

Live experiences help people cross today’s digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that’s bringing us together. To fulfill Gametime’s mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.
With platforms on iOS, Android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the US and Canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.

The Role

Gametime's Payments & Checkout team owns everything that happens between ticket selection and a completed transaction — checkout flow, payment methods, vendor relationships, and the infrastructure behind every dollar we process. This PM will own the roadmap for growing conversion and authorization performance while managing fraud exposure and the economics of how we accept payments, partnering closely with our BNPL, processing, and wallet vendors to expand what we offer fans and merchants alike.

This role is open to various levels/ titles — Senior Product Manager, Staff Product Manager, or Principal Product Manager — we're hiring for the right person and scope, not a fixed level.

What You'll Own

  • Checkout conversion: identify and eliminate friction across the payment flow, and run experimentation to lift completion rates
  • Payment authorization rates: partner with processors and networks to reduce declines and recover failed transactions
  • BNPL adoption: grow usage and expand the mix of buy-now-pay-later and alternative payment methods offered at checkout
  • Fraud and risk trade-offs: balance conversion growth against fraud exposure, working with risk tooling and rules to protect margin without adding friction
  • Vendor strategy: manage and evaluate payment processors, BNPL providers, and wallet partners to improve terms, performance, and total cost of acceptance
  • Cost of payments: drive down the blended cost of accepting transactions as volume and AOV grow
  • A roadmap tied directly to transaction growth, AOV, and payments cost efficiency

What We're Looking For

Common bar:

  • A track record of shipping product changes that moved measurable business outcomes
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills — you'll work closely with engineering, design, and data day-to-day
  • Comfort operating at whatever level you're hired into, from hands-on execution to setting multi-quarter strategy

Domain-specific:

  • Experience owning payments, checkout, or fraud/risk in a consumer marketplace, fintech, or high-volume e-commerce environment
  • Familiarity with the mechanics of authorization, processing, and payment routing, and how they connect to conversion and cost
  • Experience managing vendor and processor relationships, including negotiating terms and evaluating new partners
  • A data-driven approach — comfort working with SQL/analytics to diagnose funnel and payment performance issues

At Gametime pay ranges are subject to change and assigned to a job based on specific market median of similar jobs according to 3rd party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary for several reasons including skills/capabilities, experience, and available budget.

MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

MinIO's Events Specialist supports execution across Marquee, Trade Show, Regional, and Community events, including logistics, on-site operations, and post-event reporting. It's an entry-level role with broad exposure to event marketing, working directly with the Director of Field Marketing & Events. A strong fit for a recent graduate who's detail-oriented, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to learn by doing.

What You Will Do:

  • Coordinate logistics and vendors for US trade shows and marquee events, including booth build, shipping, and on-site setup/teardown
  • Build and manage on-site staffing schedules and shift coverage for US event presence
  • Run lead and badge-scan operations at events
  • Set up and manage post-event follow-up flows (email sequences, SFDC lead routing)
  • Draft first-pass post-event reports against the standardized reporting format
  • Support logistics for US regional events, including executive dinners, happy hours, and local activations (venue sourcing, catering, invite/RSVP management)
  • Support Community/Developer event logistics in the US (meetups, local developer events)
  • Track event budgets against actuals and flag discrepancies
  • Provide general administrative support to the Director of Field Marketing & Events, including scheduling, vendor invoicing, and calendar maintenance

Your Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 0-2 years of professional experience; an internship or coursework in events, marketing, or hospitality is a plus
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable juggling multiple deadlines and vendors at once
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Willing to travel (approximately 25%, depending on event calendar)

What We Offer:

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • 401K with 3% Contribution
  • Pre-IPO Stock Options
  • At least 12 Public Holidays
  • Flexible Time Off
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

raw.title: Senior AI Engineer | Canada | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from Canada. Residents of Quebec are not eligible for this role.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is seeking a Staff Engineer (AI & Automation) to own the AI agent infrastructure and automation platform that powers our Marketing Operations organization. You’ll build multi-agent architectures, LLM integrations, and backend services that connect AI models to internal and third-party data platforms. You’ll ship production systems that teams depend on daily.

This is a high-autonomy role where you own the technical direction. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems across Marketing, RevOps, and SDR teams, design the solutions, and ship them. You’ll define the technical direction for the automation platform (data models, API contracts, shared libraries, reference architectures) and partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, and Field Operations to build scalable, self-service automation that eliminates manual work and drives operational efficiency.

What You'll Be Doing

Agentic Systems & AI Infrastructure

  • Own end-to-end development of multi-agent AI systems, from architecture and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing operation
  • Build modular, composable agentic systems using orchestration frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, Anthropic MCP, or similar) that operate 24/7 across teams
  • Develop reusable agentic skills that agents invoke across interfaces (Slack, dashboards, internal apps, CLIs)
  • Implement observability and feedback loops including logging, performance metrics, prompt iteration, model evaluation, and cost management
  • Establish governance and compliance standards for AI workflows including access controls, audit trails, PII handling, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths

Systems Integration & Backend Services

  • Build MCP servers, APIs, CLIs, and microservices connecting AI models to business systems (BigQuery, Slack, CRMs, email, calendars, analytics tools)
  • Architect data flows for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), connecting LLMs to internal knowledge bases, customer data, and real-time business context
  • Build serverless or containerized services (GCP Cloud Functions, Cloud Run) that scale with usage and integrate with Grafana's cloud infrastructure

Automation & Workflow Enablement

  • Partner with RevOps, Demand Generation, Regional Marketing, and SDR teams to scope high-impact automation problems, identify bottlenecks, and build solutions with measurable business outcomes
  • Design and deploy workflows using orchestration tools (n8n, Workato, or custom platforms) with CI/CD, testing, and production reliability standards
  • Build systems designed for self-service with documentation, playbooks, and enablement materials that let partner teams operate independently

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You'll have access to AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and others of your choice within security guidelines). We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with depth in backend development, systems integration, or data/analytics engineering
  • 2+ years hands-on experience applying LLMs/AI to production workflows, not just prototypes
  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/Node.js with Git-based workflows, code review practices, and testing discipline
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks and patterns including prompt engineering, RAG, function calling/tool use, structured output parsing, and evaluation
  • Experience building and operating multi-agent systems at scale including agent decomposition, orchestration patterns (sequential chains, router/dispatcher, parallel fan-out), state management, and production monitoring
  • You diagnose business problems before writing code. You think in workflows and outcomes, not just functions.
  • Deep familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and serverless/containerized services (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run)
  • Understanding of LLM failure modes and production mitigations including confidence thresholds, fallback logic, human escalation, and cost/latency management
  • Proven ability to identify high-leverage problems, push back on low-impact requests, and deliver end-to-end with minimal direction
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code). You use AI to build AI systems
  • Clear technical communicator who can explain complex systems in simple terms to both engineers and business stakeholders

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vector databases or retrieval pipelines (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant, pgvector)
  • Familiarity with marketing or sales platforms (Salesforce, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach)
  • Experience with frontend frameworks (React, Slack Block Kit) for building user-facing AI tool interfaces
  • Observability tooling for AI systems (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, custom evaluation frameworks)
  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms (n8n, Temporal, Prefect, Airflow)
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to data sources
  • Prior work automating marketing, sales, or customer success workflows in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Active in open-source communities. Grafana is built on OSS and we value engineers who share that DNA

In Canada, the base compensation range for this role is CAD 164,490- CAD 197,389. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.excerpt: Position Overviewdormakaba is seeking a Product Manager IV (Senior Product Manager) based in Indianapolis, IN or remotely.
raw.description:
Position Overview

dormakaba is seeking a Product Manager IV (Senior Product Manager) based in Indianapolis, IN or remotely. The Product Manager IV (Senior Product Manager) will lead the global strategy, roadmap, and portfolio management for dormakaba’s PACS Readers & Credentials business, driving portfolio growth, technology evolution, and market competitiveness across hardware, mobile access, and credential management solutions. This role owns the end-to-end product portfolio across the Farpointe, dormakaba, and OEM/private-label brands, serving diverse customer segments and access control deployments across North America, Europe, and the rest of the world. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations, the Product Manager will translate market needs and business objectives into product strategies and roadmaps that strengthen market position, support innovation, and maximize portfolio performance throughout the product lifecycle.

HIRING SALARY RANGE: Base Salary $120,000 - $150,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) Plus an annual bonus. Please visit our career site for more information on benefits.

What you will do
  • Define and execute the global strategy for the PACS Readers & Credentials portfolio across Farpointe, dormakaba, and OEM/private-label brands, identifying market opportunities, emerging technologies, customer segments, and growth opportunities across hardware, mobile access, and credential management solutions
  • Develop and prioritize product roadmaps, investments, features, and timelines based on market trends, customer needs, technology evolution, and business objectives. Translate requirements into differentiated product solutions that strengthen competitiveness across global markets
  • Lead alignment across Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, manage dependencies, and deliver portfolio objectives throughout the product lifecycle
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to plan product launches, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market readiness. Monitor key performance indicators, revenue growth, market competitiveness, and profitability to maximize portfolio performance
  • Optimize the end-to-end portfolio of access readers, physical and mobile credentials, digital wallet solutions, and credential issuance and cloud-based management services. Manage product introductions, enhancements, and phase-outs to reduce complexity, maintain profitability, and ensure alignment with evolving market needs

What we require
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience in product management or a related function, with experience in product strategy, roadmap development, and portfolio management
  • Ability to identify market opportunities, analyze customer needs and competitive trends, prioritize product investments, and drive business growth and profitability
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align and influence cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to translate complex product and technology concepts into clear requirements, product positioning, and go-to-market strategies

What we prefer
  • Strong understanding of access control technologies, including PACS readers, RFID/smart cards, mobile credentials, digital wallets, and credential management solutions, with the ability to translate market and customer needs into product requirements
  • Experience working with international and culturally diverse teams

What we offer
  • Taking Care of our Employees on Day One with Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance coverage options. No waiting periods!
  • Your health is our priority, we offer Medical Wellness Programs to aid in your well-being
  • Vacation and Personal Time Off
  • We support your growing family; we provide Parental Leave for Moms and Dads!
  • Wisely plan for your future with our 401k Matching plan beginning on Day One
  • Supporting your career development with our Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Robust culture supporting internal advancement with our Learn and Grow Program
  • 24/7 access to over 15,000 LinkedIn Learning courses to assist in your professional development and to expand on your individual interests.
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Voluntary Legal Insurance
  • Unlimited Referral Reward Bonuses
  • Corporate Discounts for shopping, travel and more!

Who we are

We are at the heart of every place that matters. From automatic doors to cloud-based access management – as a leading global provider in the access solutions market for schools, banks, airports, hospitals, hotels, and many more, we enable seamless movement within secure, safe, and sustainable places. With over 160 years of experience and a focus on excellence and innovation, we offer exciting opportunities to grow in an environment where you can make a real impact. At dormakaba, you are encouraged to take initiative, develop your skills, and build your career alongside 16,000 experts worldwide who are setting industry standards every day.

Work in a place where you matter – apply now!

Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success.

As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best.

Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences.

You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales.

  • Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives
  • Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team
  • Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations
  • Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements
  • Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users
  • A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them
  • Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind
  • Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space
  • Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity
  • Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain
  • Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring
  • Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact

When you apply, please:

  • Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective.

  • Own end-to-end development of multi-agent AI systems, from architecture and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing operation
  • Build modular, composable agentic systems using orchestration frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, Anthropic MCP, or similar) that operate 24/7 across teams
  • Develop reusable agentic skills that agents invoke across interfaces (Slack, dashboards, internal apps, CLIs)
  • Implement observability and feedback loops including logging, performance metrics, prompt iteration, model evaluation, and cost management
  • Establish governance and compliance standards for AI workflows including access controls, audit trails, PII handling, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths

Systems Integration & Backend Services

  • Build MCP servers, APIs, CLIs, and microservices connecting AI models to business systems (BigQuery, Slack, CRMs, email, calendars, analytics tools)
  • Architect data flows for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), connecting LLMs to internal knowledge bases, customer data, and real-time business context
  • Build serverless or containerized services (GCP Cloud Functions, Cloud Run) that scale with usage and integrate with Grafana's cloud infrastructure

Automation & Workflow Enablement

  • Partner with RevOps, Demand Generation, Regional Marketing, and SDR teams to scope high-impact automation problems, identify bottlenecks, and build solutions with measurable business outcomes
  • Design and deploy workflows using orchestration tools (n8n, Workato, or custom platforms) with CI/CD, testing, and production reliability standards
  • Build systems designed for self-service with documentation, playbooks, and enablement materials that let partner teams operate independently

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You'll have access to AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and others of your choice within security guidelines). We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with depth in backend development, systems integration, or data/analytics engineering
  • 2+ years hands-on experience applying LLMs/AI to production workflows, not just prototypes
  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/Node.js with Git-based workflows, code review practices, and testing discipline
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks and patterns including prompt engineering, RAG, function calling/tool use, structured output parsing, and evaluation
  • Experience building and operating multi-agent systems at scale including agent decomposition, orchestration patterns (sequential chains, router/dispatcher, parallel fan-out), state management, and production monitoring
  • You diagnose business problems before writing code. You think in workflows and outcomes, not just functions.
  • Deep familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and serverless/containerized services (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run)
  • Understanding of LLM failure modes and production mitigations including confidence thresholds, fallback logic, human escalation, and cost/latency management
  • Proven ability to identify high-leverage problems, push back on low-impact requests, and deliver end-to-end with minimal direction
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code). You use AI to build AI systems
  • Clear technical communicator who can explain complex systems in simple terms to both engineers and business stakeholders

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vector databases or retrieval pipelines (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant, pgvector)
  • Familiarity with marketing or sales platforms (Salesforce, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach)
  • Experience with frontend frameworks (React, Slack Block Kit) for building user-facing AI tool interfaces
  • Observability tooling for AI systems (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, custom evaluation frameworks)
  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms (n8n, Temporal, Prefect, Airflow)
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to data sources
  • Prior work automating marketing, sales, or customer success workflows in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Active in open-source communities. Grafana is built on OSS and we value engineers who share that DNA

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the US and Canada (East Coast US/Canada preferred, open to other time zones for exceptional candidates).

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success.

As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best.

Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences.

You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user
  • Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity
  • Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives
  • Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team

  • A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them

raw.description:
The SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating cloud-delivered networking and security solutions that enable secure, high-performance connectivity for distributed users, devices, and applications. This role combines traditional networking expertise with modern cloud security capabilities, leveraging industry-leading SASE/SSE platforms to deliver Zero Trust architecture across hybrid and multi-cloud environments

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Design and deploy SASE and SSE solutions including CASB, SWG, ZTNA, and related capabilities.
  • Architect secure access solutions across cloud, internet, and private environments.
  • Integrate SASE with SD-WAN, identity providers, and cloud platforms.
  • Configure and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, routing, VPNs, and cloud connectivity.
  • Implement and enforce network security policies and threat protection.
  • Administer and support the organization’s SASE platform including policies, traffic steering, SSL inspection, and client deployment.
  • Monitor performance and analyze logs to troubleshoot and optimize security posture.
  • Support integrations with IAM, SIEM, and endpoint security tools.
  • Develop automation scripts and maintain documentation.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE ROLE:

  • 5+ years in network engineering, cloud security, or cybersecurity.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise SSE/SASE platforms (e.g., Netskope, Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of SASE and Zero Trust principles.
  • Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPNs).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Familiarity with multi-vendor SASE and security tools.
  • Experience with monitoring and SIEM tools.

PREFERRED SKILLS:

  • SASE/SSE vendor certifications (e.g., Zscaler ZDTA, Palo Alto PCNSE, or equivalent).
  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies.
  • Familiarity with enterprise firewall and perimeter security solutions
  • Knowledge of DLP programs and data classification.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust frameworks

OTHER SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Self-starter with strong organizational skills, ability to multitask and attention to detail
  • Proven ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Strong troubleshooting across networking and security.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally.
  • Experience in large enterprise environments.
  • Continuous learning mindset aligned with SASE and cloud trends.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

raw.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
raw.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on the member-facing programs that introduce people to our life-changing care. Your top priority will be architecting the end-to-end service journey—from the moment a member is introduced to our offering through their complete onboarding. You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Twin HQ is in Menlo Park, California, but this role is open to remote applicants in the US.

We are seeking a designer whose exceptional visual craft is matched only by their deep, rigorous service design thinking. You are a strategic systems-builder who brings order to ambiguity. You aren't just designing screens; you are designing holistic, deeply considered omnichannel experiences that balance premium, persuasive aesthetics with the logistical complexities of physical hardware and digital healthcare.

Responsibilities

  • Define Personas & Value Propositions: Identify and construct distinct user personas based on direct research insights. Uncover the specific barriers and core value propositions that resonate most powerfully with each persona, ensuring we speak directly to their unique needs.
  • Architect Persona-Driven Journeys: Take the lead on multiple programs by mapping out tailored end-to-end enrollment flows. Design targeted experiences centered around the established value propositions of your personas to create a seamless, persuasive transition from initial program discovery to active participation.
  • Drive Comprehensive Service Design: Look beyond isolated digital features to own the entire physical and digital ecosystem. Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.
  • Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.
  • Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Service & Visual Design Mastery: 8+ years of UX/product design experience. Your portfolio must be a masterclass in both high-end visual polish (consumer-facing or marketing-led design) and complex, multi-touchpoint journey mapping, showcasing how you connect digital and physical interactions.
  • Research & Strategy Expertise: Proven experience conducting user research, defining actionable personas, and successfully translating those strategic insights into tailored, high-converting product flows.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.
  • Omnichannel Agility: Deep expertise spanning responsive web and native mobile design patterns. You confidently navigate the constraints of different platforms and know how to bridge the gap between UI flows and real-world actions (like connecting Bluetooth sensors).
  • Systems & Logistics Literacy: Experience designing for hardware-software integrations or complex logistical workflows (e.g., shipping tracking, appointment routing) is a distinct advantage. You can communicate clearly with engineering regarding technical capabilities and data flows.
  • Communication: Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. You can pitch a concept, defend a complex product decision, and write the persuasive, engaging UI copy needed to speak to different personas, drive enrollment, and reduce drop-off.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in design, service design, HCI, or a related field.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $190,000 - $210,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan

US Salary Range
$190,000—$210,000 USD

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Associateto join our Human Resources Team! This individual will report into our Talent Acquisition Team Lead and will own full-cycle recruitment for assigned entry- and mid-level roles, supporting the hiring process from intake through offer and start. This includes sourcing, screening, and interviewing candidates, coordinating each stage of the hiring process, and maintaining accurate candidate records to support SupplyHouse’s talent acquisition goals. If you’re passionate about connecting people with the right opportunities, enjoy building relationships, and are excited to create a positive experience for candidates and hiring teams, we’d love to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

Role Type: Full-Time, Non-Exempt

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $45,514 to $56,892 within a full position range of $45,514 to $68,271 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline of qualified candidates using Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Handshake, university relationships, networking, AI-assisted sourcing tools, and other tools available to attract top talent
  • Review applications and resumes, using AI-assisted screening tools as a first-pass filter within established company guardrails, while always applying independent human judgment before advancing or eliminating any candidate
  • Conduct interviews via Zoom and complete detailed, thoughtful interview scorecards and evaluations
  • Schedule and coordinate interviews, hiring events, and walk-in interview days as needed, to ensure a smooth, organized experience for both candidates and hiring managers
  • Administer technical, creative, and personality assessments, as well as background checks, as needed or requested, to support hiring decisions
  • Partner with hiring managers from intake through offer, and own candidate communication throughout the process by providing timely status updates, follow-ups, and respectful rejections
  • Handle sensitive information with the utmost confidentiality and care, including performance insights, offers, negotiations, and disqualifications
  • Maintain organized, up-to-date, audit-ready candidate records; apply consistent, compliant evaluation criteria and candidate data privacy practices, in line with EEO, work authorization, and pay transparency requirements; and track key recruiting metrics
  • Represent SupplyHouse and promote its culture at university career fairs and other recruitment events
  • Stay informed on recruitment trends, job boards, salary data, and AI-assisted recruiting tools to help the team remain competitive

  • Complete reference checks and support the offer process, including offer preparation, internal approvals, and handoff to HR for pre-boarding and onboarding
  • Support the Talent Acquisition Team Lead and Manager with additional recruitment tasks and special projects as needed
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition Team Lead during job kick-off and recurring regroup meetings to understand requisition needs and hiring manager expectations
  • Track and report recruiting metrics, including time-to-fill, funnel conversion, source effectiveness, and pipeline quality, reporting on a regular basis to hiring managers and the broader recruiting team, and consistently meet the recruiting targets set by TA leadership

Requirements:

  • 0-2 years of relevant recruiting or related experience
  • A genuine passion for providing an exceptional candidate experience
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks and adapt to shifting priorities
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-volume, process-driven recruiting environment with high attention to detail
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including meeting facilitation, reference checks, offers, and rejections via Zoom, Slack, email, and phone
  • Proficiency with Zoom, Slack, and MS365, including Microsoft Word and Excel

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field
  • Prior experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, or Recruitment
  • Comfort learning and using AI-assisted recruiting tools (e.g., Greenhouse AI, Claude) within established company guardrails and processes

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
    • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
    • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
    • Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • $750 annual professional development budget
    • $25 monthly Grubhub credit
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We promote work-life balance –We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth –We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

About HumanSignal

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

About the OpportunityWe're looking for graphic design professionals to rate the quality of design work, helping AI models learn what makes a design effective.

Key Details

  • Type: Freelance, project-based opportunity
  • Project length: 6 weeks, with new projects launching regularly
  • Compensation: Paid per accepted task. On this project, you can earn the equivalent of up to $9 per hour, with pay rates varying by country of residence.

What You'll Do

  • Rate design samples for typography, visual hierarchy, design execution, color, layout, and overall polish

Please note: you won’t create your own designs. You’ll rate and edit the samples we provide, following our guidelines.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • Education in design or arts (degree or certificate)
  • 2+ years of experience as a graphic designer, SMM specialist, or marketing professional
  • Strong grasp of composition, color theory, typography, visual hierarchy, and overall design effectiveness
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain focus during repetitive tasks
  • Openness to feedback and recalibration

Nice to have

  • Design review, art direction or QA experience, with the ability to critique design objectively against industry standards
  • Experience with Figma, Sketch, or other modern design tools
  • Prior data annotation or AI training experience

How It Works

  1. Apply
  2. Register on our platform
  3. Confirm your identity
  4. Validate your skills
  5. Start earning on projects

Why Join Us

  • Work from anywhere: fully remote, with just a laptop and a stable internet connection.
  • Set your own schedule: work whenever suits you, alongside your current job, studies, or other commitments.
  • Get paid every week: weekly payouts for the work you deliver.
  • Shape the future of AI: your expertise helps train the AI tools people use every day.
