raw.title: Account Manager
raw.excerpt: Our mission is clear and staggeringly important: we're building the manufacturing operating system of the future from the ground up, one that’s engineered to create network effects as we grow.
raw.description:
Our mission is clear and staggeringly important: we're building the manufacturing operating system of the future from the ground up, one that’s engineered to create network effects as we grow. A beautiful, sophisticated quantum leap forward for the most important core industry in the world.
Manufacturing is important. It’s the fundamental industry on which everything else is built. We take it for granted. In 1989, 35% of the entire software industry was manufacturing systems. What was the first massive burst in productivity from technology has stagnated into diminishing returns and increasing complexity. We can only continue to add complexity for so much longer until the whole system collapses.
"Any intelligent fool can make things bigger and more complex. It takes a touch of genius and a lot of courage to move in the opposite direction." - Albert Einstein

Who you are

    We’re less interested in whether you’ve followed a traditional Account Management career path than whether you’ve developed the capabilities this job requires. Great candidates may come from Account Management, Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, technical sales, or other customer-facing roles. What matters is evidence that you can own sophisticated customer relationships, diagnose difficult problems, learn quickly, and create commercial outcomes.
  • Deeply curious. You don’t take a customer’s description of a problem at face value—you ask questions, dig into how their business actually works, and figure out what’s really happening
  • You enjoy learning how things work, whether that’s a customer’s manufacturing process, a new Fulcrum product, an integration, or a technical problem you’ve never seen before
  • You actively use AI to make yourself more capable and productive, and you’re excited by how quickly tools like Claude Code are expanding what non-engineers can build and solve
  • You have the judgment and presence to navigate complex organizations, competing priorities, frustrated stakeholders, and senior executives
  • You build high-trust relationships without becoming passive. You’re comfortable challenging customers, asking uncomfortable questions, and selling when you believe it’s genuinely in their best interest
  • You create opportunities rather than waiting for customers to tell you what they want to buy
  • You take ownership when things go wrong. You communicate problems early, create a plan, and stay close until they’re resolved
  • You like operating with high velocity and limited structure. Ambiguity makes you curious rather than uncomfortable
  • You’re industrious. You enjoy getting into the details, learning new things, experimenting, and doing work that might fall outside a traditional Account Manager’s job description
  • You’re collaborative, but don’t confuse collaboration with dependency. You know when to bring in an expert and when to become capable enough to handle something yourself

What the job is

    You’ll own a portfolio os Fulcrum customers after implementation, with responsibility for retaining and growing the relationship over time. Doing that well requires much more than managing renewals and running business reviews. You’ll need to understand how your customers actually operate - their people, processes, constraints, politics, and economics - well enough to identify problems and opportunities that may not recognize themselves.

    Fulcrum is increasingly giving customer-facing teams the ability to solve problems that historically required Product, Engineering, or technical specialists. We expect our Account Managers to embrace that. You won’t need to be an engineer, but you should be excited to use AI, data, and new tools to investigate problems, prototype solutions, and make yourself increasingly capable.

    You’ll:
  • Develop a deep understanding of how each customer’s business actually operates, from executive priorities to the workflows of people on the shop floor
  • Ask probing questions, investigate problems, and distinguish symptoms from root causes
  • Build relationships and navigate politics across complex customer organizations rather than relying on a single champion
  • Identify risk early, communicate it internally, and take ownership of creating a path forward before revenue is threatened
  • Create and close expansion opportunities by identifying valuable problems Fulcrum can solve—not simply responding to inbound interest
  • Balance commercial aggressiveness with long-term trust; know when to push, when to challenge, and when selling more would be the wrong decision
  • Use AI and other tools to analyze customer problems, work with data, prototype ideas, automate work, and solve things that might previously have required another team
  • Learn new Fulcrum products deeply enough to confidently teach, demonstrate, troubleshoot, and sell
  • Get hands-on when customers need help rather than reflexively routing problems to Product, Engineering, or Support
  • Lead executive conversations and business reviews that turn operational details into clear business outcomes and decisions
  • Re-engage struggling accounts and stay close to problems until momentum has been restored
  • Manage renewals with no surprises—understand the health, politics, value, and likely commercial outcome of an account well before the renewal date
  • Bring patterns from customers back into Fulcrum so Product, Engineering, Marketing, and GTM can make better decisions
  • Operate effectively without a complete playbook and actively improve the way the AM team works

Who you’ll work with

  • Customers ranging from day-to-day users and operational leaders to owners and executives
  • Launch Managers who onboard customers and transition them into an ongoing partnership
  • Product Managers & Engineers to learn, collaborate on difficult problems, and turn recurring customer needs into better products without treating them as the default owners of your customer’s problems
  • Marketing to surface customer stories, advocacy, referrals, and opportunities to amplify customer success
  • Account Executives who bring new customers into Fulcrum and help establish the foundation for the relationship

Why this role is different

    Account management at Fulcrum isn’t about checking in once a quarter, running a QBR, and routing customer requests to other teams.

    Our customers are manufacturers. Their businesses are complicated, their problems don’t always fit neatly inside software, and the person describing a problem often doesn’t know its root cause. To be great here, you’ll need to become genuinely curious about how shops operate, how people make decisions, and why a process that looks simple from the outside behaves differently on a shop floor.

    You’ll also have capabilities that Account Managers historically haven’t had. AI is making it possible for non-engineers to analyze data, automate workflows, prototype software, and solve increasingly technical customer problems themselves. We want people who are excited by that—not people waiting for someone else to hand them a playbook.

    Sometimes you’ll uncover a problem and turn it into a meaningful expansion. Sometimes you’ll get deep into a workflow because a customer is struggling. Sometimes you’ll teach yourself a new tool, work with data, or prototype something because that’s the fastest way to figure out what’s happening. And sometimes you’ll need to tell a customer—or us—that we’re wrong.

    The job sits intentionally between two competing responsibilities: protect the trust we’ve earned with our customers and use that trust to grow the relationship. Great AMs here don’t maximize one at the expense of the other.

    If you like clearly defined swim lanes, mature processes, and handing technical problems to specialists, this probably won’t be a great fit. If you like understanding complicated businesses, figuring things out yourself, building relationships, solving unfamiliar problems, and turning that work into commercial outcomes, it probably will.

Salary range & benefits

  • $90,000 – $120,000 USD/year + OTE + equity
  • 401(k) matching after 90 days — immediate vesting
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Wellbeing benefits and perks
  • Unlimited vacation policy with required minimums
  • Cell phone & internet plan coverage

    • This role is open to candidates located in the U.S. and authorized to work here. We’re not able to offer visa
    sponsorship or consider international applicants at this time.
The market tells us we’re on the right track: +50% year over year growth but we know to not rest on our laurels and that there's a lot of stuff to build and a huge amount of work to be done. We're looking for people who can stand alongside us and work hard to make our dreams become reality in the fastest, smoothest, and best way possible.
If you're someone who is obsessed with making amazing things, being the best, and wanting your work to contribute to something excellent, please reach out.

Job Title: Director, Global Regulatory Project and Submission Management

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description: The Director, Global Regulatory Project Management (Director, Global RPM) is a senior strategic leader responsible for supporting, influencing, translating, and executing oncology regulatory strategies across the global drug development lifecycle. This role combines deep regulatory expertise with advanced project management and organizational leadership, driving successful NDA/BLA/MAA submissions and ensuring seamless cross-functional integration across regions. The Director, Global RPM proactively anticipates regulatory challenges, influences decisions, and champions process improvements to secure on-time submissions and maintain market access for products worldwide

Essential Functions of the Job:

Strategic Global Leadership

  • Support, translate, and implement global regulatory strategies for development programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term vision across all major regions (US, EU, China, APAC, LATAM, etc.).
  • Serve as a principal advisor to the Global Regulatory Lead (GRL) and Regulatory Regional Leads (RRL), providing strategic regulatory oversight and recommendations for global product development, submissions, and lifecycle management.
  • Integrate functional regulatory expertise with PM knowledge to solve complex problems and make sound decisions for the organization on a global scale.
  • Maintain awareness of global regulatory environments, policy trends, and competitive landscapes, assessing impact and adapting strategies accordingly.

Global Project Management Excellence

  • Lead and manage complex regulatory submissions (IND/CTA, NDA/BLA/MAA) across multiple regions, ensuring compliance with ICH, US, EU, China, and other international requirements.
  • Act as the “COO” to the Global Regulatory Lead, translating strategic regulatory vision into actionable project plans, driving operational execution, and ensuring all cross-functional activities are coordinated and delivered on time.
  • Organize and facilitate cross-functional meetings with global teams to coordinate, plan, and track submission activities, driving accountability and alignment among stakeholders worldwide.
  • Proactively identify risks, propose solutions, and manage critical issues related to global regulatory submissions and strategy.
  • Oversee preparation and submission of documentation to support investigational and marketing registration packages, ensuring timelines and quality standards are met globally.

Cross-Regional Collaboration

  • Build partnerships with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams (clinical, medical, safety, CMC, commercial) across regions to achieve strategic business goals through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
  • Liaise and negotiate with cross-functional teams and regulatory authorities to expedite submission timelines and resolve key regulatory issues in all relevant markets.
  • Mentor, guide, and develop junior and mid-level staff in project planning, regulatory processes, and professional development, fostering a global mindset.

Continuous Improvement

  • Champion process optimization and improvement initiatives within the global regulatory PM function.
  • Lead the development and implementation of regulatory processes and policies, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation across regions.
  • undefined

Key Attributes

Travel:

raw.description:
About the Team

The Professional Services organization at Miro is focused on ensuring our Enterprise customers achieve exceptional outcomes through the Innovation Workspace. Our team of strategic advisors, implementation experts, and forward deployed consultants work side-by-side with customers to transform how they collaborate, build, and innovate—powered by agentic AI and Miro's world-class platform.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Consultant, Manufacturing, you will apply AI solutions to transform and automate the core operating processes of leading industrial enterprises. You will engage directly with C-level executives, help them identify high-impact opportunities, build and test enterprise-grade AI solutions on their own data and systems, and drive measurable business outcomes.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology. You will be paired with an Account Executive against named accounts—hunting for problems worth solving, then proving they can be solved. Generalist FDCs lead client discussions across industries; as the Manufacturing Specialist, you are the dedicated depth they bring in when a pursuit turns on industrial expertise.

What you’ll do

Executive Agenda:

  • Partner with senior executives—COO, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Chief Digital Officer, VP Manufacturing, VP Quality—to define an AI transformation agenda Miro can attach to
  • Lead the initial CxO conversation that creates awareness of what AI makes possible for the business
  • Qualify opportunities before committing to a Validation Sprint: sponsor authority, commitment, and the account's potential to become a multi-year, seven-figure relationship

Validation Sprints:

  • Co-author the Sprint charter with the AE: the business problem, its value, our approach, exit criteria, and the partnership proposal that follows success
  • Run the Sprint end to end—immerse, prioritise, build, read out—developing and testing the solution on the customer's real data and systems
  • Take manufacturing processes apart and rebuild them on AI-first principles across five workflows: new product development and gate review, quality and continuous improvement, portfolio and program management, operations and launch readiness, and process development and transformation
  • Build using Miro's AI Workflows, Prototypes, and Goals, Roadmaps & Delivery capabilities, extended through Miro's API, WebSDK, and MCP integrations into ERP, PLM, MES, and quality systems

Value and Conversion:

  • Turn Sprint outcomes into a business value story, ROI model, and KPI baseline—grounded in metrics the customer already runs on: gate cycle time, requirement coverage at gate, defect recurrence, cost of poor quality, capacity utilisation, on-time launch rate, ramp-to-full-rate time
  • Support executive leadership in delivering the Value Story read-out to the sponsor
  • Co-own with the AE the conversion of Sprint outcomes into the partnership proposal and commercial approach
  • Define the scope of Professional Services involvement post-sale and hand over cleanly
  • Package what you learn and radiate it—internally to Sales, Marketing, and Product, and externally through thought leadership

What you’ll need

  • 8+ years in top-tier consulting, forward deployed engineering, solution consulting, or enterprise transformation, weighted toward manufacturing and industrial environments
  • Deep understanding of manufacturing operating processes: NPI and stage-gate/APQP, engineering change management, quality systems (FMEA, 8D, PPAP), S&OP and production planning, lean and continuous improvement, maintenance and reliability
  • Fluency with the industrial enterprise stack—ERP (SAP or equivalent), PLM (Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE), MES, quality management systems—and where the data lives
  • Credibility with COO, Chief Supply Chain Officer, VP Operations, VP Quality, and Plant General Manager stakeholders
  • Exceptional GenAI skills: Miro, Cursor, Claude Code and Cowork, ChatGPT, Google and Microsoft suites, MCP integrations, prompt and context engineering. You can build working solutions yourself and orchestrate an AI Engineer when the build demands it
  • Ability to build a before/after value story with financial and ROI analysis that survives finance scrutiny
  • A business-problem-first rather than product-first mindset, and the curiosity to take any process apart
  • Comfort in both the boardroom and the plant
  • Self-starter who operates independently and under ambiguity
  • Willing to travel to customer sites up to 40%

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.

About Miro

Miro is a visual workspace for innovation that enables distributed teams of any size to build the next big thing. The platform's infinite canvas enables teams to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more. Miro, co-headquartered in San Francisco and Amsterdam, serves more than 100M users and 250,000 companies collaborate in the Innovation Workspace. Miro was founded in 2011 and currently has more than 1,600 employees in 13 hubs around the world.

We are a team of dreamers. We look for individuals who dream big, work hard, and above all stay humble. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do and through our work together we hope to create a supportive, welcoming, and innovative environment. We strive to play as a team to win the world and create a better version of ourselves every day. If this sounds like something that excites you, we want to hear from you!

Check out more about life at Miro:

  • Youtube:
  • Blog:
  • Instagram:

At Miro, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration across cultural differences. Miro’s mission — Empower teams to create the next big thing — is how we think about our product, people, and culture. We believe that creating big things requires diverse and inclusive teams. Diversity invites all talent with different demography, identities and styles to step in, and inclusion invites them to step closer together. Every day, we are working to build a more diverse Miro, cultivate a sense of belonging for future and current Mironeers around the world, and foster an environment where everyone can collaborate and embrace differences.

raw.excerpt: Welcome to OLX We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods.
raw.description:
Welcome to OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe, smart, and environmentally responsible.

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX and see how far you can go.

We believe the future of our products sits at the intersection of AI and design. Our ambition is to become an AI-native organization, where intelligent systems and human-centered design come together to create faster, smarter, and more meaningful customer experiences. We’re rethinking how products are built, how experiences are shaped, and how teams deliver impact.

A key part of this transformation is creating the right foundations and infrastructure to enable high-quality experiences at scale - where design systems, patterns, and workflows are structured, scalable, and AI-readable, unlocking new levels of speed, consistency, and innovation.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team. Reporting to the Product Design Manager, you will shape design strategy across product squads, own craft and quality standards, and mentor junior and mid-level designers. You'll work at the intersection of design, code, and AI systems—using tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor to prototype and iterate. Beyond shipping product experiences, you'll establish patterns, build systems thinking, and elevate the entire team's capabilities in AI-native design. The output we expect is not just working artifacts: it's strategic direction that raises design quality and team maturity across the organization.

What responsibilities will you get when working with us?

  • Lead design strategy across one or more product squads, translating business goals and user needs into coherent design direction that shapes product roadmaps and team priorities.

  • Use AI-native workflows to collapse the gap between strategy and production, prototyping and iterating directly in code rather than through static handoffs. Lead by example in adopting tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor for end-to-end design execution.

  • Establish and maintain high craft standards by defining foundational and reusable Agentic Experience patterns, designing scalable components for the design system (Nexus), and reviewing work to ensure quality and consistency.

  • Mentor and develop designers through critique, guidance, and structured feedback—helping them grow their craft, decision-making, and ability to work autonomously with AI-native tools.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to align on experience strategy, success metrics, and technical feasibility—translating design insights into business outcomes and measurable impact.

  • Conduct user research and run experiments to validate design decisions. Define success metrics, gather feedback, and iterate fast—always balancing speed with quality and bias toward shipping.

  • Lead design reviews, brainstorming sessions, and strategic discussions with your design peers and cross-functional partners. Communicate design rationale clearly with data, influence decisions, and build alignment around priorities.

  • Identify gaps and opportunities for design improvement and innovation. Propose and champion new approaches to solving complex problems—whether through design systems improvements, new AI patterns, or cross-domain initiatives.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will need:

  • Proven experience in UX / Digital Product Design, with a strong portfolio that showcases shipped work, live prototypes, and measurable business impact—not just static screens. We won’t be interviewing if you don’t have a portfolio to share beforehand.

  • Demonstrated expertise in AI-native design: you actively use AI tools (Figma Make, Lovable, Cursor, Claude, etc.) as a core part of your design practice and can teach others how to leverage them effectively.

  • Experience building or contributing to design systems, including code components. You understand how design decisions impact engineering implementation and can collaborate deeply with engineering teams.

  • Proven track record mentoring and developing designers. You give and receive candid feedback, help others improve their craft, and create psychologically safe environments for growth and experimentation.

  • Strong product and business thinking: ability to frame problems strategically, connect design decisions to business outcomes, and define success metrics that demonstrate measurable impact.

  • Excellent English communication and influence skills: you articulate design rationale clearly with data, facilitate complex discussions, and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

  • Growth mindset and adaptability: you thrive in ambiguity and rapid change, prioritize learning and impact over mastery of any specific tool, and are excited about emerging technologies and evolving design practices.

What can we offer you:

  • Work with and impact all OLX websites around the world

  • Salary + annual bonus up to 15% of your annual gross salary

  • Train and conference budget and free access to Udemy courses

  • Permanent contract, health insurance and life insurance

  • MacBook Pro or Windows Dell along with necessary accessories to make your work comfortable

  • 100% remote work (and the possibility to work from our office in Lisboa or Barcelona)

Hiring Process

    First Stage
    TA Screen


    This is your first interview with our Talent Acquisition team. We’ll explore your background, skills, and
    experience, as well as your approach to autonomy, ownership, and critical thinking. It’s also a chance to
    discuss your aspirations and ensure alignment with our culture and values.

    Second Stage
    Portfolio Review

    In this stage, you’ll meet with the Hiring Manager and a Designer from the team. We’ll explore your
    process thinking and approach to design through a case study of your choice. This is also a great
    opportunity to discuss how you collaborate with others and how your values align with our team culture.

    Third Stage
    AI Sandbox Challenge

    This is a dynamic and interactive session where you’ll have the chance to demonstrate your thought
    process in action. It’s designed to give us insight into how you approach challenges, integrate AI into your
    workflows, and apply your skills in a practical setting.
    We aim to make this process clear, collaborative, and reflective of the way we work as a team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!
OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
The Impact of an Associate Security Engineer at Coupa:

Coupa's Security Engineers keep our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data safe. As an Associate Security Engineer, you'll build your foundation in cloud, application, and infrastructure security by contributing to real, well-scoped engineering work alongside experienced teammates. You'll partner with Engineering, IT, and Compliance, learn how we build durable, automated security tooling instead of one-off fixes, and grow your root-cause analysis skills with mentorship and regular feedback.
This is a role for someone early in their security career who wants hands-on ownership of growing scope — with the support to get there.

What You'll Do:

  • Support the design and implementation of multi-cloud security controls — VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, and least-privilege IAM policies — on well-scoped tasks, with guidance from senior engineers. Build familiarity with permission boundaries and Organizations/SCPs along the way.
  • Contribute to policy as code and IaC security guardrails in CI/CD pipelines: write and tune rules, reduce false positives, and help keep pre-merge and pre-deploy checks reliable.
  • Assist in hardening containerized workloads and Kubernetes clusters, including image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, and network policies.
  • Triage vulnerability findings from application packages, container images, and third-party dependencies. Gather context on exploitability and business impact, and escalate complex or ambiguous findings to senior teammates.
  • Help the Risk & Compliance team gather technical evidence for audit frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP), and learn what auditable evidence looks like.
  • Write and maintain scripts and small automations that make security work faster and more repeatable.
  • Learn from mentors through pairing, design reviews, and feedback on your remediation plans. Document what you learn and help improve runbooks.
  • Support the secure design, deployment, and operational monitoring of enterprise AI systems, models, and agentic workflows.
  • Help design and develop internal AI-driven security tools, automation scripts, and guardrails to improve threat detection and vulnerability remediation.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • 0–2 years of experience in security, cloud, DevOps, IT, or software engineering. Internships, co-ops, research, and hands-on personal or lab projects count.
  • Foundational knowledge of cloud security concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — IAM, networking, and common misconfigurations — gained through work, coursework, labs, or certifications.
  • Working scripting skills in Python, Bash, or JavaScript, and interest in building or extending internal security tooling.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability scanning concepts (dependency and container scanning). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines is a plus.
  • Basic awareness of common compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) and a willingness to learn how they translate into technical controls.
  • Curiosity and a habit of asking why — you want to understand the cause of a vulnerability, not just what the scanner reported.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort asking questions, asking for help, and escalating early.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamps, military, self-directed learning, or similar).
  • Entry-level certifications are a plus: Security+, ISC2 CC, AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS/GCP/Azure security certifications.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
  • Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

  • Familiarity with identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID.

raw.description:
About Kalepa:

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

  • Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
  • Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
  • Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
  • Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
  • Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

About the role:

Cash Compensation: $190-250K

Location: USA (Remote)

Kalepa is bringing on our first dedicated Revenue Operations hire to build and scale the operating system behind our go-to-market team and drive Kalepa’s rapid growth. This is a high-impact, foundational role that will allow you to design systems from scratch: forecasting, pipeline management, territory design, analytics, and other critical revenue operations projects.

You’ll report to the Vice President of Operations, partner closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, and work daily with Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and the founding team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Forecasting and pipeline management: Develop Kalepa’s forecasting methodology, run the regular pipeline/forecast cadence with leadership, and surface risks early.
  • Own a GTM tech stack for the AI era: Oversee the entire tech stack, including but not limited to our CRM (HubSpot), data enrichment tools, and AI-powered automation. You’ll evaluate and implement new tools to accelerate growth and productivity of our GTM teams.
  • Compensation: Work closely with our CRO and finance to design compensation plans that align with Kalepa’s goals.
  • Book of Business and Capacity Planning: Build territories in partnership with the CRO, including account segmentation, quota setting, and annual GTM planning.
  • Analytics and Reporting: Be the source of truth for GTM metrics and reporting - including for Kalepa’s executive team and board meetings.

About you:

  • 7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Strategy & Operations at a high-growth, VC-backed AI/SaaS startup
  • Experience as the first or an early RevOps hire, building the function from scratch and owning it all (or significant pieces of it).
  • A track record of working with GTM and finance leadership to design GTM compensation plans and running them.
  • Experience building forecasts for enterprise sales motions with long, multi-stakeholder cycles.
  • Comfort presenting to executives with a clear recommendation, and the judgment to deliver data-driven insights.
  • Experience owning and implementing a modern, AI-powered GTM tech stack

What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary (based on experience level).
  • Significant equity options package.
  • 401(k) plan with employer contribution (regardless of employee contribution)
  • Excellent benefits: 100% covered medical, 100% covered vision and dental for individuals and families, and others
  • Work with an ambitious, smart, global, and fun team to transform a $7T global industry.
  • 20 days of PTO a year
  • Global team offsites (2021 - Playa del Carmen, 2022 - Rome, 2023 - Buenos Aires, 2024 - Lisbon, 2025 - Cartagena)
  • Healthy living/gym stipend. Mobile phone bill stipend.
  • Continuing education credits.
  • Paid parental leave.

*The salary range listed is an estimate and will vary based on a variety of factors. Final compensation will be determined during the offer stage based on relevant experience, performance during the interview process, and geographic location, and may therefore differ from the posted range.

About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
    First Stage
    Portfolio & Design Leadership
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

Data Process Policy

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

Important: This position will work in one of the following three Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) shift teams:

1. Weekend Shift Team
1a. Rotation 1: Sunday to Thursday (9AM–5PM), Friday and Saturday off
1b. Rotation 2: Tuesday to Saturday (9AM–5PM), Sunday and Monday off

2. Early-Morning Shift Team
2a. Rotation 1: Monday to Friday (4AM–12PM Pacific Time), Saturday and Sunday off
2b. Rotation 2: Tuesday to Saturday (4AM–12PM Pacific Time), Sunday and Monday off

3. Late-Evening Shift Team
3a. Rotation 1: Monday to Friday (3PM–11PM Pacific Time), Saturday and Sunday off
3b. Rotation 2: Sunday to Thursday (3PM–11PM Pacific Time), Friday and Saturday off

Important notes:

  • During hiring, candidates will select and commit to one shift team (Weekend, Early-Morning, or Late-Evening).
  • Once hired and onboarded, the team member will work exclusively within that shift team.
  • ExHS team members rotate quarterly (every three months) between their team's two rotations.
  • There are no rotations between shift teams.

This is an exciting opportunity in our Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) department at Natera (a global leader in precision medicine and genomics testing), to lead a team providing key data analytics services for our lab production operations. As a Manager of Data Analysis for Lab Production Support, you will work in one of the above three DSPE Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) shift teams, during the specified rotation hours. You will have the opportunity to apply innovative data analytics solutions, directly support the most cutting-edge medical diagnostics and genomics applications, and make real & immediate impact to patients and healthcare providers, by ensuring the specific ExHS shift team's timely and accurate data analytics support to production teams, e.g., product management team, lab operations teams, lab director teams, and genetic counselor teams.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the specific ExHS shift team, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and collaboration.
  • Measure, report, and continuously improve team operational effectiveness.
  • Define and track team objectives, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals.
  • Provide career growth opportunities, feedback, and performance assessments for team members.
  • Encourage individual contributors (ICs) to pitch ideas for process improvements and innovations.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure timely and accurate resolution of production escalations data analysis tickets.
  • Train and coach team members on new technologies, procedures, and guidelines/best practices.
  • Enforce operating procedures for compliance, quality, and efficiency.
  • Manage and improve tracking systems for workload, capacity, and ticket SLAs.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Represent the Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) teams in stakeholder meetings.
  • Proactively manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Establish regular stakeholder reporting mechanisms.
  • Translate complex analytical results into actionable recommendations for cross-functional partners.
  • Effectively and correctly escalate issues encountered to other DSPE teams.

Process Improvement and Innovation

  • Identify opportunities for automation and process enhancements to streamline operations.
  • Identify and escalate risks such as data model changes that impact project timelines or ticket TAT.
  • Collaborate with the overall DSPE team to develop new and improve existing support solutions.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master's degree in a related field (e.g., Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science).
  • Minimum 5 years of working experience in a highly regulated environment, e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis and/or statistical modeling in data production, data engineering, data analytics, analytics production support roles.
  • Minimum 2 years in a team management role.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements, such as HIPAA and FDA guidelines.
  • Working knowledge of the business processes and requirements of diagnostic laboratories.
  • Proven track record in managing production escalations, data workflows, and team operations.
  • Experience with healthcare data, and clinical terminology is a plus.
  • Functional understanding of next-gen sequencing workflows.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Proficient in data analysis and statistical techniques.
  • Proficient in Python and SQL development.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake platform technologies.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and retrieving data from complex data sources in a structured format.
  • Strong understanding of various statistical concepts (parametric & non-parametric distributions, hypothesis testing, probability, regression).
  • Proficient in aggregating data, preparing, cleaning data, and data mining using SQL and Python.
  • Familiarity with machine learning techniques and their practical applications in real-world datasets.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Good documentation practices and coding style.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience using version control systems such as GitHub or GitLab for managing code and collaboration.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Strong integrity.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$140,000—$175,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

What You'll Do:

    • Act as the trusted advisor and partner to Customer Success leadership with credibility and influence from strategy to execution • Implement and execute the Coupa Revenue Operating Model across the Customer Success organization. • Provide leadership and counsel to Customer Success leaders to implement objectives and cadences — including renewal forecast reviews and at-risk account cadences — that appropriately reflect and drive our business goals. • Own the operating rhythm for renewal forecasting, including available-to-renew (ATR) management and the accuracy and consistency of renewal rate, churn, and expansion reporting. • Drive book-of-business segmentation, coverage, and capacity planning processes and related activities, working with cross-functional teams to build plans that align to corporate goals and strategy. • Develop and implement best-practices, processes, and cadences to establish quality, accuracy, and process consistency across reporting, forecasting, retention management, and overall revenue process optimization while minimizing administrative overhead. • Oversee the creation, accuracy, and efficient distribution of retention, renewal, and customer health metrics, reports, and other revenue-related business intelligence essential to the organization. • Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations peers to ensure renewal, churn, and net retention reporting reconciles with company-level forecasting and planning. • Actively contribute to the enhancement of business operations processes covering applications, data, reporting, field engagement and project/change management. • Build strong relationships across Customer Success leadership and other cross-functional departments to influence decision making, drive process optimization and overall revenue effectiveness.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

    • Strong executive presence and communication skills, and an ability to lead through influence and credibility across an organization. • Solid leadership skills with the ability to act independently. • Ability to manage and influence stakeholders • Strong understanding of the post-sales customer lifecycle — renewals, retention, and expansion — with the ability to translate that knowledge to other teams, including Revenue, Customer Success, Finance, IT, and other revenue support teams. • Excellent analytical skills combined with strong problem solving and organization skills and a high attention to detail. • Sharp business acumen and judgement, and strong project management skills. • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. • Results driven and naturally curious with an ability to motivate those around them. • Bachelor's degree in Business-related discipline; MBA and/or CPA an asset. • 5-8 years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, Sales Strategy or Business Operations. • 5+ years of experience in the software industry and cloud platform businesses. Industry experience in B2B, HCM and/or SaaS technology an asset. • Salesforce, Clari, Microsoft Excel, and other revenue analytics experience required, with experience in Gainsight or other Customer Success platforms and Tableau or other data visualization tools an asset.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
  • Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

At Ardent, we hire people who want more than a job — they want to serve a mission that matters. Our teams support the federal government’s most critical national security and defense priorities, helping protect the nation, strengthen resilience, and advance the technologies and capabilities that keep America secure. For veterans, cleared professionals, and purpose-driven innovators, Ardent is a place to continue serving alongside a team that understands the importance of the mission and the people behind it.

We also know top talent has choices, which is why we back our mission with benefits and flexibility that stand out: competitive pay, comprehensive health coverage, flexible PTO, federal holidays off, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, wellness stipends, and a culture that values and rewards hard work, dedication, and adaptability. If you want to build something meaningful, while enjoying the kind of flexibility and support that you need to do your best work — Ardent is where your next mission begins.

Ardent is seeking an IT Subject Matter Expert to join our team.

This is a remote position.

Position Description:

Ardent is seeking an experienced Data Scientist / IT Subject Matter Expert to support data-driven initiatives within a federal environment. This role will focus on applying advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and data science techniques to complex business and operational challenges.

Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Provide subject matter expertise supporting data science, analytics, and machine learning initiatives.
  • Support analysis of complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Provide recommendations regarding analytical methods, statistical models, and data-driven solutions.
  • Support data preparation, transformation, modeling, and visualization activities.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership to define analytical requirements and support program objectives.
  • Support development of dashboards, reports, technical documentation, and analytical deliverables.
  • Provide guidance on data quality, analytical methodologies, and data science best practices.
  • Contribute to modernization and continuous improvement efforts involving data, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in Information Technology, data analytics, data science, or related technical environments.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience supporting enterprise-scale data, analytics, or technology initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience performing statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, or other advanced analytical work.
  • Experience working with large, complex, and/or disparate datasets.
  • Proficiency with data analysis and programming tools such as Python, R, SQL, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with data visualization and communicating analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts clearly.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical, business, and program teams in a federal environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting federal government programs or mission environments.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms and analytical environments.
  • Experience developing or implementing machine learning models in operational or production environments.
  • Familiarity with AI, machine learning, natural language processing, or other advanced analytics techniques.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, or enterprise data management practices.

Due to the nature of the work we support, all candidates in consideration for this role must be willing to undergo the government issued background investigation process. We highly encourage all Veterans and those with disabilities to apply.

Ardent is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other basis protected by state, local, or federal law.

United by our vision. Leading with empathy. Pioneers in curiosity.

Deliver high-quality ADHD Assessments, on your schedule.

Looking to use your clinical skills flexibly and remotely? Healios is looking for ADHD assessment experienced clinicians to deliver assessments for children, young people and adults via our market-leading digital platform.

Whether you're picking up extra work or prefer the freedom of freelance, you'll get the tools, support, and autonomy to focus on what matters: delivering great care.

As an associate clinician at Healios, you can scale your caseload up and down to ensure you get the right work-life balance, as you need it.

As an ADHD Assessment Clinician you will play a pivotal role in our clinical teams. Healios’ structured observations involve sessions conducted ‘face-to-face’ via the Healios online platform. Your primary responsibilities will include;

  • Undertaking diagnostic observations and histories
  • Attendance at MDTs
  • If required, providing post assessment support e.g. feedback
  • Whilst you will primarily be undertaking Adult and Children ADHD assessments. You are required to have experience across the lifespan services from under 7’s to adulthood.
  • You will have the opportunity to work across all service lines (NHS, Melios, Bupa) and we provide the appropriate clinicians with Bupa accreditation

What you need to have

If you feel you could be a good fit for the role but do not meet all of the criteria, please do make an application and we will be happy to consider your application.

  • Minimum of 12 months diagnostic experience including observation and histories
  • Experience of assessing both children and adults
  • Clinical qualification and registration in:
    • Occupational Therapy
    • Psychology (Clinical, Counselling or Forensic)
    • Speech & Language Therapy
    • Paediatrician
    • RMN/Learning Disability/Child & Adult Nurses
  • Clinical registration with HCPC or GMC
  • Current DBS in place active on the Update Service (must cover Child/Adult Barring lists)
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Comfortable conducting sessions and associated administration via online platform
  • Flexibility to support our mission of bringing healthcare to anyone, anytime, anywhere
  • A commitment to ethical practice and adherence to the highest standards of safeguarding of adults/children
  • A professional home working environment
  • Wifi connection. Minimum of 2 mbps up and download speed

What’s in it for you

  • 💸£540 per child assessment / £430 per adult assessment
  • 🧠Use your expertise to deliver remote assessments via a highly efficient virtual technology platform
  • 🕐Flexible hours — choose when and how much you work (Mon–Sun, 8:30am–9pm)
  • 🔧Market LeadingTech, admin + safeguarding support allowing you to focus on high-quality clinical work
  • 📚CPD + training access included
  • 👥Join a supportive clinical network
  • 💷 Automated invoicing

We are a Disability Confident Employer and operate a Guaranteed Interview Scheme (GIS). This means we are committed to interviewing all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. If you wish to be considered under this scheme, please indicate this when asked about disability on the application form.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

“Do the right thing” is one of our core Healios values. And building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels supported is absolutely the right thing to do. Whether we’re developing a new service line or enhancing one of our products, we need people with different skills, backgrounds, identities and perspectives to ensure our innovations will work for the children and young people we are here to serve. By embracing diversity, we can deliver better care experiences and outcomes, while tackling the inequalities in healthcare provision that exist today.

SAFER RECRUITMENT & PRE- EMPLOYMENT CHECKS

Healios ensures that supporting people to be safe is at the heart of our work and a key priority across all areas of the organisation, We will do our absolute best to keep the people that we support, safe from harm. This starts with our recruitment processes.

As part of our pre-employment checks, all employees of Healios will be asked to have a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. Dependent on your role within the business, this will either be an Enhanced or Basic. A Protecting Vulnerable Groups (PVG) check will be required. You will also be asked to provide two professional references as a minimum.

Overview

Job Title: Senior Information Technology Project ManagerLocation: Remote Mano Lani LLC is seeking a Senior Information Technology Project Manager to oversee project staffing, schedules, deliverables, and day-to-day coordination for technology and data-focused projects. This position will work closely with client stakeholders, technical teams, and company leadership to keep projects organized, on schedule, and aligned with customer requirements. The ideal candidate has experience managing technical projects, coordinating cross-functional teams, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role requires someone who can manage multiple priorities while providing guidance across complex project activities. Key Responsibilities • Manage project schedules, staffing, priorities, milestones, and deliverables.• Coordinate the work of technical, analytical, and support teams.• Track project progress, risks, issues, and action items.• Ensure project requirements and deliverables are completed accurately and on time.• Serve as a primary point of contact for project coordination and status updates.• Facilitate project meetings and communicate priorities, decisions, and follow-up actions.• Work with technical leads and subject matter experts to resolve project issues.• Prepare project status reports, schedules, briefings, and other management documentation.• Support resource planning and help ensure appropriate staffing across project activities.• Identify potential schedule, staffing, or technical risks and recommend practical solutions.• Maintain effective communication between client stakeholders, project teams, and company leadership.• Provide guidance across multiple technical assignments as needed.
