raw.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. This role centers on a comprehensive diagnosis of core business constraints impacting client growth, leveraging a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to identify and formulate strategic solutions. This includes pinpointing challenges across all points of sale - DTC/ecommerce acquisition, retail execution, Amazon market share erosion, or upstream strategic barriers like brand positioning - and developing a unified, data-backed strategy to overcome them.

CPG accounts tend to have opinions about their channels that predate the data. Part of this job is having the product, competitive, and retail fluency to challenge those assumptions with credibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with particular attention to how the client's retail and DTC performance interact
  • Own the senior client relationship
  • QBRs should drive decisions, not report history
  • Consult on channel mix across DTC, Amazon, and retail — understand how they cannibalize or reinforce each other and make a recommendation
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a single account strategy
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
  • Coach analysts and specialists; give specific, timely feedback

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in CPG marketing, ideally with both DTC and retail brand experience
  • Understands how Amazon fits into a CPG growth strategy — share of search, ASIN architecture, buy box, sponsored vs. organic balance
  • Familiar with the retailer relationship layer: how Target, Ulta, Sephora, Whole Foods, or similar partners shape media investment decisions
  • Has an opinion on CPG measurement — MMM, incrementality testing, in-store vs. digital attribution
  • Fluent in upper-funnel channel strategy — content, SEO, YouTube, programmatic
  • Comfortable with creative-heavy accounts where briefs, asset velocity, and influencer strategy are as important as media optimization
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts
  • Has managed senior clients who have strong brand opinions and needs to be met with confidence

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.

You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.

What you’ll do

  • Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
  • Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.
  • Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders.
  • Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps.
  • Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes.
  • Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions.
  • Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps.
  • Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.
  • Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters.
  • Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes.
  • Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge.
  • Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation.
  • Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook-first company.
  • Experience leading globally distributed remote teams.
  • Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.

About the team

Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models.

CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Lead Finance Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, optimization, integration, governance, and continuous improvement of CareDx's Finance systems portfolio, with NetSuite serving as the Company's core ERP platform and Coupa, Concur, FloQast, and related applications supporting critical financial operations. This role serves as the primary technical owner for Finance systems, partnering closely with Accounting, Finance, Procurement, Internal Audit, and IT stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and well-controlled solutions that support business objectives.

The Lead Finance Systems Administrator provides technical leadership for system configuration, integrations, vendor management, platform enhancements, and operational support. This individual translates business and accounting requirements into effective technology solutions while ensuring the reliability, compliance, and performance of systems supporting financial reporting, procure-to-pay, expense management, month-end close, audit readiness, and SOX-regulated processes.

Reporting and Key Partnerships

Reports to the Manager, IT SOX & Corporate Applications, serving as the primary technical owner for NetSuite and the supporting Finance systems landscape, including Coupa, Concur, FloQast, and other related systems/integrations.

  • Partner closely with the VP Controller, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Supply Chain, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to support financial operations, reporting requirements, period-end close activities, compliance initiatives, and business process improvements.
  • Collaborate with IT infrastructure, security, integration, and application teams to ensure Finance systems are secure, reliable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards.
  • Own relationships with external vendors, implementation partners, consultants, and managed service providers, ensuring project delivery, technical quality, documentation, testing, and knowledge transfer meet organizational expectations.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Finance and Accounting leadership, translating business requirements into scalable, well-governed technology solutions that support business growth, operational efficiency, audit readiness, and SOX compliance.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams on acquisitions, system enhancements, process automation, master data governance, integrations, and other strategic initiatives impacting the Finance technology ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

Finance Systems Administration and Governance

  • Own the administration, optimization, governance, and strategic roadmap for the CareDx Finance systems portfolio, including NetSuite, Coupa, Concur, FloQast, and related financial applications.
  • Serve as the primary technical owner and subject matter expert for Finance systems architecture, configuration, integrations, security, and support.
  • Develop and maintain system standards, documentation, operating procedures, and governance processes that promote scalability, reliability, and compliance.
  • Drive platform enhancements and process improvements that improve user experience, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and control effectiveness.
  • Establish and maintain disciplined change management practices, including requirements gathering, testing, approvals, deployment controls, and documentation.

Finance and Accounting Enablement

  • Translate accounting and finance requirements into practical NetSuite solutions across close, revenue, billing, procure-to-pay, accounts payable, purchasing, cash, inventory, intercompany, consolidations, reporting, and audit support.
  • Support monthly and quarterly close requirements by improving workflows, reports, reconciliations, saved searches, dashboards, and exception reporting.
  • Create reporting capabilities to support consolidation of financials across multiple subsidiaries, entities, departments, and management reporting layers.
  • Improve accounting processes and workflows for various segments of the business, including processes introduced through acquisitions or new business units.
  • Partner with the VP Controller and Accounting leadership to prioritize system work based on financial reporting risk, operational urgency, compliance impact, and business value.

External Consultant and Project Management

  • Own relationships with external consultants, implementation partners, and managed service providers supporting Finance applications.
  • Oversee project scope, timelines, budgets, solution design, testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer activities.
  • Evaluate recommendations from vendors and consultants to ensure proposed solutions meet CareDx requirements for scalability, supportability, compliance, and long-term maintainability.

Integrations, Systems, and Data

  • Support integrations between NetSuite and adjacent finance or operational systems, including expense management, procurement, inventory or warehouse tools, banking, reporting, and other finance applications.
  • Partner with IT and business owners to troubleshoot integration errors, data mapping issues, master data governance concerns, and failed or incomplete transactions.
  • Support acquisition integration activities, including subsidiary setup, master data alignment, data migration, reporting layers, process stabilization, and post-close support.
  • Help define the long-term architecture and roadmap for the Finance systems ecosystem, ensuring solutions remain scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives.

Training, Adoption, and Stakeholder Support

  • Provide practical training, guidance, and job aids for new and existing users across Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, and other business teams.
  • Build credibility with accounting users by understanding their process pain points and communicating solutions in clear business language.
  • Create a consistent intake and prioritization process for enhancement requests, support tickets, close-related issues, reporting needs, and control remediation items.
  • Manage support tickets issued through ServiceNow or similar ticketing tools, where applicable.

Audit, SOX, and Compliance Support

  • Support the external audit process by helping Accounting and related teams gather system evidence, access support, configuration information, audit documentation, and reports required by external auditors.
  • Partner with Accounting, SOX owners, and external auditors to investigate and resolve audit findings, account discrepancies, access concerns, and issues of non-compliance.
  • Support user access reviews, role design reviews, segregation of duties analysis, change management evidence, and control remediation activities.
  • Ensure finance application administration practices support audit readiness, including evidence retention, approval documentation, and clear ownership of configuration decisions.
  • Participate in risk assessments, control improvement initiatives, and governance activities related to Finance technology.

Minimum Education, Experience, & Specialized Knowledge (Required): 

  • 5+ years of progressive NetSuite administration, finance systems, and ERP implementation experience, with hands-on configuration responsibility in a complex company environment.
  • Strong NetSuite technical skillset across roles and permissions, workflows, saved searches, reports, dashboards, custom records, forms, bundles, release management, sandbox testing, and production deployment practices.
  • At least one year of experience using or administering Coupa.
  • Working understanding of core accounting and finance processes, including close, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory, revenue, consolidations, intercompany, reporting, and audit support.
  • Experience managing or coordinating external consultants, developers, or implementation partners.
  • Experience with integrations between NetSuite, Coupa, Concur, and other finance or operational systems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to Accounting and Finance stakeholders.
  • Ability to take ownership, prioritize competing requests, manage details carefully, and operate in a public-company control environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Public company, SOX, external audit, regulated life sciences, healthcare, or similar controlled-environment experience.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting acquisitions, subsidiary expansion, multi-entity reporting, post-close integration, or ERP stabilization after business combinations.
  • Experience with expense management, procurement, contract lifecycle, warehouse/inventory, banking, reporting, or other systems that integrate with NetSuite.
  • NetSuite certification, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript familiarity, or comparable technical credentials.
  • SAP Concur, ServiceNow, procurement systems, reporting tools, or similar finance application experience.

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

  • Demonstrate Courage
  • Practice Adaptability
  • Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is part of Schumacher North America, which is the largest division of the company.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Temporary Payroll Manager to run end-to-end payroll for 500+ employees in UKG from October 26, 2026 through January 31, 2027. This is a hands-on role: you will process every pay run, own payroll tax registration and reconciliation, and keep employee records accurate.

You will also play a key part in two transitions. First, you will help implement Rippling as our new payroll system. Second, you will help close out a former entity in each state where it operates, partnering with Finance on final payment remittances. The ideal candidate is detail-driven, works independently from day one and is comfortable in a period of change.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end payroll processing (UKG)

  • Run the full payroll cycle for 500+ employees, from data intake through final approval and funding.
  • Enter all payroll transactions in UKG, including new hires, terminations, pay changes, bonuses, commission, incentives, deductions, garnishments and off-cycle payments.
  • Maintain accurate employee profiles in UKG, including pay, tax, direct deposit and deduction setups.
  • Prepare and review pre- and post-payroll audits and variance reports; resolve discrepancies before payroll is finalized.
  • Process off-cycle, manual and final paychecks in line with state final-pay requirements.
  • Respond to employee and manager payroll questions promptly and accurately.

Payroll tax registration and reconciliation

  • Own state and local payroll tax registrations, including new account setups, rate updates and agency correspondence.
  • Reconcile payroll tax filings and payments against payroll registers and agency records each pay period and quarter.
  • Research and resolve tax notices, penalties and account discrepancies.
  • Support Q4 and year-end close, including W-2 preparation and review.

Rippling payroll implementation

  • Assist with pay runs during the transition, including any parallel runs between UKG and Rippling.
  • Help gather, validate and map data for migration, such as employee records, earnings and deduction codes, tax setups and year-to-date balances.
  • Test payroll results in Rippling and reconcile them against UKG output.
  • Help document new payroll processes and controls for the team.
  • Keep registrations up to date in both UKG and Rippling.
  • In January, work on the transition of POA and TPA to Rippling.

Former entity termination

  • Help close out the former entity in each operating state, including payroll tax account closures and final filings.
  • Work with Finance on payment remittances to tax agencies and other payees tied to the former entity.
  • Track closure status by state and escalate open items or risks.

Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of progressive payroll experience, including end-to-end processing for 500+ employees.
  • Hands-on experience running payroll in UKG (UKG Pro).
  • Multi-state payroll experience, including state and local tax registration, filings and reconciliation.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state and local payroll regulations, including final-pay rules.
  • Proven ability to reconcile payroll registers, tax filings and general ledger entries.
  • Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) for audits and reconciliations.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment with confidential data and the ability to meet fixed payroll deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Rippling or another payroll system implementation or conversion.
  • Experience closing out an entity, including payroll tax account closures across multiple states.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. This role centers on a comprehensive diagnosis of core business constraints impacting client growth, leveraging a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to identify and formulate strategic solutions. This includes pinpointing challenges across all points of sale - DTC/ecommerce acquisition, retail execution, Amazon market share erosion, or upstream strategic barriers like brand positioning - and developing a unified, data-backed strategy to overcome them.

CPG accounts tend to have opinions about their channels that predate the data. Part of this job is having the product, competitive, and retail fluency to challenge those assumptions with credibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with particular attention to how the client's retail and DTC performance interact
  • Own the senior client relationship
  • QBRs should drive decisions, not report history
  • Consult on channel mix across DTC, Amazon, and retail — understand how they cannibalize or reinforce each other and make a recommendation
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a single account strategy
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
  • Coach analysts and specialists; give specific, timely feedback

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in CPG marketing, ideally with both DTC and retail brand experience
  • Understands how Amazon fits into a CPG growth strategy — share of search, ASIN architecture, buy box, sponsored vs. organic balance
  • Familiar with the retailer relationship layer: how Target, Ulta, Sephora, Whole Foods, or similar partners shape media investment decisions
  • Has an opinion on CPG measurement — MMM, incrementality testing, in-store vs. digital attribution
  • Fluent in upper-funnel channel strategy — content, SEO, YouTube, programmatic
  • Comfortable with creative-heavy accounts where briefs, asset velocity, and influencer strategy are as important as media optimization
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts
  • Has managed senior clients who have strong brand opinions and needs to be met with confidence

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Lead Field Marketing Manager (FMM) serves as a strategic partner to Enterprise Sales, responsible for developing and executing integrated field marketing plans that accelerate pipeline growth, strengthen customer relationships, and drive revenue outcomes. This role leads Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives, customer and prospect events, sales activations, and targeted demand generation strategies designed to engage priority accounts throughout the buyer journey.

The FMM partners closely with sales leadership, account teams, corporate marketing, product marketing, and external vendors to create measurable marketing programs that generate awareness, influence opportunities, deepen customer engagement, and support customer acquisition, retention, and expansion goals. This position plays a critical role in aligning marketing investments with business priorities and ensuring field activities contribute directly to pipeline creation, pipeline acceleration, opportunity progression, customer expansion, and revenue growth.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Serve as the strategic marketing partner to Enterprise Sales, developing account and territory plans that drive pipeline growth, customer expansion, and revenue outcomes.
  • Lead targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategies and programs for priority accounts, leveraging data-driven insights to increase engagement and opportunity progression.
  • Plan and execute customer, prospect, and executive engagement programs, including executive briefings, industry events, roundtables, and hospitality experiences that strengthen relationships and support business growth.
  • Drive integrated demand generation and sales activation initiatives that create new opportunities, accelerate pipeline, and support strategic business priorities.
  • Collaborate across Sales, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, and Campaign teams to deliver aligned go-to-market initiatives and maximize field impact.
  • Provide strategic insights and recommendations to sales leadership by leveraging market intelligence, account data, and performance analytics to improve account penetration and growth.
  • Measure and optimize program effectiveness through pipeline impact, account engagement, revenue influence, ROI, and sales follow-through, delivering executive-level reporting and recommendations.
  • Manage field marketing budgets, agency and vendor relationships, and marketing innovation initiatives, including AI-enabled tools and automation, to maximize business impact and operational efficiency.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in field marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, sales enablement, event marketing, or related disciplines.
  • Proven success partnering with enterprise sales organizations to drive pipeline creation, pipeline acceleration, pipeline growth, and revenue outcomes.
  • Experience developing and executing ABM strategies and account engagement programs.
  • Strong background managing customer events, executive engagement programs, hospitality experiences, conferences, and field marketing initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience measuring marketing effectiveness, campaign performance, pipeline contribution, pipeline acceleration, and ROI.
  • Experience managing significant marketing budgets and multiple vendor relationships.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage front-line sellers, sales leadership, and executive audiences.
  • Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and sales engagement platforms, including Salesforce and Marketo (or similar technologies).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Travel up to 30%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience with account intent platforms, ABM technologies, and data-driven targeting strategies.
  • Knowledge of telecommunications, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, or technology solutions.
  • Experience leading executive engagement programs and strategic customer experiences.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered marketing, sales, and productivity platforms to improve campaign effectiveness, account engagement, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

Success Measures

  • Pipeline sourced, influenced, and accelerated
  • Opportunity creation, progression, and expansion
  • Target account engagement growth
  • Event ROI and sales follow-up effectiveness
  • Sales stakeholder satisfaction and partnership
  • Marketing program adoption and participation
  • Revenue impact and business growth contribution
  • Adoption and effectiveness of AI-enabled marketing practices

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll help GitLab customers realize the full value of our DevSecOps platform by driving adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term advocacy. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers, guiding them on Git, branching strategies, software development lifecycle, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps best practices. In this role, you’ll connect customer goals with GitLab capabilities, lead workshops and Centers of Excellence efforts, and translate product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations for both customers and GitLab account teams. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services, with success in your first year measured by customer satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the strategic relationships you build.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain a trusted advisor relationship with each assigned customer, focusing on adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term satisfaction with GitLab.
  • Assist customers with expert deployment guidance, operational best practices, and establishing a GitLab Center of Excellence within their organization.
  • Lead and participate in workshops to help customers understand and use the full value of the GitLab solution across their software development lifecycle.
  • Measure and monitor customers’ progress against critical and key performance indicators, and share insights with GitLab account stakeholders and customer sponsors and executives.
  • Translate customer product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive adoption and expansion of GitLab within customer environments.
  • Establish and manage regular touchpoints with customers in line with service level agreements to review strategic and technical objectives and adjust plans as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services to streamline issue resolution, share customer feedback, and align on customer success plans.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in a customer-facing role focused on post-sales adoption, value realization, and advocacy.
  • Background in customer success, professional services, technical account management, or a related function with direct customer engagement.
  • Ability to understand and discuss Git, common branching strategies, and how customers use version control in their workflows.
  • Knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including typical development pipelines and tooling.
  • Familiarity with continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps concepts and practices.
  • Skill in translating product usage data and technical details into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to build trusted advisor relationships, facilitate workshops, and guide customers through best practices and operational change.
  • Openness to learning, with transferable skills from adjacent roles or industries that support collaborative, outcome-focused customer partnerships.

About the team

The Customer Success Management team at GitLab works with customers across regions to drive adoption of the GitLab DevSecOps platform, measure and communicate outcomes, and build long-term advocacy. As a globally distributed, all-remote team, we collaborate asynchronously with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other groups to connect customer needs with GitLab’s product and services. We focus on helping our customers establish GitLab best practices, including Centers of Excellence, and on turning usage data into actionable insights that support strategic and technical objectives.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$85,200—$144,000 USD

raw.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. This role centers on a comprehensive diagnosis of core business constraints impacting client growth, leveraging a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to identify and formulate strategic solutions. This includes pinpointing challenges across all points of sale - DTC/ecommerce acquisition, retail execution, Amazon market share erosion, or upstream strategic barriers like brand positioning - and developing a unified, data-backed strategy to overcome them.

CPG accounts tend to have opinions about their channels that predate the data. Part of this job is having the product, competitive, and retail fluency to challenge those assumptions with credibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with particular attention to how the client's retail and DTC performance interact
  • Own the senior client relationship
  • QBRs should drive decisions, not report history
  • Consult on channel mix across DTC, Amazon, and retail — understand how they cannibalize or reinforce each other and make a recommendation
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a single account strategy
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
  • Coach analysts and specialists; give specific, timely feedback

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in CPG marketing, ideally with both DTC and retail brand experience
  • Understands how Amazon fits into a CPG growth strategy — share of search, ASIN architecture, buy box, sponsored vs. organic balance
  • Familiar with the retailer relationship layer: how Target, Ulta, Sephora, Whole Foods, or similar partners shape media investment decisions
  • Has an opinion on CPG measurement — MMM, incrementality testing, in-store vs. digital attribution
  • Fluent in upper-funnel channel strategy — content, SEO, YouTube, programmatic
  • Comfortable with creative-heavy accounts where briefs, asset velocity, and influencer strategy are as important as media optimization
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts
  • Has managed senior clients who have strong brand opinions and needs to be met with confidence

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Prepaid Medicine Plan
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

  • 5% or lower client churn
  • Manage 8-10 mid level clients
  • Maintain $22,000 RPE

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Leads the enterprise Critical Sparing Program, ensuring network and CPE restoration capabilities remain ready, responsive, and reliable through disciplined execution, urgency, and accountability. Owns end-to-end operational performance across equipment availability, expedited fulfillment, logistics, recovery, repair, replenishment, asset lifecycle governance, escalations, financial management, and continuous improvement. Ensures accelerated replacement of out-of-box and service-impacting equipment failures to protect the customer experience, minimize downtime, and enable timely restoration and installation activities. Maintains 24x7 operational readiness for critical customer events, network incidents, emergency response, and business continuity requirements. Partners cross-functionally to drive operational excellence, network resilience, and customer experience.

Work Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

• Own urgent, disciplined execution across the full spares lifecycle, including fulfillment, transportation, proof of delivery, depot replenishment, reverse logistics, repair/RMA, reclamation, asset recovery, billing, reconciliation, and closure.

• Establish program governance, operating controls, priorities, and improvement plans that directly support restoration speed, customer experience, service-level commitments, and financial objectives.

• Maintain 24x7 operational readiness for network and CPE outages, critical installations, severe weather, disasters, and business continuity events as a core member of the Emergency Response Team.

• Serve as the senior escalation leader for urgent program issues, order failures, DOA replacements, transportation delays, repair constraints, and other customer- or service-impacting events requiring immediate action.

• Represent the Sparing Program in senior leadership forums, customer reviews, Service Assurance activities, network reliability initiatives, and enterprise operational events where readiness, response, and risk mitigation are critical.

• Lead managers, analysts, and operational teams with clear accountability, timely decision-making, performance expectations, workforce planning, and succession development.

• Own performance management and business reviews covering availability, delivery SLA, restoration milestones, repair turnaround, return compliance, freight performance, asset recovery, and capital avoidance.

• Use analytics, root-cause analysis, and decisive corrective action to resolve process gaps, duplicate orders, high-failure parts, DOA/damage trends, logistics issues, and recurring service risks.

• Partner with Inventory Planning, Service Assurance and Technology Planning and Engineering on deployed-base analysis, sparing requirements, min/max levels, forecasting, depot strategy, gap mitigation, and capital recommendations; partner with Vendor Quality and Strategic Sourcing on hardware quality, supplier performance, repair effectiveness, and corrective action.

• Drive automation, predictive capabilities, system integration, and process improvements that improve traceability, reduce manual effort, accelerate restoration, and strengthen operational control.

What We Look For in a Candidate

• Progressive leadership experience in supply chain, logistics, field services, service assurance, asset lifecycle management, telecommunications, network operations, or a comparable mission-critical environment.

• Demonstrated ability to lead teams, complex programs, urgent escalations, service-level performance, and cross-functional execution in high-pressure operations.

• Strong analytical capability with the ability to convert operational data into timely decisions, decisive corrective action, and concise senior-level communication.

• Preferred experience with critical spares, field operations, service assurance, telecommunications infrastructure, SAP S/4HANA, ERP systems, transportation, inventory planning, OpsConsole, and analytics platforms.

Success Measures

• Inventory readiness and delivery SLA performance

• Restoration speed, escalation response, and event readiness

• Repair turnaround, return compliance, and lifecycle closure

• Asset recovery, capital avoidance, cost control, and financial accuracy

• Emergency readiness, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement

Company Overview:

Everything we do is for educators. We’re partnering with them to advance a bold vision for education that boosts district performance and student success. At Follett Software, we empower educators across roles with technology that streamlines processes and manages information and resources to improve their schools, increase student success, and drive the future of education. We believe that by empowering educators to amplify their impact on students’ lives, we can change the world. Our goal and mission is to drive the future of education. We are inspired by educators to deliver transformative technology. Our innovative, connected solutions simplify challenges and offer a seamless and intuitive experience.

Position Summary:

We’re looking for a Senior People Partner to support our Product & Technology, Marketing, and Finance teams. This role blends trusted relationship-building, strategic thought partnership, and hands-on execution. You’ll help leaders design healthy, high-performing teams, align people strategy to business goals, and make thoughtful people decisions that serve both employees and the business.

You are growth-oriented, seek feedback, and model the kind of curiosity, accountability, and resilience we expect from our leaders. You take care of people in a very real way—while also holding a high bar for performance, clarity, and business outcomes. You use technology and data as natural parts of your toolkit to support better decision-making and simpler, more transparent processes.

Position Scope:

  • Serve as a primary People Partner to leaders in Product & Technology, Marketing, and Finance, connecting org goals to clear people plans.
  • Advise on org design, headcount planning, team structure, and change management.
  • Anticipate and surface themes, risks, and opportunities early proposing options and helping leaders make thoughtful people-centered decisions.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers and employees across levels; be a go-to partner for candid, solutions-focused conversations.
  • Influence decisions through asking questions, identifying tradeoffs, and offering clear recommendations—not just citing policy.
  • Coach managers and employees through complex situations (role changes, behavior issues, team dynamics).
  • Navigate conflict and tension in a way that preserves trust and keeps work moving forward.
  • Bring the perspective of your client groups into People team decisions and company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead your client groups through core People cycles (performance, calibration, compensation, engagement, recognition) with clear timelines and expectations.
  • Translate company-wide programs into simple, practical guidance for your leaders and teams.
  • Spot process gaps or friction and partner with cross-functional teams to improve, simplify, or automate.
  • Support managers in setting clear expectations, giving effective feedback, and addressing performance issues in a timely, fair way.
  • Help identify and develop top talent and successors for critical roles.
  • Use people metrics to highlight trends and inform leader decisions.
  • Champion Follett Software’s values and drive a culture of clarity, inclusion, accountability, and recognition within your client groups.
  • Use technology and AI tools to increase your own efficiency and improve communication and access to information.
  • This role evolves as the business does; responsibilities may shift as team and company needs change.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in HR/People Partner or HR Business Partner roles.
  • Experience supporting technical teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, or IT) strongly preferred; exposure to Marketing and/or Finance teams is a plus.
  • Experience working in Tech or SaaS preferred; experience in EdTech is a plus.
  • Experience working on a fully remote or highly distributed team, with comfort operating independently and collaborating asynchronously required.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and levels without relying on formal authority.
  • Proven track record of moving cross-functional work forward where ownership is shared or ambiguous.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, high emotional intelligence, and sound judgment in sensitive situations.
  • Operational mindset with comfort managing details, timelines, and follow-through.
  • Growth-oriented and feedback-seeking; open to trying new approaches and iterating on how you work.
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort managing multiple systems and processes at once.
  • A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset — you notice gaps, ask questions, and take initiative without waiting for explicit direction.
  • Comfortable with HR systems (ideally including Rippling, Lattice, Awardco or similar platforms), AI tools and leveraging data to inform decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Work Environment:

  • This role is remote and only open to candidates currently located in the United States and able to work without sponsorship.
  • The role requires a suitable space that provides a private and quiet workplace.
  • Work hours and schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

Physical Environment:

  • Perform tasks in a home office environment with frequent virtual meetings, communications, and interruptions, requiring effective time management and prioritization.
  • Prolonged sitting with sustained visual focus on digital screens, requiring the ability to interact at a typical working distance.
  • Frequent use of keyboard and mouse, involving repetitive hand movements and fine motor skills for typing, navigating, and handling materials.
  • Occasionally adjust position or move within the workspace to reach, retrieve, or access items, involving bending, twisting, or reaching, and occasionally lifting or carrying items weighing up to 10 pounds.
  • Travel requirements: Less than 5%

We’re deeply committed to supporting the well-being, growth, and success of every Team Member. That commitment shows up in a thoughtfully designed, comprehensive benefits package that helps you thrive—at work and in life. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Meaningful recognition and tangible rewards that celebrate achievements, fuel motivation, and recognize both individual and team success

Our mission at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Strategic Consultant to join our team!

The Strategic Consultant owns Greenhouse’s largest and most complex paid strategic enablement engagements via professional services. You will be an integral member of the Customer Success and Professional Services teams, accelerating Greenhouse-led implementations and conducting system audits, strategic advisement, reconfigurations, and change management.

High proficiency with Greenhouse Recruiting is only part of the skillset we're looking for. A successful candidate will be skilled at distilling complex needs into digestible workflows, and feels comfortable inspiring decision makers to action.

Who will love this job

  • An organized multi-tasker - you can handle multiple complex engagements simultaneously and never lose sight of detail and organization in the process
  • A collaborative teammate - you work with both internal and external stakeholders to drive the success of project
  • A strategic thinker - you're an expert in all things Greenhouse and Talent Acquisition best practices and policies, and use your knowledge to advise and provide clear and actionable recommendations
  • A creative builder - you see the gaps in processes and actively work to optimize documentation, resources, people, tools, workflows, etc
  • An advocate - you turn customers from passive users to active champions of our product

What you’ll do

  • Work strategically with our largest and fastest-growing customers to help upgrade their workflows, system configurations, and recruiting strategies
  • Build documentation and playbooks to standardize consulting engagements and processes
  • Strategize and oversee the professional services lifecycle of multiple projects at a time
  • Partner with customers for specific lengths of time to advise, educate, and facilitate changes based on your recommendations
  • Engage in change management and evangelism
  • Conduct account and workflow audits, including detailed recommendations
  • Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have

  • Extensive Greenhouse knowledge
  • Project management experience
  • 3+ years experience advising on talent-related functions
  • Experience helping to build internal programs and process improvements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; assertive, strategic and thoughtful
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and work well on a team, and adapt to a constantly changing environment with competing priorities
  • Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day and curious about how they could help customers get more out of their recruiting process
  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply!

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
