raw.description:
Company Overview (Who are we? Why should you join us?)

At ecoATM the proof of our success is in our staggering growth, extraordinary impact on protecting the planet, and providing a work culture unlike any other. We are a technology company and a pioneer of device re-commerce. Through our 7,000 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.

At ecoATM we know our employees are our greatest strength and the key to our continued growth and success. When you join our team, you will enjoy more than just a job, you will be empowered to develop and utilize your unique talents and skills to build a rewarding career while making a lasting, positive impact on the planet.

Our Values and Leadership Behaviors

About the Role

ecoATM is hiring a Director, Tax reporting to our Chief Accounting Officer (CAO). This roleowns ecoATM's global tax function end to end; tax planning, the quarterly and annual income tax provision under ASC 740, and all U.S. federal, state, local, and non-U.S. compliance. The role is the company's principal internal tax authority and the primary point of contact for external tax advisors, the external auditors, and taxing authorities.

This is a hands-on, build-and-run role. ecoATM co-sources significant compliance and advisory work, such as sales and use tax, property tax, direct tax, and business license registrations, so the Director is accountable for scoping, directing, reviewing, and controlling the cost of third-party providers rather than delegating judgment to them. Emphasis is heaviest on tax planning, the provision, and compliance execution; international and U.S. international tax (GILTI/FDII, Subpart F, Pillar Two monitoring, transfer pricing, and a small non-U.S. footprint) is a required competency but a modest share of the overall workload.

The role partners closely with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, and business leadership on transaction support, entity structure, cash tax planning, and audit readiness, and reports to the Chief Accounting Officer.

This is a visible role. The Director will interact regularly with the CFO, the CEO, and ecoATM's private equity sponsors, and must be able to explain a tax position in plain English to people who are not tax specialists.

Over time, ecoATM expects to bring elements of the tax provision and compliance in house and build a small internal tax team. The Director is expected to assess what should move in house, make the case, and lead that build; the ideal candidate wants to grow a function, not just run an outsourced one.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Planning & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the company's tax planning agenda — effective tax rate management, cash tax optimization, credits and incentives, entity rationalization, and NOL and attribute utilization and preservation (including Section 382 monitoring).
  • Model the tax consequences of business initiatives, capital structure changes, acquisitions, dispositions, restructurings, and financing transactions; present clear, decision-ready recommendations to the CAO and CFO.
  • Identify and drive federal, state, and local planning opportunities, including R&D credits, fixed asset and cost segregation positions, state apportionment and nexus planning, and sales and use tax exposure reduction.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enacted and proposed legislation and assess its impact on the company's rate, cash taxes, and structure.
  • Evaluate and document uncertain tax positions and establish the company's position on material judgments.

Tax Provision (ASC 740)

  • Own the quarterly and annual income tax provision end to end: current and deferred computations, rate reconciliation, return-to-provision true-ups, valuation allowance analysis, FIN 48 / ASC 740-10 reserves, and deferred tax roll-forwards.
  • Prepare or review all tax-related financial statement disclosures and supporting schedules, and coordinate deliverables with the external auditors to a clean, on-time close.
  • Maintain provision models and documentation to an auditable standard, with clear support, review evidence, and version control.
  • Own tax-related SOX controls, narratives, and walkthroughs; remediate deficiencies on schedule.
  • Forecast the effective tax rate and cash taxes in partnership with FP&A and Treasury, including quarterly estimated payment requirements.

Tax Compliance & Third-Party Provider Management

  • Own the complete compliance calendar and ensure timely, accurate filing of all U.S. federal, state, and local income and franchise tax returns, extensions, and estimated payments.
  • Direct third-party providers across sales and use tax, property tax, and direct taxes — scope engagements, set deliverable standards and deadlines, review output critically, and negotiate and control fees.
  • Own business license registrations and renewals with applicable states and localities, including nexus studies, registrations, and exemption certificate management.
  • Oversee non-U.S. filings and statutory tax reporting for the company's foreign entities in coordination with local advisors.
  • Manage federal, state, and local tax audits, notices, and information requests end to end, including strategy, responses, and settlement recommendations.
  • Support 1099, W-9, and other information reporting in partnership with Accounts Payable and Payroll.
  • Maintain the tax basis balance sheet, fixed asset tax depreciation, and supporting workpapers.
  • Retain ownership of all technical conclusions and filing positions; providers deliver scale and specialty depth, not judgment.

International & U.S. International Tax

  • Oversee U.S. international calculations and reporting — GILTI, FDII, BEAT, Subpart F, foreign tax credits, Forms 5471/8858/8975 and related disclosures — with support from external specialists.
  • Maintain intercompany and transfer pricing arrangements, including intercompany agreements, documentation, local files, and periodic benchmarking; coordinate intercompany charges with Accounting.
  • Monitor Pillar Two / global minimum tax developments, permanent establishment risk, withholding tax, and VAT/GST obligations relevant to the company's footprint, and escalate exposures with recommended actions.
  • Support cross-border cash repatriation, funding, and entity structure decisions in partnership with Treasury and Legal.

Process, Systems & Leadership

  • Build and continuously improve tax processes, workpapers, calendars, and documentation so the function is repeatable, controlled, and transferable.
  • Drive automation and data quality across tax data sourcing from Oracle and the data warehouse; reduce manual preparation and shorten provision cycle time.
  • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, and Procurement, translating tax requirements into practical business guidance.
  • Provide clear, concise reporting to the CAO, CFO, CEO, the Board, and the company's private equity sponsors on tax risk, effective rate, cash taxes, and open matters — translating technical positions into plain English and a clear recommendation.
  • Represent the company's tax position directly in sponsor, board, lender, and diligence discussions, responding to questions on the spot with confidence and without jargon.
  • Assess which elements of the tax provision and compliance currently performed by third parties should be brought in house, build the business case, and lead the transition — including the people, process, systems and documentation required to run them internally.
  • Operate initially as a working individual contributor, then hire, coach and develop a small in-house tax team as scope moves in house; establish cross-training and documented desktop procedures so there are no single points of failure.
  • Support transaction, financing, diligence, and IPO- or exit-readiness workstreams as required.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA and/or Master's in Taxation (MST) highly desirable. JD/LLM in Taxation considered.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive corporate tax experience, including a mix of public accounting (Big 4 or large regional) and in-house corporate tax.
  • Deep, demonstrable ownership of the ASC 740 income tax provision, including deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Strong federal and multistate income tax compliance experience in a multi-entity, multi-state environment.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. international tax concepts (GILTI, Subpart F, FTCs, Forms 5471) and transfer pricing fundamentals, with the judgment to know when to engage a specialist.
  • Proven track record of managing third-party tax providers and advisors to scope, budget, and deadline.
  • Experience with tax planning, compliance, and audit support within a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization.
  • Experience transitioning outsourced tax work in house and building or scaling an internal tax team is a strong plus.
  • Experience operating in a SOX-compliant or audited environment, including tax control design and documentation.
  • Preferred: private-equity-backed or pre-IPO experience; partnership / LLC taxation; Oracle EBS or comparable ERP; tax provision or compliance software (e.g., OneSource, Corptax, Avalara/Vertex); Snowflake, Power BI or Alteryx.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Comprehensive understanding of federal, state, local, and international tax laws, with the ability to interpret complex statutes and apply them in practical, real-world scenarios.
  • Advanced proficiency in tax research and analysis, using authoritative resources to resolve intricate issues and provide strategic recommendations.
  • Expertise in tax software, accounting systems, and data management tools to streamline tax processes and enhance accuracy.
  • Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large ERP data sets; strong analytical and modeling ability.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with proven aptitude for identifying risks and opportunities in filings and planning strategies.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate complex tax positions in plain English to non-tax audiences — the CFO, CEO, the Board, private equity sponsors, auditors, and regulatory authorities — and to state the conclusion and the recommendation up front.
  • Executive presence and credibility in front of senior stakeholders, including comfort being challenged on a position and defending it clearly.
  • Ability to mentor, guide, and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.
  • High ethical standards and sound judgment in handling confidential financial information and facilitating transparent reporting practices.
  • Ability to use Claude and other AI tools effectively for tax research, analysis, workpapers, and reporting.

Measures of Success (First 12 Months)

  • Quarterly and annual provisions delivered within the close calendar with no material audit adjustments and no significant deficiencies in tax controls.
  • A complete, documented, and current tax compliance calendar with 100% on-time filing and payment across all jurisdictions.
  • A documented, auditable provision and compliance workpaper set that a successor or reviewer can pick up without rework.
  • Third-party provider spend at or below budget, with scope, deliverables, and fees clearly defined and tracked.
  • At least two quantified planning opportunities identified and executed, with measurable rate or cash tax benefit.
  • All open notices, audits, and exposures inventoried, assessed, and either resolved or on a documented plan.
  • A recommendation delivered on which provision and compliance activities should move in house, with cost, resourcing, and a phased transition plan.

Business Travel (How much will you travel?)

  • <10%

Location (Where will you be working?)

  • Remote; must reside in the United States
Pay Range (How much might you earn in your base salary?)
  • $176,700 - $233,200 Annually
This position is eligible for short-term and long-term incentives based on individual and company performance.

Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This information is provided per CA SB 1162 (“CA Pay Transparency Law”). Base pay information is based on market location. Learn more about ecoATM benefits here.

This position may also be eligible for short-term and long-term incentives based on individual and company performance.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Here at ecoATM/Gazelle we value diversity & belonging and are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic, and are fairly and equitably compensated based on current market data. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know.

Job Title: Arrears Executive - Remote
Working Pattern: 36.25 hours per week with contractual hours stated as Monday to Saturday between 8am to 7pm (with a 45-minute lunch break). Saturday shifts take place on the last Saturday of each month, from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Working rota to be shared by Line Manager. 
Salary: up to £31,000 and up to 20% bonus and benefits
Location: Remote

💚 Shaping the future of sustainable digital banking

Launched in 2014 as one of the UK’s original challenger banks, Tandem is proudly headquartered in the Northwest, with over 500 people working across the UK. 

People join Tandem because they want to shape something meaningful. Here, you’ll use your skills to create products that empower people to make better financial choices and lower their environmental impact. We’re big enough to drive real change, small enough for every voice to be heard, and united by a shared purpose that inspires us to move forward - together. 

Recognised in The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for 2024 and 2025, Tandem has also been named in The Sunday Times 100 Tech list for two consecutive years in 2025 and 2026 – a list of the fastest growing tech companies in Britain, reflective of our growing industry presence. Tandem was also awarded Investor in Customers’ Gold Standard based on customer and employee feedback and is a Certified™ Great Place to Work®. 

Tandem is growing fast and helping to shape the future of sustainable banking.

Your team: Collaborators in change

Tandem is proud to offer a workplace with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds which leads to a unique company culture for our people and a better experience for our customers.

This is a key role in ensuring that the fair treatment of customers is embedded within the Operations team whilst ensuring that fair customer outcomes are consistently delivered. The purpose of the role is to support the Operations Leaders by supporting customers in financial difficulty and arrears whilst achieving departmental service levels. Upholding company standards and complying with all relevant Company and regulatory obligations (including adherence to FCA rules (including FCA MCOB and CONC rules).   

Led by our Operations Director, our Operations teams are responsible for all customer contact.  The teams are the primary points of contact for customers including responding to their inbound queries during the lifetime of their mortgage or loan as well as supporting customers that are in financial difficulty and/or arrears. Our aim is to provide an exceptional service to our customers by ensuring that we have knowledgeable, well training operational colleagues to deliver the service that our customers expect of us.   

Your Impact: Building a sustainable tomorrow

As an Arrears Executive at Tandem your focus will be on:

  • Proactively service requests from our customers efficiently and professionally ensuring at you provide the customer with the information that they require. 
  • Proactively manage all customer service-related inbound communication (via telephone, correspondence, email, portal) from customers and third parties as part of the servicing and arrears management of a range of mortgage and loan products.
  • Ensure regulatory transactional documentation is issued accurately and correctly in accordance with regulatory requirements (including regulatory arrears correspondence). 
  • Identify situations that may require specialist handling (e.g. complaints, vulnerability, fraud) and refer these where appropriate. 
  • Knowledge and practical application of handling customer complaints, to include identifying complaints, logging and investigating with an aim to putting a resolution in place. 
  • Knowledge and practical application of dealing with vulnerable customers at first point of contact to ensure their specific needs are understood and they are treated with care and consideration. 
  • Proactively manage accounts in arrears by completing outbound contact to establish the root cause of the customers payment difficulties and identify options to assist the customer in rehabilitating their mortgage or loan arrears.  
  • Negotiate with customers and authorised third parties in financial difficulty regarding how to repay their arrears taking into consideration their individual personal circumstances. 
  • Knowledge and practical application of completing Income and Expenditure assessments and deciding suitable forbearance options for the customer.  
  • Knowledge and practical application of late arrears and litigation practices. 
  • Ensure that all customer contact both written and verbal is conducted within Company standards, FCA regulations, Customer Complaint procedures and that the principles of TCF are upheld consistently with all customers. 
  • Attain and maintain own competence to Group Training and Competence Framework demonstrated by ongoing adherence. 
  • Proactively challenge existing processes and take ownership for implementing positive changes which are within own span of control. 
  • Keep up to date with all Company/regulatory changes particularly those which affect own business area. 
  • Actively contribute to the achievement of the Company Balance Scorecard objectives and demonstrating Company values in everything you do. 
  • Adherence to and promotion of a culture of treating our customers fairly to deliver fair outcomes.   

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Previous experience in financial services (with relevant regulatory appreciation) with demonstrable success in customer service and arrears within a regulated lending environment. 
  • Demonstrable experience of working accounts in arrears including applying arrears forbearance options and identification of customers that are vulnerable. 
  • Demonstrable experience of collecting arrears for mortgages and loans with knowledge of how own and team performance affects wider Company objectives. 
  • Demonstrable knowledge of FCA rules (including MCOB and CONC rules), delivering fair outcomes to customers, CCA and GDPR regulations. 
  • A working knowledge of customer services and arrears management in a regulated, lending environment.

Rewards that reflect your value, what’s in it for you?

At Tandem, your hard work is rewarded in many ways, and we have an enhanced employee benefits package on offer from your very first day with us:

  • 25 days annual leave plus 8 days Bank Holiday
  • An additional day off for a ‘celebration day’ including, but not limited to, birthdays, weddings, religious holidays, graduations etc
  • Buy or sell up to 5 days holiday a year
  • Healthcare cash plan through Westfield Health
  • Life Assurance at 3 x salary
  • Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme
  • Cycle to Work salary sacrifice scheme and a free helmet
  • Salary sacrifice Pension contribution*, 4% employee contributions matched with 4% Tandem contribution (*Subject to salary eligibility)
  • Smart Tech scheme (buy goods with 0% interest)
  • 10% discount on solar panels
  • Tandem Hub for treats, cash back and discounts on UK retailers
  • 2 days per year paid volunteering
  • Free cereal, snacks and drinks in all offices
  • Quarterly team social budgets

Please note, some benefits are subject to eligibility criteria, such as passing your probation.

Our Green Deal: Your Impact Amplified

A little welcome gift from us to you, we’ll plant a tree in the Tandem Grove and you can enter into our “Green Deal” below:

  • Volunteer 2 days a year for charity > receive an early Friday finish
  • Raise £200 per annum for charity > Tandem provide PR and marketing support
  • Have renewable energy at home > receive an additional 1 day annual leave
  • Drive an electric car > receive £500 towards a home charger

Ready to make your mark?

Apply now and let's pave the way to a greener world, together. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. We will close adverts once we have received enough applications so please apply asap if you’re interested in the role.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at Tandem works primarily on a direct sourcing model and does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list. We are not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company. You can find our Applicant Privacy Policy on our Careers page.

Tandem is an equal opportunity employer and are committed to meeting our responsibilities under the Equality Act (2010). We respect the diverse experience and talents that every individual brings to our Company, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

Please be aware that background checking (including credit, criminal records and CIFAS Internal Fraud Database Checks) form part of our recruitment process. We will adhere to our duties under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974.

About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are a fast growing healthcare company specializing in whole body MRI screening - pioneering WB-MRI’s utility within a preventative healthcare and innovative clinical radiology practice. Our patient mix includes a combination of self-referred patients as well as physician-referred, from primary care doctors as well as specialists.

We are looking to expand our team of Radiologists for our rapidly growing practice across North America. Ideally you are a Radiologist with a strong MRI foundation. For Canadian-based Radiologists, a BC License is required.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

Why Join Prenuvo?

Prenuvo was founded by a radiologist who wanted a better way to practice—one that values quality, flexibility, and meaning.

Here, your time is respected, your work is supported, and your focus stays on what matters most: helping patients.

  • Independent Contractor (1099): Enjoy true autonomy while meeting agreed weekly volume goals.
  • Fully Remote: We provide the workstation and full IT support.
  • No Call. No Nights. No Shifts: Create a schedule that fits your life.
  • Competitive Earning Potential: High-reward compensation that recognizes expertise, accuracy, and quality—with the flexibility to scale volume and income on your terms.
  • Collaborative Team: Work alongside fellowship-trained radiologists in Body MRI, Neuroradiology, Musculoskeletal, and Breast Imaging.
  • Smart Technology: Advanced MRI systems, AI-supported tools, and efficient PACS workflows designed to help you do your best work.

What You’ll Do

  • Interpret Prenuvo whole-body MRI and preventive imaging studies, producing high-quality, clinically meaningful reports.
  • Communicate clear, actionable findings to patients and referring clinicians.
  • Participate in peer review, educational discussions, and continuous quality improvement within a collegial network.
  • Share urgent or unexpected results promptly and thoughtfully.
  • Uphold Prenuvo’s standards for diagnostic excellence, compassion, and consistency.

What You’ll Bring

  • Licensed with the appropriate board - must be a fellow of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada.
  • Licensed within British Columbia, Canada at minimum
  • Must stay current with CME credits
  • For Canadian applicants - must maintain membership in the Canadian Medical Protective Association & must participate in the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada MOC program
  • A body MRI fellowship is a bonus

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • $400 CAD per read

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. Your primary mission is to drive revenue, relentlessly hitting the phones to seek and seize opportunities, turning cold calls into warm connections, and exceeding sales targets. You thrive on performance metrics and are motivated by the thrilling challenge of continuously raising the bar.

raw.description:
Crypto-Fiat Digital Banking Venture

Location: Remote (Europe preferred) | International travel required

Salary: Negotiable / Flexible, based on experience and profile

About the Opportunity

Our client is a private investment group led by successful technology entrepreneurs with extensive experience in building and scaling international businesses across technology, fintech and digital industries.

The group is now preparing to launch a new crypto-fiat digital banking venture, connecting digital assets with traditional financial services. The planned offering includes crypto-to-fiat conversion, digital wallets, payment cards and banking payment solutions, with opportunities across both B2B and B2C markets.

The venture is backed by experienced investors, with an established technological foundation, payment processing capabilities and technical expertise already in place.

The next step is to bring on board a strong commercial leader who can turn this foundation into a successful, scalable international business.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial CEO or Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) with direct experience in crypto banking, crypto-fiat payments or closely related fintech businesses, and a proven ability to launch, build and scale commercial operations.

The Role

This is an opportunity for an ambitious executive who wants to build a business rather than simply manage an existing one.

You will play a key role in shaping the company's commercial direction, defining its market positioning, identifying growth opportunities and building the team and processes required to bring the business to market.

We are particularly interested in individuals who have already been through the journey of launching and scaling a fintech business, understand what drives growth and profitability, and know how to turn business opportunities into measurable results.

You should be equally comfortable developing strategy and getting personally involved in execution. You don't need a large corporate structure or extensive resources to make things happen.

The ideal candidate will bring a genuine entrepreneurial mindset, strong commercial judgement and the ambition to become a long-term business partner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the company's commercial and go-to-market strategy.
  • Identify and develop profitable opportunities across B2B and B2C customer segments and international markets.
  • Build and optimise the business model, revenue streams and unit economics.
  • Lead customer acquisition and growth initiatives, including performance marketing, partnerships and business development.
  • Establish strategic relationships with relevant financial institutions, payment providers and industry partners.
  • Work closely with product and technology leadership to shape a competitive offering and accelerate market launch.
  • Build and lead a lean, high-performing commercial team, establishing efficient processes and clear performance objectives.
  • Take ownership of commercial performance, budgets and financial results, with a strong focus on sustainable growth and profitability.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven senior leadership experience within crypto banking, crypto-fiat fintech, digital asset payments or crypto-enabled neobanking businesses.
  • Demonstrated success in launching, building or significantly scaling a fintech business, product or commercial operation.
  • Strong expertise in business development, commercial strategy, growth and customer acquisition.
  • Practical knowledge of performance marketing, acquisition channels and growth economics.
  • Solid understanding of P&L management, unit economics, revenue models and profitability drivers.
  • Established professional network within the crypto, fintech, payments or digital banking ecosystem.
  • Experience building and leading teams in dynamic, fast-growing businesses.
  • Ability to identify market opportunities, make independent decisions and deliver measurable commercial results.
  • Strong execution skills, commercial instinct and a hands-on approach to leadership.
  • Above all, we are looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset — a leader who takes ownership, moves quickly and is motivated by building a successful business from the ground up.
  • You may already be a CEO, or you may be an accomplished CCO or commercial leader ready to take the next step into broader business leadership.

What's on Offer

  • A genuine business-building opportunity:Play a central role in launching and scaling a new international crypto-fiat fintech venture.
  • Experienced investment backing: Work alongside successful technology entrepreneurs who bring capital, industry expertise and an existing technical foundation.
  • Autonomy and influence: Help shape the company's strategy, commercial model, team and long-term direction.
  • Flexible and competitive compensation:The remuneration package is open for discussion. Our client is prepared to consider attractive, individually tailored terms for exceptional candidates with the right experience and track record.
  • Participation in outcomes:Performance-based incentives, profit participation or equity arrangements will be discussed as part of an individually tailored compensation package.
  • International flexibility: Remote working arrangements, with a preference for Europe-based candidates who are comfortable with regular business travel.

Interested?

If you have experience building and scaling businesses in crypto banking or crypto-fiat fintech, and are looking for an opportunity to take on greater ownership and entrepreneurial responsibility, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

Reach out to our Associate Partner at or via Telegram @tmalinouskaya to discuss more.

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.

We recognize that to do your best work, you have to be your best self.
It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.

Our culture is one of belonging.
We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join others who value a workplace for all.
We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.
Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:

Working closely with product owners, scrum masters, developers, QA, business analysts, configuration admins, integration, security, and data teams, this role directs the technical execution of a Salesforce delivery pod supporting Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams. Serves as a technical resource responsible for organizing and guiding all technical aspects of day-to-day support and project delivery, translating business priorities into implementable Salesforce solutions, enforcing platform standards, coordinating technical work across disciplines, and ensuring high-quality delivery through agile/scrum practices, disciplined release execution, and strong technical documentation.

Platform scope: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud where applicable, Data Cloud integrations, Salesforce platform configuration, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, and connected enterprise systems.

What you will do:

  • Lead and coordinate all technical aspects of a Salesforce pod that includes developers, QA, analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring technical work is organized, sequenced, estimated, reviewed, and delivered consistently across agile/scrum ceremonies and release cycles.
  • Provide senior hands-on technical leadership for Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams, including day-to-day operational work, enhancements, production support, and project-based delivery.
  • Translate business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into scalable Salesforce technical designs and implementation plans that align with platform standards, architecture direction, security expectations, and agile delivery commitments.
  • Guide developers and configuration admins on solution approach, design tradeoffs, platform-native patterns, reuse opportunities, and technical debt management while maintaining accountability for technical quality across the pod.
  • Review and direct configuration, automation, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL, REST/SOAP API, Visualforce where applicable, and Salesforce integration work to ensure solutions are secure, maintainable, performant, and governor-limit aware.
  • Partner with product owners, scrum masters, and analysts to refine backlog items, define technical tasks, identify dependencies, manage technical risks, and ensure readiness for sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, and support handoff.
  • Lead technical design reviews and participate in architecture, security, integration, and platform governance forums when required, ensuring designs obtain appropriate approvals and exceptions are documented.
  • Coordinate with QA to define test strategy, support automated and manual testing, validate acceptance criteria, ensure adequate unit test coverage, and resolve defects across configuration, custom code, integrations, data, and user experience components.
  • Support CI/CD and release management activities, including source control discipline, branching, build validation, deployment planning, release readiness, change control, rollback planning, and post-deployment verification.
  • Identify, communicate, and manage technical risks, issues, dependencies, and impediments across the pod, escalating when needed and recommending practical mitigation options.
  • Lead technical troubleshooting for production issues, platform events, integration failures, data integrity concerns, governor limit issues, access/security issues, and performance problems in collaboration with support and platform teams.
  • Ensure Salesforce security controls are implemented appropriately, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, field-level security, object permissions, secure integration patterns, and least-privilege access principles.
  • Support data migration, data quality, data mapping, and data lifecycle activities, including ETL coordination, validation, reconciliation, and remediation for complex Salesforce initiatives.
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation, including design notes, diagrams, runbooks, deployment notes, code review outcomes, environment considerations, and operational support procedures.
  • Coach and mentor Salesforce developers, admins, and analysts on platform best practices, code and configuration standards, agile execution, estimation, documentation, testing discipline, and release quality.
  • Continuously assess Salesforce platform capabilities, seasonal releases, AppExchange products, and ecosystem tooling to recommend improvements that increase reliability, maintainability, user value, and delivery velocity.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Data Science, Computer Science, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Seven to ten years of Salesforce platform experience with strong hands-on development and configuration experience, including experience serving as a senior developer, technical lead, or comparable senior technical role on enterprise Salesforce delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical execution for agile/scrum teams or pods supporting a mix of project delivery, enhancements, configuration, QA, and operational support work.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Salesforce development and configuration, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce Flow, APIs, security configuration, declarative automation, and platform configuration patterns.
  • Ability to direct technical work across developers, QA, analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring clear work breakdown, sequencing, estimation, dependency management, sprint readiness, and delivery accountability.
  • Strong understanding of agile/scrum delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, definition of ready, definition of done, and technical task management.
  • Experience supporting Sales Cloud and Service Cloud capabilities, including case management, account/contact models, sales/service processes, queues, routing, activities, automation, reports, dashboards, and role-based access models.
  • Experience with Salesforce configuration and administration practices, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, page layouts, Lightning record pages, validation rules, flows, approvals, objects, fields, and metadata management.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security and sharing, including least-privilege design, field-level security, object permissions, sharing models, auditability, and privacy-aware configuration.
  • Understanding of integration patterns and technologies relevant to Salesforce, including REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, platform events, middleware, batch integrations, and secure error handling and monitoring practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps and SDLC practices, including source control, CI/CD, deployment pipelines, packaging or metadata deployment approaches, branching strategies, automated testing, and release governance.
  • Ability to review code, configuration, technical designs, test plans, and deployment plans to ensure quality, maintainability, scalability, performance, and alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce governor limits, performance tuning, bulkification, asynchronous processing, large data volume considerations, selective querying, data archiving, and high-volume transaction patterns.
  • Experience troubleshooting Salesforce production issues, including integration failures, automation errors, data quality issues, security access problems, platform events, governor limits, and user experience defects.
  • Ability to identify and manage technical risks, issues, dependencies, and impediments, communicate impacts clearly, and drive timely resolution across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to produce and maintain clear technical documentation, diagrams, design notes, deployment notes, operational runbooks, and support handoff materials.
  • Ability to mentor and coach technical team members, promote standards adoption, support technical skill development, and foster consistent delivery practices across the pod.
  • Ability to partner effectively with product owners, business stakeholders, scrum masters, analysts, architects, security, integration, data, QA, release management, and operations teams.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce seasonal releases, AppExchange products, platform roadmap considerations, and the ability to evaluate new capabilities for business value, risk, and operational maturity.
  • Experience designing and supporting Salesforce solutions in regulated environments with awareness of privacy, auditability, data protection, retention, encryption where applicable, and secure integration practices.
  • Proficient communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and delivery impacts clearly.
  • Comfortable working in agile/scrum delivery models and able to operate within waterfall, hybrid, or governance-driven processes when required.

The extras:

  • Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, or Sharing and Visibility Architect.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another environment with strong privacy, auditability, and data protection requirements.
  • Experience with Financial Services Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce/Einstein capabilities, OmniStudio, or other Salesforce cloud capabilities relevant to customer/member-facing and internal service workflows.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems and middleware such as MuleSoft, Informatica Cloud, APIs, event-driven patterns, contact center platforms, document management platforms, identity platforms, ServiceNow, or core business systems.
  • Experience leading or coordinating complex data migration, ETL, data quality, and reconciliation efforts.
  • Experience working in a global delivery model or with blended internal, vendor, and offshore development teams.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

Our culture of belonging at Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island (BCBSRI) is at the core of all we do, and it strengthens our ability to meet the challenges of today’s healthcare industry. BCBSRI is an equal opportunity employer.

We are looking for a Student Retention Specialist to support students in their learning journey and help them stay committed to their educational goals.

This role is responsible for driving student engagement, retention, and overall satisfaction by building meaningful relationships, identifying potential challenges, and providing proactive support. You will work closely with students to help them stay motivated, overcome obstacles, and successfully achieve their educational goals.

What we can offer you

raw.title: Associate Director, Client Services

raw.description:
Job Highlights:

  • AdAge and Inc Magazine have named Silverback one of the best places to work.

  • We are hiring an Associate Director of Client Services.

  • Salary band is $120k-$160k with legit bonus and benefits.

  • This is an opportunity to make a big impact at a smaller agency.

Today, we're looking for an Associate Director, Client Services to join our team. Our new Associate Director will serve as the strategic lead and trusted advisor for a portfolio of some of Silverback's most important client relationships. You'll own client health from end to end: understanding each client's business, connecting marketing performance to real business outcomes, spotting risk before it turns into churn, and finding the next opportunity to grow the partnership.

This isn't a hands-on-keys role. You won't be building campaigns in Google Ads or Meta, but you'll need to understand what those platforms are telling you, and what they're not. You'll work alongside our Paid Media, SEO, Measurement, and Creative teams to turn performance data into a clear story for clients, and you'll partner with delivery teams to make sure every account is both successful for the client and healthy for Silverback. This role is ideal for a seasoned client services leader who thrives on big-picture thinking, loves a good puzzle, and wants a real seat at the table.

Here's what we expect from our Associate Director, Client Services.

—What You'll Do—

    • Client Strategy: Understand each client's business and marketing performance through data analysis, and develop cross-functional marketing strategies that ladder up to their business goals.
    • Performance Analysis: Analyze paid media performance across your portfolio by triangulating data from Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, and client CRMs. When platform-reported conversions don't match pipeline in the CRM, you're the one who figures out why and explains it clearly.
    • Client Care: Build healthy, long-lasting client relationships through active listening and follow-through. Proactively monitor positive and negative client feedback to identify and mitigate churn risk before it affects the relationship.
    • Client Retention & Growth: Own retention and revenue growth for your portfolio. Identify strategic upsell and cross-sell opportunities, partner with our sales team on expansions, and lead the way through crisis moments with steady, solutions-first communication.
    • Delivery Margin Management: Partner with delivery teams to build 3-month rolling plans that balance client performance goals with margin targets. When an account is off track, dig into the root cause and resolve it through process changes, expectation resets, or rescopes.
    • Process Improvement: Regularly surface opportunities to improve how we work, whether that means increasing client value, eliminating waste, or making our people's jobs easier.
    • Client Innovation: Stay on top of changes in the marketing industry, understand how they impact your clients, and help clients navigate and capitalize on that change. Turn client wins into case studies that fuel our marketing.
    • Thought Leadership: Contribute a weekly news insight and point of view to keep our team and clients ahead of the curve.

—What We're Looking For—

    • Years of Experience: 7+ years of client services, account management, or client strategy experience, with at least 4 years at a digital or performance marketing agency. Previous agency experience is a must-have.
    • Paid Media Fluency: You don't need to be a platform expert, but you need to speak the language. You're comfortable with the metrics Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, and CRMs report out, and you know how to triangulate them to find the real story.
    • Deductive Reasoning: When something doesn't add up, you work the problem. You connect the dots across data sources, client conversations, and team input to get to the root cause and the right next step.
    • Communication: Your verbal and written communication is sharp, clear, and confident. You can explain a complex performance story to a CMO in plain English and write an email that gets a stalled decision moving.
    • Self-Awareness: You know your strengths, own your blind spots, and actively seek feedback. You read the room well, both with clients and with your team.

raw.description:
The Information and Communications Technology Council (ICTC) is seeking a rigorous, analytically strong Economist to support economic research that underpins Canada's digital transformation. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Economic Research, this role will dedicate 50% of its time to executing ICTC's major labour market information (LMI) initiatives. The successful candidate will also contribute to ICTC's national policy, economic outlook, and workforce development work.

The ideal candidate brings solid knowledge of Canada's digital economy, LMI, economic forecasting, and workforce transformation, along with a track record of data-driven analysis and the ability to translate complex economic findings into actionable intelligence for Canadians, businesses, and policymakers.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution

  • In collaboration with internal teams, carry out the methodology for ICTC's labour market outlook reports, conducting longitudinal and cross-sectoral labour market analysis.
  • Support the preparation of quarterly economic briefs that distill current labour trends and digital economy shifts into accessible knowledge for industry leaders.
  • Support the development of LMI dashboards and tools that reflect occupational shifts, emerging technologies, and regional skills demand.
  • Work with partners and stakeholders across provinces and territories to align federal and provincial LMI data and inform evidence-based workforce planning.
  • Help develop and maintain the ICT LMI Hub for Canadian businesses and policymakers.
  • Participate in advisory council activities, co-design sessions, and external events as needed to validate findings and strengthen industry relevance.
  • Collaborate with qualitative and quantitative researchers and policy analysts on integrated, mixed-methods research initiatives.
  • Translate project objectives into research questions, analytical plans, and deliverables, identifying data requirements, dependencies, and methodological risks early.
  • Manage assigned research workstreams, monitor progress against timelines, and communicate emerging findings, limitations, and delivery risks to the project lead.
  • Conduct literature reviews and jurisdictional scans to inform the LMO, assessing Canadian and international evidence on digital economy trends, skills, and workforce policies.
  • Contribute to the design and delivery of the KII’s and longitudinal employer surveys, analyze hiring intentions, skills gaps, and technology adoption, and maintain consistency across survey waves.

Economic Analysis and Expertise

  • Build working knowledge of Canada's digital economy and contribute to publications, conferences, and stakeholder engagements
  • Produce research papers, sector briefs, and data-driven insights on the changing landscape of Canada's ICT labour market.
  • Analyze how automation, AI, cybersecurity, clean tech, digital infrastructure, and other emerging technologies and priority areas shape skills demand across sectors.
  • Examine employment, wages, productivity, and job quality alongside skills demand to provide a fuller picture of digital economy labour market conditions.
  • Contribute to ICTC's forecasting capabilities and economic modelling, including input-output models, integrating new data sources and methodologies.
  • Contribute to economic impact analyses of programs using a range of quantitative methods.

Data Governance and Innovation

  • Collect, integrate, and manage large, complex datasets from Statistics Canada, RTRA, Vicinity Jobs, and provincial sources.
  • Uphold data accessibility, reproducibility, and transparency in all analytical outputs.
  • Perform data cleaning, harmonization, and predictive analytics tasks, applying rigorous standards in longitudinal and cross-sectional research.
  • Maintain documented definitions and mappings for digital economy industries, occupations, and skills, supporting consistent measurement across datasets and publications.
  • Follow applicable data access, confidentiality, and disclosure requirements, and document how these affect analysis and reporting.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with ICTC's government relations, policy, and communications teams to disseminate findings in accessible formats.
  • Support engagement with external stakeholders, including government departments, academic institutions, research networks, and industry associations.
  • Contribute to grant proposals, stakeholder reports, and evidence-informed recommendations that support ICTC's strategic priorities.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Data Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in economic research, forecasting, and labour market analysis, ideally within a Canadian context.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to longitudinal research projects and producing dashboards, outlook reports, or applied workforce tools.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate economic insights to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience:

  • Labour market data and policy
  • Economic modelling (macroeconomic, sectoral, and input-output)
  • Data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Forecasting techniques and modelling

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience working with equity-deserving groups or inclusive labour policy.
  • Familiarity with LMI frameworks or intergovernmental data integration initiatives.
  • Experience working with occupational and industry classifications, skills taxonomies, or concordances between classification systems.
  • Bilingualism (English/French) is a strong asset.

Are you?

  • Driven and determined: Are you highly motivated, self-starting, and willing to go above and beyond, with the drive to improve and exceed goals?
  • Optimistic and results-driven:Are you able to think creatively and navigate barriers and obstacles? Do you stay focused on priority goals and results?
  • Dynamic, resilient, and flexible: Are you able to embrace the rapid pace of change, advances in technology, and uncertainty? Are you open to evolving requirements and continuous feedback, and able to work with remote teams across Canada?
  • A strategic, creative thinker: Are you skilled at analyzing complex situations, identifying patterns and trends, challenging assumptions, and generating options to solve problems and seize opportunities?
  • Collaborative: Are you able to work with and through others to achieve results, with the emotional intelligence to understand different perspectives, share information, and be a strong team player?
  • A sound decision-maker: Are you able to analyze situations carefully, seek diverse perspectives, and make decisions that align with strategic goals?
  • Ethical: Can you steward confidential information and data? This role requires high integrity, good judgment, confidentiality, and ethical compliance.
  • A champion of diversity and inclusion: Are you committed to understanding the issues and challenges faced by diverse groups?
  • An excellent communicator: Do you have outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to present ideas and proposals persuasively?
  • Reliable: Do you demonstrate reliability, organizational skills, and accountability to meet and exceed project and funder deliverable requirements?
  • Committed to lifelong learning: Do you stay abreast of industry trends, seek out new perspectives, and invest in your own professional growth?

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a dynamic, mission-driven, entrepreneurial organization committed to advancing Canada's competitive advantage in the digital economy.
  • Lead high-impact programs that drive economic growth and shape the future of Canadian businesses.
  • Work in an agile, collaborative, innovative, and forward-thinking environment where we are always helping each other achieve collective goals.

Location

Remote (anywhere in Canada).

ICTC is a neutral, not-for-profit national centre of expertise with the mission of strengthening Canada's digital advantage in the global economy. Our goal is to ensure that technology is utilized to drive economic growth and innovation, and that Canada's workforce remains competitive on a global scale.

  • OUR VISION IS TO: Foster globally competitive Canadian industries and a prosperous society empowered by innovative digital solutions.

raw.title: Forward Deployed <HR> Engineer
raw.excerpt: About the RoleWhen a staffing firm or high-volume employer signs with Onboarded, the contract is the starting line.
raw.description:
About the Role

When a staffing firm or high-volume employer signs with Onboarded, the contract is the starting line. Their compliance work has to run, and run right: I-9 and E-Verify, background checks, state and federal forms, tax credits, union agreements, credentials. Every customer's version is different. We're looking for engineers to embed with our direct customers and build those workflows end to end.

You'll be embedded in two or three strategic customer accounts at a time. You learn how their hiring actually works across states, worker types and systems, then build it on Onboarded: forms as code, policies, automations, and integrations to their ATS, HRIS and payroll. You own the build from first discovery through go-live, and you answer for how fast the customer goes live and whether the work is right. Sales opens the account. Customer Engineering supports it at steady state. You build in the middle.

Onboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right. We never built I-9 as a feature. We built primitives, and every customer build turns implementation into code we reuse. What you build for one customer becomes a package for the next, and what you learn in the field shapes the roadmap.

We're casting a wide net. Maybe you've been a forward deployed engineer at an AI or data company, a solutions engineer who writes real code, an integration engineer, or a founder. What matters is that you ship production-quality code, you're energized by messy customer problems, and you use AI as a force multiplier.

What You'll Do

  • Embed with strategic customers. Work alongside their HR, operations, legal and IT teams. Map how a worker goes from hired to ready to work across their systems, states and worker types, and find where it breaks.
  • Build compliance workflows as code. Implement each customer's requirements on Onboarded's primitives: forms, policies, entities, automations and integrations. Versioned, reviewed, and deployed across every entity they run.
  • Connect the customer's stack. Integrate Onboarded with their ATS, HRIS, payroll and screening vendors through our REST API, webhooks and MCP surfaces. Own the data model, the auth, and how records stay in sync.
  • Ship to production and own the outcome. Take each workflow from discovery to go-live. Monitor it, fix what breaks, and stand behind it when an auditor asks how it works.
  • Turn every build into something reusable. Every workflow you deliver should make the next one faster. Generalize what you build into packages and tooling the whole team uses, including AI agents that write configuration.
  • Bring the field back to product. Write clear specs for the gaps the core platform should close, prioritize hard, and be the first person to test what ships.

What We're Looking For

  • A builder who ships. 3+ years writing production code in a modern stack (TypeScript, Python or similar), or a track record shipping real systems as a founder. You get productive in an unfamiliar codebase fast.
  • Real integration skills. APIs, webhooks, authentication, data models, and keeping records in sync across systems you didn't build. You've made other people's systems work together at scale.
  • Customer-facing by choice. You can run discovery with an HR director in the morning and debug a payroll sync with their IT team in the afternoon. You earn trust by delivering.
  • Precision that holds up. Compliance work cannot be wrong. You know the difference between fast and right, and you deliver both.
  • AI-first operator. You use AI tools to write code, generate configuration, analyze requirements and prototype. This is non-negotiable.
  • Product judgment. You can take "we need it to do X" from a customer, find what they actually need, and come back with a crisp build or a clear no.

Experience in staffing, ATS or HRIS software, payroll, or employment compliance (I-9, E-Verify, background checks, tax forms) is a strong signal but not required. Learning velocity and an AI-first approach to closing the gap count just as much.

This role is not a fit for someone who wants a ticket queue, or who wants to write code far from the people who use it. It is for engineers who want to own the outcome and see their work run in the real world.

Why This Role

  • Your code puts people to work. Every workflow you ship decides whether a real person starts their job on time and compliantly. The stakes are real and so is the impact.
  • You'll build next to the people who built the engine. Our CTO and founders own customer accounts too. You'll have a direct line to them, Product and Engineering, and your field work shapes what the platform becomes.
  • There is a clear growth path. As we add strategic accounts, this role can grow into leading a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, moving into core platform engineering, or owning a product area.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing startup
  • Health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits
  • Remote-first culture with optional in-person collaboration
  • A chance to build the workflows that have to be right, for some of the largest employers and staffing firms in the country

How to Apply

Send a short introduction + your resume, LinkedIn or GitHub to . Include how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, and one story about something you built inside a customer's environment: what was messy, what you built, and what it changed. Bonus points if you tell us how you'd decide whether a customer request should be a one-off configuration or a reusable package.

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Principal Structural Engineer - Technical Reviewer to work on very high-level and technically challenging projects to join our team! In this role you will get to lend your bridge technical knowledge on an as-needed basis.


POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Principal Structural Engineer – Technical Reviewer (Casual) will provide independent technical oversight for structural engineering work on highway, transit, freight rail, and passenger rail projects on an as needed basis. With more than 30 years of structural engineering experience, this senior engineer will focus on checking and improving work prepared by junior and mid-level engineers, helping ensure that calculations, plans, specifications, and technical recommendations are accurate, coordinated, constructible, and consistent with applicable standards.

Working with project managers, discipline leads, and design teams, the reviewer will examine structural analyses and design packages at key milestones, identify technical and coordination issues, and provide clear, actionable comments. The position calls for sound judgment across bridges, retaining walls, culverts, foundations, and related transportation structures, along with a practical ability to explain why changes are needed and help engineers strengthen their work. The reviewer will contribute to quality planning, resolve difficult design questions, and support delivery from preliminary engineering through construction.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Principal Structural Engineer will apply deep technical experience to review structural work and build quality into project delivery. Responsibilities include:

  • Independently check structural calculations, analysis models, design assumptions, and engineering judgments prepared by junior and mid-level structural engineers; verify that methods, inputs, results, and conclusions are technically sound.
  • Review bridge, wall, culvert, foundation, and related structure plans, details, specifications, quantities, and cost estimates for accuracy, completeness, internal consistency, and constructability.
  • Evaluate design packages for compliance with AASHTO LRFD, IDOT, Illinois Tollway, and applicable AISC, ACI, and rail requirements; identify departures, unresolved risks, and coordination gaps before submittal.
  • Provide clear review comments, redlines, and documented dispositions; discuss findings with the responsible engineers, confirm corrections, and coach staff on sound analysis, detailing, and quality-control practices.
  • Review structural evaluations, rehabilitation concepts, load ratings, inspection findings, and construction-phase responses, including shop drawings, RFIs, and field issues, with attention to safety and serviceability.

Coordinate reviews with roadway, rail, geotechnical, drainage, traffic, CADD, and construction teams. Attend client meetings and project-site visits as needed to resolve technical questions and support timely delivery.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS:

Supervision Received

- Structural Practice Lead, Project Manager, or designated Technical Manager

Supervision Given

- Technical direction and mentoring for junior and mid-level structural engineers and design staff

Internal Contacts

- Project Managers, Structural Practice Leaders, bridge and rail engineers, roadway and geotechnical teams, CADD staff, quality managers, and construction support teams

External Contacts

- IDOT, Illinois Tollway, CDOT, CTA, Metra, Amtrak, Class I railroads, municipalities, contractors, and other project stakeholders

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • 30+ years of progressive structural or bridge engineering experience, including substantial responsibility for checking and quality review of work prepared by other engineers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering from an accredited program; a master’s degree is preferred.
  • Active Illinois Structural Engineer (S.E.) license.
  • Extensive experience with steel and concrete transportation structures, including bridge superstructures and substructures, foundations, retaining walls, and culverts.
  • Demonstrated ability to review structural calculations, analysis models, plans, specifications, technical reports, quantities, and cost estimates and to identify technical errors, omissions, and coordination conflicts.
  • Strong working knowledge of AASHTO LRFD, IDOT and Illinois Tollway procedures, and applicable AISC, ACI, and rail standards; proficiency with BlueBeam and bridge analysis/design software is expected.
  • Strong technical writing, communication, and mentoring skills, with the judgment to explain review findings constructively and support resolution of complex structural issues.

  • Quality assurance and quality control
  • Technical problem solving and risk identification

  • Coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Multidisciplinary coordination
  • Client and project team communication
  • Sound professional judgment and organization

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Department: Sales

Reports to: Director of Strategic Initiatives

Direct Reports: None

Type: Full-Time

Status: Exempt

Schedule: M-F

Salary: $55,000 - $75,000 + Quota Attainment Bonus

This position is posted nationally, and the base salary range reflects the broad geographic scope of our talent search. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate's specific location, along with relevant experience, skills, and internal equity.

About IPA

For over 30 years, IPA has been the trusted leader in automated infection prevention solutions — helping hospitals nationwide reduce infection risk and drive operational efficiency through our clariFy software solution that powers our scrubEx, alEx, and vendEx product lines. We don't just innovate; we deliver measurable impact for healthcare providers and their patients. As we continue expanding our reach within the community hospital segment, we're looking for an Inside Sales Representative who's ready to own a territory, build lasting relationships, and drive real revenue results — all from a remote environment.

This is an opportunity to join a respected organization with a strong brand, an established customer base, and significant room for growth. You'll have the autonomy to run your own book of business with the support of experienced sales leaders and cross-functional partners who are invested in your success.

If you excel at building relationships, managing a full sales cycle remotely, and creating long-term value for customers, we'd like to talk with you.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • This is not an appointment-setting role — its account of ownership, relationship development, and revenue execution.
  • You'll engage all existing IPA customers and prospective customers across IPA's target market segments, building trusted relationships with clinical, supply chain, and administrative stakeholders to drive growth. You'll drive new equipment sales, expand CoverCare service agreements, identify hosting and replacement opportunities, and activate new accounts — all through proactive outbound selling via phone, email, and virtual meetings.
  • Every win is earned through preparation, persistence, and disciplined pipeline execution.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a track record of quota attainment and know what it means to be accountable for a book of business from prospecting through close.
  • Consultative by nature. You lead with discovery, ask the right questions, and build credibility with diverse stakeholders — not just the person who answers the phone.
  • Disciplined in your process. You manage your pipeline with intention — same-day CRM updates, accurate forecasting, and next-step commitments at every stage.
  • Relentlessly proactive. You don't wait for opportunities to come to you. You create them through consistent outreach and a deep understanding of your accounts.
  • Collaborative when it counts. You know when to engage field resources, service teams, or leadership to improve win probability — and you do it without losing ownership of the deal.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience with demonstrated quota attainment
  • Proven experience managing a defined account portfolio with full sales cycle ownership
  • Remote selling proficiency — phone, email, and virtual meetings are your primary channels
  • Strong CRM discipline, preferably Salesforce, with accurate real-time pipeline documentation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage and influence across multiple stakeholder types

STRONGLY PREFERRED

  • Healthcare or acute-care hospital sales experience
  • Medical or capital equipment sales background
  • Service agreement or recurring revenue sales experience
  • Familiarity with GPO relationships, hospital procurement cycles, and capital buying processes

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

  • Performance-Based Compensation: Base salary plus quota-based variable compensation for equipment sales and CoverCare renewals, with commissions for net new CoverCare unit additions.
  • 100% Remote — sell from anywhere with a strong, structured virtual approach
  • Competitive Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) — active day 1, no waiting period
  • Flexible Time Off Schedule
  • 401(k) + Company matching
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) — own a piece of what you're building
  • Sales Type: Inside Sales, Account Management, B2B
  • Industry: Healthcare

OUR CULTURE

At IPA, we believe great results come from strong relationships, collaboration, and a shared commitment to helping our customers succeed. We foster an environment where employees are empowered to contribute ideas, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact on the business.

We value diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

THINK YOU COULD BE A FIT?

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. We recognize that strong candidates bring a variety of experiences, perspectives, and transferable skills that may not be reflected in a traditional resume.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities
