raw.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a Consulting Sales Engineer. This position is remote-friendly.

Position Overview:

The Consulting Sales Engineer at Alteryx plays a pivotal role in the sales process by bridging the gap between technical capabilities and customer needs, by translating the Alteryx platform features to customer business value. This role involves working closely with the sales team to provide technical expertise, product demonstrations, and solution recommendations tailored to prospective clients. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of Alteryx products, data analytics, and have excellent communication skills to effectively articulate the value of our solutions.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provide pre-sales support for pre-qualified opportunities for all products in the Alteryx Platform.

  • Craft and deliver technical presentations of offerings to new potential customers.

  • Develop and deliver proof of concept (POC) demonstrations/meetings to demonstrate the feasibility and value of Alteryx solutions in the customer's environment.

  • Remain up to date on Alteryx solutions and products, industry trends, competitive products, and emerging technologies while maintaining familiarity and adherence to all company methods and procedures.

  • Mentor team members through observation of their work and develop learning plans to improve their abilities, skills and knowledge of the Alteryx platform, sales engineering strategies, and client facing skills.

  • Work with sales management to drive sales through optimizing processes, training of team, and development of a culture of collaboration, learning, and success.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of pre-sales or consultant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data science, preferably in the software industry. This includes at least 3 years of experience in the field.

  • Knowledge of public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) with familiarity in data warehousing solutions like Snowflake and Databricks. Proficiency in SQL, Python, R, Apache Spark or similar product or language is a plus.

  • Strong knowledge of data analytics, data science, and ETL processes. Proficiency in using Alteryx or similar data analytics tools is highly desirable.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex selling situations, involving multiple departments and levels of the organization (i.e., Line of business, C-suite, IT, etc.)

  • Ability to handle a fast-paced environment and continuously re-prioritize while maintaining a constant focus on participating in the sales process.

  • Travel up to 40% or as required.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as your relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The “On Target Earnings” (OTE) for this role in the United States is $184,200 - $202,540.

Employees may also be eligible for a wide range of other benefits (subject to eligibility), including medical, retirement, financial, wellness, time off, employee discounts, and others.

Interested? Learn more and apply today at alteryx.com/careers!

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Benefits & Perks:

Alteryx has amazing benefits for all Associates which can be viewed here.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Alteryx will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

raw.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.
We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Today, we’re ready to add another Senior Paid Media Manager to our team. Our new Senior Paid Media Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will act as a true paid channel expert, developing and managing a portfolio of Paid Media accounts and marketing campaigns, building great relationships, managing projects and deliverables, and growing accounts.

You’ll work on a team of other Paid Media Specialists and Managers, but as the Sr. Manager, will be expected to go “above and beyond” to exemplify excellence in your work & contribute to internal initiatives like developing media best practices, disseminating industry updates, and enhancing Silverback’s overall media product. You’ll serve as a role model and mentor to your peers, and in some cases, will even directly manage 1-2 junior teammates.

The Senior Paid Media Manager is expected to work cross-functionally, finding opportunities to enhance our clients' overall digital programs through Paid initiatives and complementary strategies with other services. You'll collaborate internally with teammates in Creative, Measurement, SEO, and Client Services functions. You’ll be the true face of Paid Media for your assigned clients, and will spearhead the kickoff, development, tactical execution, and ongoing testing, optimization, and overall success of your clients’ media strategies & performance.

Here’s what we expect from our Senior Paid Media Manager.

—What You'll Do—

    • Responsible for driving the strategy, innovation, and performance of multiple client Paid Media strategies

    • Fully “own” the success of a portfolio of a few (3-5) client accounts

    • Plan, implement, and audit paid media campaigns & strategies that align with client KPIs and marketing goals

    • Successfully plan & execute campaigns in both Search and Social paid media platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)

    • Pioneer testing and deployment of “outside the box” media channels & tools

    • Collaborate closely with internal teammates in our Creative and Measurement teams to drive successful creative strategy/performance & analytics measurement, tag management, etc

    • Collaborate cross-functionally whenever appropriate (i.e. on multiservice clients) with counterparts in SEO to drive successful cross-channel marketing strategy for clients

    • Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients

    • Leverage various tools to carry out analysis and to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of Paid Media accounts

    • Serve as the lead point of contact for all things Paid Media for your “owned” clients; lead biweekly and ad hoc client calls to build & maintain strong client relationships

    • Successfully retain & even grow your assigned client portfolio through best-in-class communication, storytelling, presentation, and relationship building

    • Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change

    • Understand the client’s industry, audience and goals and stay on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices

    • Play a close role in sales enablement, including but not limited to identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and contributing to sales pitches, client onboardings/kickoffs, etc

    • Effectively delegate support tasks as appropriate to junior teammates; manage quality assurance for teammates’ work & ensure clients are receiving high-quality deliverables 100% of the time

    • In some cases, directly manage (i.e. act as the dedicated people manager) for 1-2 Paid Media teammates (Managers, Specialists, or Associates)

    • Contribute to the overall success of the Media department through proactive involvement in product development, process improvement, and direct collaboration with the Associate Directors and Senior Director of Paid Media

—What We’re Looking For—

    • 5+ years of experience (minimum) managing Paid Search AND Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok)

    • Previous agency experience is a must-have!

    • Experience serving as the main point of contact on client engagements (at least 3+ years of client-facing experience); strong comfortability being client-facing

    • Strong experience driving/leading paid media account strategy

    • Strong testing & innovation mentality

    • Experience collaborating with Creative resources and contributing to creative briefs + driving paid social performance creative

    • Advanced proficiency with Google Analytics 4 and Google Sheets/Excel

    • Experience with Google Tag Manager and Supermetrics is a plus!

    • Strong analytical skills, technical knowledge and attention to detail

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

    • Eagerness to deliver under tight deadlines

    • Genuine curiosity that will guide the research to inform your technical work

    • Outstanding time management and organization skills

    • The ability to accept constructive criticism in a professional manner and to learn from edits

    • Comfort with constant personal and professional growth

—Why Silverback?—

    • Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

    • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

    • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

    • Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

    • Unlimited PTO

    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

    • Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

    • Company-paid ClassPass membership

    • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

    • Summer Fridays

    • 401(k) with Employer Match

—Work Environment—

    • We’re a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication.

    • We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality.

    • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you!

Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, color, disability, family, genetic information, origin, race, religion, sex. For more information, we invite you to visit eeoc.gov.

raw.description:
At Nimber, we're looking for a ServiceNow Developer to join a challenging international project within the banking sector, focused on the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of enterprise Service Management platforms.

You'll work in an environment supporting over 130,000 users and 11,000 service fulfilment professionals, across multiple ServiceNow instances used for IT operations and business processes.

This role combines JavaScript development, platform configuration and application support, offering the opportunity to work on a wide range of solutions, from IT Service Management (ITSM) to employee portals and business-specific applications.

Previous ServiceNow experience is valued, but training on the platform is planned, making this an opportunity for developers with strong JavaScript skills who want to specialise in ServiceNow.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop, configure and maintain applications and functionalities within the ServiceNow platform.
  • Contribute to the development of new features and enhancements for IT and business applications.
  • Work with ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change and service catalogue management.
  • Support the development and maintenance of user portals, service catalogues and custom business applications.
  • Develop and customise platform functionalities using JavaScript.
  • Work with REST APIs to support integrations between ServiceNow and external systems.
  • Contribute to frontend customisation using HTML, CSS and AngularJS.
  • Manage platform configuration, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Investigate and resolve application issues, ensuring platform stability and operational continuity.
  • Collaborate with international IT teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript development.
  • Good understanding of web application development and integration principles.
  • Experience developing, maintaining or supporting enterprise applications.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive approach to learning new technologies and improving existing solutions.
  • Professional proficiency in English (mandatory).

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with ServiceNow development, administration or configuration.
  • Knowledge of ITSM processes, including incident, problem and change management.
  • Experience developing or integrating REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS and AngularJS.
  • Experience with ServiceNow portals, service catalogues or custom applications.
  • Previous exposure to banking or other large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Professional proficiency in French.

Why Nimber?

At Nimber, we don't believe in simply filling vacancies. We believe in connecting talented people with meaningful challenges, encouraging innovation and creating opportunities to make a real impact.

If you have a strong JavaScript background, enjoy developing enterprise applications and want to expand your expertise in ServiceNow within an international environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Ready for a new challenge? Apply now and make your mark with Nimber.

raw.title: Salesforce Developer
raw.excerpt: Who We Are:Yoga Alliance is the largest nonprofit membership association of yoga professionals, practitioners, and advocates around the globe.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

Yoga Alliance is the largest nonprofit membership association of yoga professionals, practitioners, and advocates around the globe. We believe if more people practice yoga, the better the world will be. We’re here to amplify the power of yoga and to make it accessible to anyone wherever they are, under whatever circumstances by:

  • Uplifting the transformative power of yoga,
  • Surfacing and reducing barriers to the practice, and
  • Building, engaging, and supporting the yoga community.

Our member-driven community is a diverse collective of wisdom holders, yoga educators, and teachers expanding their expertise; a welcoming space for those newly exploring yoga; a place for seasoned practitioners to deepen their practice; and a supportive hub where community leaders, organizations, and businesses can leverage yoga for social good.

At the core of Yoga Alliance lies a profound commitment to our people. Here, every team member is empowered to lead, innovate, dream, create, and grow. Diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility and belonging guide our way of being in work and in working with each other. We champion a culture of collaboration, where learning from failures is as valued as achieving success. Together, we challenge the status quo and push the boundaries of what is possible.

About the Role:

Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience Yoga Alliance is seeking a Salesforce Developer to join our team.

Salesforce is the backbone of how we serve our members ​-- it holds​ their ​critical information and powers credentialing, membership, and communications. ​Yoga Alliance is adding this newly created role to ​its team to give the platform a dedicated in-house owner who can strengthen and grow ​Salesforce over time. Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience, this role will partner cross-functionally with internal teams and ​externally with the implementation partner to ​ensure the Salesforce environment​ is reliable and stable, ​as well as manage day-to-day requests from members and staff, and help ​deliver the improvements on ​the product roadmap.

What You Will Do:

Administration and Configuration

  • Own incident response during renewals, launches, and peak periods, making time-sensitive calls and coordinating fixes with the external partner when needed.
  • Manage users, profiles, permission sets, roles, and license assignments across the organization
  • Build and maintain declarative automation with Flow, validation rules, and approval processes.
  • Configure objects, fields, page layouts, record types, and Lightning App pages.
  • Build and maintain CRM and operational reports and dashboards: membership records, case volume, renewals, and internal team dashboards.
  • Maintain data quality across records through deduplication, standardization, and ongoing hygiene.
  • Work through the support and enhancement backlog, prioritizing the highest-impact tickets first.

Development

  • Write, test, and maintain Apex (triggers, classes, batch and scheduled jobs) where configuration alone is not enough.
  • Build Lightning Web Components for custom interfaces.
  • Build and configure member portal experiences on Experience Cloud within the product and UX direction set by the Director of Digital Experience.
  • Support and maintain the platform's integrations over REST and SOAP APIs: Absorb LMS (SSO enrollment and completion sync), Stripe and Blackthorn payments, Marketing Cloud journey triggers, and Pendo.
  • Write unit tests that meet Salesforce's 75% minimum, with higher coverage on business-critical logic.
  • Run deployments and sandbox refreshes following the release schedule and environment strategy set by the Director of Digital Experience and the external implementation partner.

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Own user acceptance testing and post-launch stabilization across a launch-heavy roadmap, including participating in UAT cycles, triaging defects, and resolving the post-launch backlog after each release.
  • Translate defined business requirements into technical designs and build specifications, advising stakeholders on feasibility, effort, and tradeoffs.
  • Collaborate day-to-day with the external implementation partner on assigned development and release items, with the partner relationship and scoping staying with the Director of Digital Experience.
  • Document configuration, customizations, and decisions so the org stays maintainable.
  • Track Salesforce releases and adopt relevant features and best practices.

What You Will Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience across administration and development.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification.
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder certification.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
  • Strong command of the Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and organizational-wide defaults.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud
    • Declarative automation, especially Flow
    • Source control and deployment tooling: Salesforce DX, Git, and CI/CD
    • Coordinating work with external implementation or development partners
  • Working proficiency in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Familiarity with REST and SOAP API integrations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong project management skills with a proven track record of proactively managing expectations and ensuring consistent follow through and delivery.
  • Demonstrated commitment to and experience advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging in the workplace or community settings.
  • Curious and proactively scans the horizon to stay abreast of technology, creative approaches, and novel ideas to experiment, test, and apply.
  • Ability to travel as needed to Yoga Alliance’s Arlington, VA office to participate in organizational meetings, trainings and retreats.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
  • Experience with credentialing or certification systems: renewals, application flows, and the underlying data model. Ideally at a membership organization, nonprofit, or association.
  • Experience with data deduplication and data quality tooling within Salesforce.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum delivery.
  • Experience coordinating work with external implementation or development partners.

We encourage individuals to apply even if they do not have any of the desiredqualifications.

What We Offer:

Yoga Alliance provides robust employee benefits including comprehensive health insurance plan offerings that are 100% employer paid for employees and 65% paid for dependents, a matching 401K plan, a generous paid-leave program including parental leave and sabbatical leave, and reimbursement for professional development opportunities. Employees enjoy a casual dress code so they can arrive to work as their most authentic selves. Our organizational culture is supportive and collaborative with conscious attention to body and mind health.

Location:

This position is remote and will require the individual to be able to travel as needed. Yoga Alliance is based in Arlington, Virginia within sight of the historic northwest region of Washington, DC.

Salary Range:

$102,000 - $112,000 (commensurate with experience). This position is a full-time, exempt position.

Application and Timeline:

Interested applicants are encouraged to apply by November 16, 2026to ensure priority consideration of your application. We will continue to review applications on a rolling basis after this priority deadline until the position is filled.

A cover letter is required and all cover letters will be read during the application review process.

Please, no phone calls or walk-ins.

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace:
At Yoga Alliance, we value a diverse team and a culture of inclusivity and belonging. We encourage applications from all individuals without regard to an individuals' race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

raw.title: Head of Product
raw.excerpt: Decile Group is transforming venture capital into a force for good in the world.
raw.description:
Decile Group is transforming venture capital into a force for good in the world. We are working to launch 1,000 next-generation venture capital firms, changing the face of venture capital. We run VC Lab, the leading venture capital accelerator worldwide, and operate the Decile Hub platform — reducing the barriers of entry for next-generation investors to launch and grow meaningful early-stage investment firms.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own the full product experience of Decile Hub and build it into a world-class tool. Read more about the Decile Group tech team here:

The ideal candidate is obsessive about user experience — not in a theoretical way, but in the way that makes you fix a broken flow at 11pm because you can't stop thinking about it. You understand how software is actually built. You've worked closely enough with Rails codebases to speak the language of your engineers, and you know how to use AI tools not as a curiosity but as a real lever for speed and quality. You don't need a prestigious resume — but you do need to be a sharp thinker, a clear communicator, and someone who holds the bar high.

Basic requirements:

  • You must live and work within a few time zones of Pacific (California) time. We are on Zoom and Slack a lot.
  • You must be comfortable getting into a Rails app, reading the code, and understanding what's hard and what isn't.
  • You are already using AI tools daily — in your writing, your research, your specs, your thinking. This isn't aspirational for you; it's how you work.
  • You must be able to own a product surface end-to-end and work directly with the people who use it.

If you're the kind of person who gets genuinely bothered by a clunky UX, who has strong opinions about what "good" looks like, and who wants to build something that tens of thousands of venture capitalists will rely on to run their firms — then you're who we're looking for.

And we want to work with you too.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product experience, end to end. You are accountable for how Decile Hub looks, feels, and works — from the first login of a new fund manager to the most complex fund administration workflow. Every interaction is your responsibility.
  • Set and drive the roadmap. Translate user needs, operational realities, and Decile Group's business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap. Make the hard calls on what gets built and what doesn't. Maintain alignment across Decile Group's engineering, operations, and leadership teams.
  • Write specs that engineers love. Crisp, specific, with edge cases handled and acceptance criteria defined. You remove ambiguity before it becomes a bug. You respect engineering time.
  • Use AI to move faster and think sharper. Leverage AI in discovery, synthesis, spec writing, competitive research, and anywhere else it makes you better. Be a model for AI-first product thinking across Decile Group.
  • Stay close to customers. Run user interviews. Shadow onboarding calls. Read every support ticket. Synthesize what you learn into clear problem definitions and close the loop after features ship to make sure they actually worked.
  • Raise the bar on design and UX. Be the person at Decile Group who is never satisfied with "good enough." Push for clarity, simplicity, and delight in every flow — especially in the dense, complex workflows that define fund administration.
  • Lead cross-functional execution. Bring structure to product workflows across Decile Group. Rally engineering, ops, legal ops, and customer success around shared priorities. Keep launches on track and documentation tight.

What You Bring

  • 6–10+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping high-quality, complex SaaS products
  • Genuine technical fluency — you've worked closely with Rails or comparable web frameworks and can hold your own in an engineering conversation
  • An active, sophisticated AI workflow — you use AI tools to do your job better, every day
  • Exceptional written clarity — your specs, emails, and Slack messages are models of structured thinking
  • Deep UX sensibility — you've built beautiful, functional tools for operational, financial, or workflow-heavy domains and you know the difference between a flow that works and one that sings
  • Strong prioritization instincts and the discipline to say no to good ideas in service of great ones
  • Comfort in fast-moving, high-ambiguity environments — and the ability to create structure where there isn't any

Nice to Have

  • Experience with fund administration, venture capital tooling, or compliance workflows
  • Background in operations, legal ops, or workflow automation
  • Experience analyzing user behavior and creating practical user segments (e.g., new users, advanced users, high-touch accounts) to inform onboarding, feature design, or support processes

How to Apply:

If you don't tick every box above, we'd still encourage you to apply. We're building a diverse team whose skills balance and complement one another.
Please describe why you are uniquely qualified for this position in the competitive field of Venture Capital to apply, as well as submitting your resume.
Salary and benefits are commensurate with experience.

raw.description:
Begin your Composites One career today!

Position Overview:

The Business Development Manager – Advanced Resins is responsible for strategically driving growth and profitability of the assigned product category by collaborating closely with the Product Manager, Commercial and Technical Teams, Operations, Procurement, and Suppliers. The Business Development Manager will be the technical expert on Advanced Resins including pDCPD, Epoxy, Curatives, Urethanes, etc. and provide required training to the Commercial and Technical Teams that enables them to be effective at maintaining current business and converting new business. The Business Development Manager focuses efforts across C1 functional groups to deliver both short-term and long-term results for the organization and drive customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Growth Strategy

  • Develop and execute an annual business development plan to position C1 as the premier partner for Customers and Suppliers within the specified product line.
  • Develop market plans and tactics that support Product Marketing and effectively execute strategic plans with internal stakeholders.
  • Recommend pricing strategies that enhance profitability and increase market share.
  • Research, analyze, and monitor the product category, market trends, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to understand the competitive landscape and recommend strategic and tactical responses.

Customer & Supplier Partnerships

  • Develop and strengthen key Customer and Supplier relationships to drive revenue, margin growth, and Customer satisfaction.
  • Understand key Suppliers’ products, strategies, and technical capabilities to identify and capitalize on growth opportunities.
  • Communicate Customer and market product/technology needs to the Product Manager and share relevant competitive information with stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to partner with Suppliers to support market and industry growth.

Technical & Commercial Support

  • Serve as a primary technical and commercial resource for the Advanced Resins product category.
  • Partner with Sales Managers to coordinate strategic Customer and Supplier interactions.
  • Visit key Customers with Sellers and Commercial Team members to provide technical support, market and product information, and understand Customer needs.
  • Provide field personnel with technical product and processing information needed to enhance Customer responsiveness.
  • Develop and facilitate technical training, seminars, and supporting tools for Commercial Teams.
  • Participate in industry trade shows and trade associations to support Commercial Teams and Customers.

Product, Inventory & Profitability Management

  • Evaluate product line overlap and provide recommendations to the Product Manager, Suppliers, Supply Chain Managers, and Commercial and Technical Teams.
  • Assist with product category rationalization and inventory maintenance, including identifying opportunities to move aged inventory.
  • Partner with the Product Manager and Supply Chain Managers to leverage product purchases, identify COGS reduction opportunities, and optimize logistics to improve profitability.
  • Transform market data into useful information that can be effectively communicated to key internal and external stakeholders.

Expected Skills and Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in a technical, business development, B2B marketing, Composites Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related role focused on Advanced Resins.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Composites or Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Technical expertise in Advanced Resins, including pDCPD, Epoxy, Curatives, Urethanes, and related technologies, with the ability to provide effective technical training.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute business development strategies that support customer needs and drive growth.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, OEMs, and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to analyze market and business data and translate findings into recommendations.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel, with the ability to learn internal systems such as Incorta and SAP.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

  • A proven track record of business development or related commercial success and technical skills is desired for this position.
  • Composites industry experience is a significant plus.
  • Experience with MS Office programs and applications preferred.

Work Location & Travel:

  • This is a remote position; however, candidates should reside within proximity to one of the locations identified in this job posting.

  • Routine travel (up to 70%) is required, including local, national, and international travel to visit customers, engage with suppliers, and attend industry trade shows.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • This position offers a competitive base salary plus an annual performance-based bonus.

  • A company vehicle and company cell phone are also provided.

Pre-Employment Requirement:

  • Employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of a drug screen and background check. This requirement is especially critical for safety-sensitive roles.

Discover a Fulfilling Career:

At Composites One, our Team Members are the cornerstone of our success. Each role is essential in helping us provide exceptional service to our Customers. We cultivate a culture of empowerment and opportunity, fostering both personal and professional growth.

We believe in driving success and appreciating achievement. Our Team Members are eligible for annual bonuses and profit sharing because when the company thrives, we all benefit. Join us and be part of a Team where your hard work and dedication are valued, and together, we achieve great things.

Respect, Teamwork, and Communication are Woven into our Core Values:

Our guiding principle of Respect, Teamwork, and Communication embodies the spirit of our Core Values. We uphold these principles every day as we strive to make a positive impact for our Customers, our Team, and the world around us.

Benefits:

Explore our comprehensive health, retirement, wellness, and professional growth programs in detail here.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Composites One, all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or other protected classification as defined by applicable law and regulation.

raw.description:
Cognicion LLC, a boutique eDiscovery services and information management provider is actively recruiting a Senior eDiscovery Consultant who is a Relativity Certified Administrator and/or has Generative AI experience. The selected candidate is responsible for overseeing and delivering high quality eDiscovery projects. Serving as a trusted advisor to our clients, the Senior eDiscovery Consultant provides strategic guidance in the identification, collection, preservation, and analysis of electronic data for legal and regulatory matters. This role leads project teams, demonstrates effective project management, coordinates team resources, assists with project related tasks, and ensures a high level of client service.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  1. Acts as primary point of contact to internal and external clients for eDiscovery consultation. Advises regarding eDiscovery services and data management activities including, but not limited to, data collection, volume reduction services, data processing, hosted production workflows, data analytics, and document review.
  2. Develops a firm understanding of client’s technical requirements and objectives, documenting project specifications and requirements, and translating those needs to a team of internal technical staff.
  3. Provides project scope and estimates to client and ensures adequate staffing and resources requirements to achieve project goals and timelines.
  4. Delegates appropriate workflow tasks, including data management, data processing, and productions or other required work product.
  5. Implements project-specific quality control processes and oversees quality control of all out going work product.
  6. Collaborates with the Manager of Managed Review Services in analyzing review quality control statistics, team productivity, and project budget goals. Provides feedback on review team work product, productivity levels, and adherence to best practice standards.
  7. Understands the downstream impact of various options during collection, processing, review, and production.
  8. Mitigates risks to timeline or deliverables and set realistic expectations with internal project teams, external clients, and any third-party providers.
  9. Identifies project issues and seeks appropriate resolutions with technology team, software experts, or other available resources. Keeps client and case teams updated on potential issues and possible resolutions.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Juris Doctorate degree preferred with licensure to practice in any state.
  • 6 years’ experience in eDiscovery project management or litigation document Review.

TECHNICAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Advanced knowledge of Relativity e-Discovery software, including advanced experience with structured analytics, active learning or technology-assisted review (TAR), and exposure to Relativity aiR products.
  • Up to date expertise on eDiscovery management trends including technology assisted review, generative AI, predictive coding and understanding of impact of recent case law on project management processes.
  • Strong project management experience with on-time deliverables, problem-solving skills, and high attention to detail.
  • Extensive knowledge of the concepts, principles, management, and processing of electronically stored information (ESI) as they relate to legal matters, including the use of various ESI management tools and applications.

The expected salary range for this role is $98,500 – $149,800. Beyond an employment candidate's physical location, salary offers may be based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, education, training and/or experience.

Description

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

Location: United States | Remote/Hybrid | Approximately 40% domestic travel
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

Exodigo is seeking a Director of Geotechnical Engineering to lead U.S. geotechnical engineering standards, quality, and technical credibility. This senior role combines engineering leadership with customer engagement, helping infrastructure owners, contractors, and engineering consultants understand and trust Exodigo’s subsurface intelligence technology.

The ideal candidate is an experienced geotechnical engineer with strong industry relationships and expertise in complex civil infrastructure, particularly tunnels, bridges, and transportation projects. You will partner with Sales as a technical advisor while working across Product, R&D, Operations, and Project Management to translate engineering needs into product requirements and ensure reliable, defensible deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build industry trust: Represent Exodigo’s geotechnical expertise with infrastructure owners, DOTs, contractors, and engineering consultants; communicate the technology’s value, accuracy, and limitations.
  • Support customers and Sales: Lead technical discussions, presentations, and proposals, addressing engineering challenges and demonstrating real-world applications.
  • Own technical standards and quality: Translate customer requirements and industry standards into engineering specifications, acceptance criteria, QA processes, and consistent delivery practices.
  • Provide engineering oversight: Review geotechnical deliverables and serve as the responsible engineering sign-off authority.
  • Connect engineering and product: Partner with Product and R&D to align customer needs with product capabilities and development priorities.
  • Improve project delivery: Work with U.S. Project Management, Operations, and CAD/BIM teams to standardize workflows and maintain consistent quality nationwide.

Requirements

• B.S. in Civil Engineering with a geotechnical specialization; M.S. strongly preferred.

• 10–15 years of progressive geotechnical engineering experience in U.S. civil infrastructure and/or construction.

• Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) in at least one U.S. state, with the ability to obtain additional licensure as needed.

• Demonstrated track record authoring formal engineering requirement documents (PRDs, design basis documents, technical specifications) and translating market needs into user stories / acceptance criteria.

• Deep working knowledge of DOT (AASHTO, FHWA, state DOT) and ASCE standards; strong familiarity with ASTM and USACE geotechnical practice.

• Solid understanding of engineering and geotechnical formats, including common solutions, methodologies, and industry work practices

• Basic technological understanding of current tools and approaches used in engineering and geotechnical fields

• Ability to read, interpret, and analyze geological, geotechnical, and civil engineering reports

• Substantial client-facing experience: scoping, presenting, negotiating technical approaches with owners, DOTs, and contractors; acting as voice of the customer internally.

• Experience leading delivery organizations that include field operators, OPS, QA, and CAD/BIM/infrastructure engineers.

• Hands-on experience running agile/structured delivery using tools such as Monday, Jira, Slack, and Gantt-based planning.

• Advanced proficiency in drafting documents, proposals, and strategic plans, with meticulous attention to detail to ensure clarity, accuracy, and effective coordination of all requirements and applications

• Proven collaboration with business functions on strategy, pricing, and marketing in a technical B2B context.

• U.S. work authorization; willingness to travel domestically to project sites (estimated 25–40%).

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading delivery for productized geotechnical solutions (instrumentation, monitoring, sensing, specialty foundations, ground improvement, etc.).

• Prior role as a technical/delivery lead on major DOT or large-scale infrastructure projects.

• Active participation in ASCE Geo-Institute, TRB committees, or DFI technical committees.

• Experience working in a growth-stage company environment with cross-functional business exposure.

Salary: $160,000 - $260,000 depending on experience and geographic location.

Location: Remote (NYC / LA preferred)

Exodigo encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants without regard to characteristics protected under applicable federal, state, or local law, including race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.

Learn more

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to shape sales strategy and make a direct impact on company growt
  • Exposure to cutting-edge solutions transforming digital infrastructure and data center development
  • Collaborative, no-ego team environment focused on customer impact
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility and autonomy

Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open-minded, and love hard questions.

You can learn more about us on our website or check out this short video.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to execute service work as per work instructions and in accordance with ABB quality and safety guidelines. Each day, you will deliver quality customer service and executing service work as per customer order and expectation. You will ensure customer retention by effectively communicating the service work timeline and expectations.

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The work model for the role is: Remote { selected candidates will be located in Cheyenne, WY.

Your role and responsibilities:

  • Work on-site with customers to identify opportunities for operational improvement and eliminate pain points.

raw.excerpt: Impinj delivers the Physical Intelligence that connects the physical world to the AI-powered digital world, fueling automated workflows and improving consumer experiences.
raw.description:
Impinj delivers the Physical Intelligence that connects the physical world to the AI-powered digital world, fueling automated workflows and improving consumer experiences. From retail merchandise and groceries to packages and shipping pallets, Impinj products and solutions identify and track tens of billions of everyday items, providing real-time operational insights about every item enterprises make, move and sell. We are, quite literally, the eyes and ears of smart enterprise systems. Come help us build technology and solutions that enable businesses to visualize everything, waste nothing and act instantly.

Team Overview:

The Layout Design Engineering group is an integral part of the Silicon Engineering department, working closely with the analog RFID end-point IC development team and the Reader IC team, internationally. The team is responsible for delivering tape-outs for RFID products, test chips, reader ICs, and DOEs (design of experiments) work that sits at the center of how Impinj brings new silicon to market.

Layout decisions made by this team directly influence the power efficiency, cost, and time-to-market of every piece of silicon we ship, making the group's work foundational to Impinj's mission. The team operates with a continuous-improvement mindset, adapting quickly and challenging each other to remain best-in-class in both quality and speed, with meticulous attention to detail to ensure designs have long-term reliability and zero defects, at production volumes in the many billions and eventually trillions of tags per year.

What You Will Do:

  • Perform detailed transistor-level layout of RF, mixed-signal, and analog circuit blocks for both high-performance RF as well as ultra-low power and compact RFID
  • Work closely with the analog and digital design teams on floor planning, pin placement, power supply strategy and signal distribution between blocks
  • Conduct layout reviews for power/ground routing, electromigration, matching, and signal coupling
  • Participate in schedule meetings coordinating layout and floorplan activities

What You Will Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer or electrical engineering and 8+ years of experience
  • Experience in custom analog, RF, and mixed-signal layout
  • Ability to collaborate with other layout engineers on the top-level IC floorplan, partnering with circuit designers to resolve complex problems
  • Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and foundry technologies across advanced process nodes down to 16nm for ultra-low-power and high-fidelity applications
  • Knowledge of analog layout challenges and layout-dependent effects in advanced processes — noise coupling, matching, parasitics, LOD, WPE, PSE, and coloring — along with proficiency in mitigation techniques such as guard rings, DNW, PN junctions, parasitic management, signal integrity, reliability (EMIR), and ESD
  • Proficiency with the use of Cadence Virtuoso layout editor and Cadence/Siemens layout verification tools (including PVS and Siemens Calibre DRC/LVS). Ability to interpret and correct ERC, DRC and LVS error reports
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong technical project management skills

Compensation & Benefits:

The benefits listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Impinj and the country where you work.

The typical base pay range for this role across the US is $136,000 - $204,000. Individual base pay depends on various factors such as complexity and responsibility of role, job duties, requirements, and relevant experience and skills. Both market wage data and the mid-point of the pay range is reviewed and used as the starting point for all new hire offers. Offers are made within the base pay range applicable at the time.

At Impinj certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, annual bonus and stock. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role. US based employees have access to healthcare benefits; a 401(k) plan and company match among others.

For a more comprehensive list of US employment benefits, click here.

US Export Controls:

This position has access to technologies or data subject to U.S. export control regulations. Under these laws, the release or transfer of export-controlled items or information to individuals who are not classified as "U.S. persons" (as defined by Immigration & Nationality Act) may require prior authorization from the U.S. government. We may require additional documentation related to national identity to determine whether an export compliance license is required for any export-controlled items. This information is requested solely for the purpose of complying with U.S. export control laws and will not be used for other purposes. Learn more about export compliance here.

Why work at Impinj:

Know you’re making a difference. Competitive benefits. Support for remote work or a desk with a view. Weekly Q&A sessions with our executive team. Impinj provides an environment that fosters openness and innovation and is developing technology that delivers a positive impact on the world. Collaboration and teamwork are highly valued, and accomplishments are duly celebrated. We have an open paid time-off policy paired with a respect for work/life balance. Our headquarters is located in Seattle with spectacular views of the Olympics, Lake Union, and Mt Baker, which can be enjoyed from our rooftop deck. Our Brazilian site is in Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul state, at “Tecnopuc,” a technology park that offers a very nice workplace for the development of groundbreaking technologies. Impinj is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

raw.excerpt: About HighLevel: HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
raw.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    HighLevel is looking for a Sr. SDET with 5+ years of experience to play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, performance, and scalability of our products. We are seeking engineers who thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoy problem-solving, and stay updated with the latest models and solutions. This is a great opportunity to work on cutting-edge performance testing strategies and contribute to the success of our products.

Responsibilities:

  • Performance baselines for critical services: SLIs, SLOs, and latency, throughput, and error-rate targets, plus workload models built from production traffic and real customer behaviour
  • A shared performance testing framework and production-like environments (Kubernetes and cloud, test data included) that product-team SDETs can use without starting from scratch, and the evaluation of new tools through PoCs
  • Automated performance regression checks in CI/CD, with trend reports that catch regressions before release
  • Load, stress, soak, and spike testing, and capacity planning ahead of peak events
  • Root cause analysis of bottlenecks across API, database, queue, and frontend layers, using traces, metrics, logs, and profiling, in partnership with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, concurrency, rate limiting and common performance bottlenecks
  • Ability to interpret performance metrics, translate findings into actionable engineering recommendations, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams
  • Supervise and mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building initiatives to raise the performance bar across the team

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in performance, scalability, or reliability engineering or testing, with examples of finding and fixing bottlenecks in production-scale systems
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern load-testing tool (k6, Gatling, or Locust), including realistic workload modeling and distributed load generation, and strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java
  • Experience using observability tooling (for example New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to isolate root cause across API, database, and queue layers, with a solid grasp of REST service performance, concurrency, and caching
  • Experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail thresholds
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) to deploy and debug test environments

Nice to Have:

  • Runtime profiling and thread or heap analysis on the JVM or Node.js (GC behavior, event-loop lag)
  • Frontend performance experience: Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, real user monitoring
  • Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to test design or result analysis
  • Experience with NoSQL or search datastores and message brokers at scale
  • Chaos or resilience testing, and safe testing in production (canaries, shadow traffic)

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. title: Patient Scheduling Coordinator
description: Role PurposeThe Patient Scheduling Coordinator is responsible for converting prospective patient enquiries into booked consultations and procedures for NMAC.

raw.title: Patient Scheduling Coordinator
raw.excerpt: Role PurposeThe Patient Scheduling Coordinator is responsible for converting prospective patient enquiries into booked consultations and procedures for NMAC.
raw.description:
Role Purpose

The Patient Scheduling Coordinator is responsible for converting prospective patient enquiries into booked consultations and procedures for NMAC.

The role manages prospective patients from their initial enquiry through to booking, providing timely, professional and personalised support throughout the decision-making process. The consultant will build trust with prospective patients, explain NMAC’s services clearly, address non-clinical questions, conduct consistent follow-up and maintain accurate patient and sales records.

This is a target-driven role requiring a strong balance of sales capability, empathy, professionalism and discretion.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Enquiry Management

  • Respond promptly and professionally to enquiries received through telephone calls, email, the website, social media, messaging platforms and marketing campaigns.
  • Contact new leads within the established response-time standard.
  • Engage prospective patients in a professional and reassuring manner.
  • Understand the patient’s needs, interests, timeframe and readiness to proceed.
  • Provide approved information regarding NMAC’s services, procedures, consultation process, pricing and payment arrangements.
  • Refer all clinical or medical questions to the appropriate NMAC medical professional.

Sales Conversion and Bookings

  • Guide prospective patients through the enquiry and booking process.
  • Convert qualified patient enquiries into booked consultations and procedures.
  • Conduct structured follow-up with prospective patients who have not yet booked.
  • Address non-clinical concerns or barriers that may prevent a patient from proceeding.
  • Re-engage previous enquiries and inactive leads where appropriate.
  • Identify suitable opportunities to introduce other relevant NMAC services without applying inappropriate pressure.
  • Meet agreed individual and team booking, conversion and revenue targets.

Patient Relationship Management

  • Deliver a high-quality and personalised patient experience at every stage of the sales process.
  • Build trust and maintain appropriate professional relationships with prospective patients.
  • Ensure that patients receive clear information about the next steps, required documentation, appointment arrangements and payment processes.
  • Coordinate with clinical and administrative teams to support a smooth transition from enquiry to consultation and treatment.
  • Escalate complaints, clinical concerns, safeguarding matters or sensitive patient issues promptly.

CRM and Record Management

  • Record all enquiries, calls, follow-ups, outcomes and bookings accurately in NMAC’s designated systems.
  • Maintain a clear and current sales pipeline.
  • Schedule follow-up activity and ensure that no viable patient enquiry is overlooked.
  • Record reasons why prospective patients do not proceed.
  • Maintain accurate patient contact details and communication preferences.
  • Handle patient and company information confidentially and in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and NMAC policies.

Reporting and Performance

  • Provide regular reports on lead volumes, response times, bookings, conversion rates, lost leads and revenue generated.
  • Participate in weekly pipeline and performance review meetings.
  • Identify recurring patient concerns, common objections and opportunities to improve the patient journey.
  • Provide feedback on lead quality and the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.
  • Work collaboratively with marketing, clinical, finance and administrative teams to improve conversion performance.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be measured against:

  • Speed of response to new patient enquiries
  • Percentage of leads successfully contacted
  • Enquiry-to-consultation booking rate
  • Consultation attendance rate
  • Consultation-to-procedure conversion rate
  • Number and value of confirmed bookings
  • Revenue generated from converted enquiries
  • Follow-up completion rate
  • Accuracy and completeness of CRM records
  • Patient satisfaction and communication quality
  • Reasons for lost or unconverted leads
  • Compliance with confidentiality, privacy and internal procedures

Final targets will be established by management and may be adjusted according to lead volumes, service demand and business requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential

  • Previous experience in sales, client conversion, appointment setting, account management, customer service or a patient-facing role.
  • Demonstrated ability to convert enquiries or leads into appointments, bookings or sales.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong telephone, email and virtual communication skills.
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and communicate with empathy and confidence.
  • Strong follow-up, organisation and time-management skills.
  • Confidence using CRM systems, email, virtual meeting platforms and other digital business tools.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining responsive and accountable.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Willingness and ability to work during the hours required to effectively support NMAC’s prospective patients.

Preferred

  • Experience in private healthcare, cosmetic surgery, medical aesthetics, dental services, wellness, hospitality or another premium service environment.
  • Experience working with high-value, consultative or relationship-based sales.
  • Experience managing an international or multi-country client base.
  • Knowledge of patient booking systems or healthcare CRM platforms.
  • Bermudian status or eligibility to work in Bermuda, where applicable.

Skills and Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Consultative selling and lead-conversion ability
  • Empathy and patient-centred communication
  • Professionalism and discretion
  • Persistence without being overly aggressive
  • Strong listening and questioning skills
  • Confidence in handling non-clinical objections
  • Commercial awareness and results orientation
  • High attention to detail
  • Good judgement and escalation awareness
  • Personal accountability and reliability
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries simultaneously
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with remote and cross-functional teams

Role Boundaries

The Patient Scheduling Coordinator is a non-clinical position. The role holder must not:

  • Provide medical advice, diagnoses or clinical recommendations.
  • Make claims or guarantees regarding clinical outcomes.
  • Recommend a procedure based on a clinical assessment.
  • Provide information outside approved NMAC materials and guidelines.
  • Pressure, mislead or inappropriately influence prospective patients.
  • Confirm that a patient is medically suitable for treatment.
  • Share patient information with unauthorised parties.

All clinical questions and decisions regarding medical suitability must be referred to an appropriately authorised NMAC medical professional.

Working Arrangements

  • This is a full-time remote role based in Bermuda or the United Kingdom.
  • The employee must have a professional, private and secure home-working environment.
  • The employee must maintain reliable internet connectivity and be available during agreed working hours.
  • Working hours may be structured to accommodate NMAC’s patient markets, enquiry patterns and operational requirements.
  • Some evening or weekend availability may be required, subject to the employment agreement and applicable labour requirements.
  • The employee will be expected to attend virtual meetings, training sessions and performance reviews.

Confidentiality and Data Protection

The role involves access to confidential patient, commercial and operational information. The successful candidate must comply with all applicable privacy requirements, confidentiality obligations, information-security standards and NMAC policies.

Patient information may only be accessed, recorded, used and shared for authorised business purposes through approved company systems.

Measures of Success

Success in this position will be demonstrated by:

  • Prompt and professional engagement with prospective patients.
  • Consistent conversion of qualified enquiries into consultations and procedures.
  • A well-managed and accurately recorded patient sales pipeline.
  • Strong coordination between the sales, clinical and administrative teams.
  • Positive prospective-patient experiences.
  • Achievement of agreed booking, conversion and revenue targets.
  • Adherence to ethical, clinical and confidentiality boundaries.

General Provision

This job description outlines the principal duties and responsibilities of the position. It is not an exhaustive list. The role holder may be required to perform other reasonable duties aligned with the nature and level of the position and NMAC’s operational requirements.
